jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS ProServe GDO - Security, Tooling, and Compliance Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building tools and automation that help organizations move faster and more securely in the cloud? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a team that builds purpose-built solutions enabling enterprise customers to deploy secure, compliant cloud foundations at scale.

In this role, you'll design and develop open-source and internal software that solves hard infrastructure and compliance challenges for some of the most security-conscious organizations in the world. Your work will directly reduce the time it takes for customers to go from zero to a fully operational, accredited cloud environment. You'll contribute to solutions spanning infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD platforms, data architecture tooling, and secure access management, all used by thousands of engineers globally.

You'll work in a team that values pragmatism over perfection, lean development practices, and building mechanisms that scale through automation rather than headcount. If you enjoy shipping software that has measurable impact on how customers adopt and operate in the cloud, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities


Design and maintain cloud infrastructure automation tools that help enterprise customers deploy secure, compliant environments on AWS

Build and contribute to open-source solutions that accelerate cloud foundation setup, including account structures, networking, and security controls

Develop and improve CI/CD platform tooling and developer experience for a software development platform used by tens of thousands of engineers globally

Build secure access management solutions that provide auditable, guardrail-enforced access to customer cloud environments

Write infrastructure-as-code, automated tests, and deployment automation to ensure reliability across all solutions

Collaborate across regions to design globally scalable, locally adaptable solutions

Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design sessions


About the team
We are a globally distributed engineering team within AWS Professional Services that builds tools and frameworks helping regulated enterprises get to production on AWS faster and more securely. Our solutions include open-source cloud foundation accelerators, a centralized development platform serving over 35,000 users, data architecture tooling, and secure access management systems. We value pragmatism, quality, and automation-first thinking. Our team is based in Germany and collaborates closely with delivery consultants and customers to solve real problems at scale.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Optics
jobs.description:
Come build intelligent systems that secure the foundation of our customer's physical locations using computer vision and applied machine learning to automate real-time production decisions that protect every AWS location globally.

The Amazon Optics team builds and manages services used by AWS employees to secure our physical sites. Our services allow customers to protect AWS locations and preserve the trust that all AWS users have in us. You will work with other software development engineers and Applied Scientists every day to build, deploy, and optimize machine learning models that automate real-time security decisions at scale. The models you build and operate will run across every AWS region, making automated determinations that directly impact the physical security posture of every AWS customer.

You will partner directly with Applied Scientists to translate research into production-grade inference pipelines. You will own the full lifecycle of ML model deployment: from training infrastructure through real-time serving, monitoring, and iteration. You will build the systems that take a model from notebook to production, ensuring low-latency inference at scale with high reliability.

Our team provides solutions where "can't be done" is not an answer. You will stretch yourself and grow. You will share your knowledge with others and help others achieve. You will be empowered to automate away operational inefficiencies for both the team and our customers. You will solve complex architecture problems with solutions that are extensible and scale, yet always look for ways to simplify. You will work with the team on multiple products deployed to every AWS region using AWS services in a fully IaC deployment environment where you own everything end to end: design, development, testing, deploying.

You will join a team that values strong intuition but seeks metrics and data to validate assumptions.

Key job responsibilities
Build and deploy machine learning models that automate real-time physical security decisions across all AWS regions
Partner with Applied Scientists to operationalize research models into production-grade inference pipelines
Own the full ML model lifecycle: training infrastructure, real-time serving, monitoring, retraining, and iteration
Design and implement low-latency, high-reliability distributed systems for model serving at scale
Build computer vision pipelines that process video and image data for automated threat detection
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for all ML and application infrastructure
Monitor model performance in production, identify drift, and drive continuous improvement
Contribute to system design and architecture decisions that balance innovation with operational excellence
Participate actively in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to peers and senior engineers
Collaborate cross-functionally with security operations, hardware, and product teams to define requirements
Drive operational excellence through automation, runbooks, and proactive risk mitigation
Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and technical growth

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer Apprentice (48-Month Fixed Term Contract)
jobs.description:
Are you a budding programmer with a passion for technology and a drive to learn? Look no further. We're seeking a Software Development Engineer Apprentice to join our dynamic team and embark on an exciting journey of professional growth and skill development.

As a Software Development Engineer Apprentice, you'll work alongside seasoned software engineering experts, gaining hands-on experience in a fast-paced, innovative environment. You'll contribute to the design, development, and implementation of cutting-edge software solutions that drive our business forward. Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll be exposed to a variety of programming languages, frameworks, and methodologies, building a well-rounded skillset - from mastering the fundamentals of software engineering to exploring emerging technologies and pushing the boundaries of your abilities.

A day in the life can involve:

- Collaborating with teams across the business to design, implement, and optimise solutions
- Learning and applying best practices in software development
- Contributing to real-world projects that impact millions of customers globally
- Analysing and solving complex technical challenges
- Participating in code reviews and ensuring code quality
- Implementing software security measures and compliance
- Staying up to date with the latest development trends and emerging technologies

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds with a genuine passion for technology and a drive to learn. You'll bring strong problem-solving skills, a self-motivated approach to learning, and a keen eye for detail. The ability to work collaboratively is crucial, as is excellent communication, so you can contribute to a dynamic team and build strong working relationships. You'll also need adaptability and a growth mindset to navigate shifting priorities and embrace new technologies and methodologies as you go.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious, ambitious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a wide range of valuable experiences and skills while working towards the Graduate Apprenticeship in BSc (Hons) Software Development. As a working student, your focus during your 20% off-the-job time is to develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours that lead to successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

Please note: as part of your off-the-job learning, you may be required to travel to a training centre, and this location may differ from your primary work base. Candidates should be prepared for occasional travel as part of the programme.

You'll build your skills over a 48-month period, starting in September, developing both personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship combines classroom and virtual training to cover the knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team that values different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here. If you've got this blend of technical curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a collaborative spirit, apply now and begin a journey that will propel your career forward in software development.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Network Fabric Engineering, MONA
jobs.description:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Core Networking team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) team. As a Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building software services to deploy and scale the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.

AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer with production quality software services experience.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery of new services and features is very rapid.
- The ideal candidate will demonstrate established software engineering expertise, having successfully developed and launched extensive distributed systems in collaboration with a team.
- You are adaptable, capable of excelling in a dynamic and entrepreneurial setting.
- You will be responsible for delivering high quality, extensible design and code.
- You are expected to have extensive background in network engineering and can troubleshoot network issues.
- You are expected to mentor and guide junior engineers.
- You are comfortable managing competing priorities and are able to bring order to ambiguous scenarios.
- You identify and implement optimizations for performance, scalability, and efficiency. Maturity, impeccable judgment, and the ability to influence and lead are essential to success in this role.
- You are data-driven and analytical.
- You have the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally, across organizations.


A day in the life
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.

About the team
AWS NFE (Network Fabric Engineering) owns datacenter network services that provide unconstrained connectivity to our customers, such as EC2, EBS, S3 and Amazon CDO Services. They own the networks internal to the datacenters end to end, including scaling and operational functions, for both traditional datacenters. They also own newer AWS offerings such as Outposts and Local Zones.
Working at AWS in the Core Networking Team

Meet Kensie, Network Development Engineer --- https://youtu.be/ezF3kpUAhWU

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

You will design, develop, and deploy reliable embedded software for large quantity of consumer electronic products. Leo is breaking new ground with every device we design, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system.
· Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
· Developing embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
· Have experience with real-time embedded software philosophies and practices
· Have expertise with Linux and/or RTOS
· Review schematics, logic analyzer, and embedded software trouble-shooting techniques.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
As part of our Leo Customer Terminal Software Team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Project Leo products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment. You need to be flexible and responsive to changing priority issues.

About the team
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Leo network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, VPC Lattice
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building software that impacts millions of customers? We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team at Amazon, where you will design, build, and deliver features that solve real customer problems at scale. In this role, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating software systems. You will work alongside talented engineers, collaborate across teams, and have the opportunity to mentor others while continuously growing your own technical skills. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving complex problems with simple, well-crafted solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions that improve quality, performance, and maintainability across major portions of your team's systems, ensuring alignment with long-term architectural goals.
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including product definition, scoping, design, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support, while maintaining high standards for code quality and documentation.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business and customer requirements, translating them into effective technical solutions.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools where appropriate, refining outputs and applying responsible practices to augment productivity and solution quality.
- Mentor and coach fellow engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and onboarding of new team members, helping raise the technical bar across the team.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design document for a new feature, then jump into a code review where you share feedback with a teammate. After a standup with your team, you spend focused time writing clean, well-tested code for a project you are driving. In the afternoon, you pair with a newer engineer to help them ramp up on a system you helped build, then wrap up by investigating an operational metric that caught your attention during a deployment.

About the team
Our team at Amazon is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the customer experience. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We encourage every team member to bring their perspective to the table, ask questions, and contribute ideas that shape our technical direction. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your engineering contributions have meaningful impact and your growth is supported, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced popular devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo and Amazon Echo Show. The Amazon Devices group delivers delightfully unique Amazon experiences, giving customers instant access to everything, digital or physical.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize device OS frameworks and system services that power connectivity on Amazon devices, including cellular, location, and related wireless experiences. You'll own software on the application processor side, from platform APIs and system services down to the interfaces with modem and hardware components, and deliver reliable, power-efficient experiences across many devices.

- Architect and implement core framework components and system services for voice, data, messaging, and connectivity features, along with newer capabilities such as Wi-Fi calling, eSIM provisioning, and 5G.
- Optimize performance, reliability, and power efficiency, including latency, resource usage, and behavior across diverse networks and device configurations.
- Partner with product management to translate customer experience goals into technical designs and implementation.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with OS platform, hardware, QA, and cloud services teams to deliver features end to end.
- Lead and participate in design reviews, take ownership of critical architectural decisions, and drive resolution of complex technical issues.

About the team
We own the cellular services on various devices, building the software that connects people through voice, data, and messaging every day. We work closely with OS platform teams, QA/certification, cloud services, and product management to deliver reliable connectivity experiences across diverse carrier networks and device configurations. We take ownership of the performance and reliability that users depend on for their most fundamental connectivity experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Annapurna ML Systems, Trainium
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Sr.Software Development Engineer with deep storage expertise to architect, build, and operate the high-performance storage infrastructure that accelerates silicon development at Annapurna Labs. In this role, you'll own the storage platforms—spanning Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, FSx for Lustre, and S3—that enable chip design teams to iterate faster, run regressions more efficiently, and bring transformative custom silicon to market.

Key job responsibilities
You will design, deploy, and operate high-performance storage platforms—Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP (Gen1/Gen2) and FSx for Lustre—optimized for EDA and HPC workloads. This includes managing NFS exports, ONTAP SVMs, intelligent tiering (FabricPool), snapshot policies, SnapMirror replication, and quota enforcement across multi-tenant environments. You'll deploy all storage infrastructure using AWS CDK, architect cross-VPC and multi-account solutions via Transit Gateway and Route 53 private hosted zones, enable EFA for high-throughput Lustre access, and manage data synchronization using DataSync and S3 integrations. You'll build a Storage as a Service platform with self-service provisioning, defined SLOs, cost attribution, and automated lifecycle management that enables teams to consume storage without deep specialization.
You will build monitoring and observability for storage health, utilization, and cost trends, and establish incident response processes for storage-related failures. You'll continuously evaluate and adopt new AWS storage features—Gen2 scale-out, NVMe-over-TCP, enhanced backup performance—to keep the platform at the leading edge. You'll profile I/O patterns across EDA workloads, tune file system configurations for optimal performance, and partner with silicon design and verification teams to proactively scale capacity and mentor others on storage best practices.


A day in the life
You might start your day reviewing storage utilization dashboards and tiering efficiency reports, identifying file systems approaching capacity thresholds or workloads that would benefit from tier migration. Mid-morning, you could be collaborating with a verification team to provision a new FSx for Lustre file system optimized for their regression suite—sizing it based on their I/O profiles, enabling EFA access, and deploying it through your CDK pipeline.
In the afternoon, you might be building the next iteration of your Storage as a Service platform—adding automated quota enforcement for a new team onboarding, implementing a snapshot policy that aligns with their project milestones, or extending cross-VPC access to a new account. You'll review pull requests for CDK constructs, investigate a DataSync job that stalled, and discuss FSx ONTAP Gen2 migration plans with your team.
Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate customer needs—expanding a volume for a team blocked on disk space, troubleshooting NFS mount latency—with longer-term platform investments like evaluating intelligent tiering policies or prototyping NVMe-over-TCP access patterns. You'll engage with AWS service teams on feature requests and roadmap alignment, ensuring Annapurna Labs gets the most from the storage platform.


About the team
At Annapurna Labs, your storage infrastructure work directly enables breakthrough innovations in custom silicon that power AWS and transform industries. The EDA Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the compute, storage, and networking platforms that hundreds of chip designers and verification engineers depend on daily. We offer the resources and scale of AWS with the innovation culture and technical depth of a focused silicon team.
If you're passionate about storage systems, thrive on building platforms that make complex infrastructure simple for others, and want to see your work accelerate the next generation of AWS silicon—we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS DynamoDB
jobs.description:
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. We believe it is always Day 1, and we keep improving the service and adding new capabilities.

DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed database. It delivers consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, with no servers to provision, no maintenance windows, and no downtime. Customers can create a table and scale it automatically to their most demanding workloads without having to plan capacity. During Prime Day 2026, DynamoDB handled more than 59 trillion requests over four days. It peaked at 192 million requests per second while keeping single-digit millisecond response times. The Capacity & Customer Entitlement (CCE) team builds the systems behind this. We decide how much throughput and storage each customer gets and enforce quotas and limits fairly. We also keep DynamoDB's global fleet ahead of demand. When our systems do their job, customers grow without thinking about capacity, and DynamoDB runs efficiently at any scale.

Managing capacity for one of the largest databases in the world is a hard distributed systems problem. Our systems forecast demand across every AWS Region, plan and place capacity across the fleet, and manage the limits and entitlements that decide how far each customer can scale. We prepare DynamoDB for major events such as Prime Day and new Region launches, so capacity is in place well before customers need it. We are building fully automated capacity management from the ground up. It is a greenfield opportunity to design systems that detect, predict, and act on their own. Engineers on this team solve problems where accuracy, scale, and cost all matter at the same time, and their work shapes how customers experience DynamoDB.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the services that manage DynamoDB throughput, storage, quotas, and customer entitlements at global scale.
- Build automated capacity management: demand forecasting, proactive scaling, and self-healing workflows that replace manual operations.
- Build APIs and data platforms, that give DynamoDB teams and tools accurate, real-time views of capacity and usage.
- Reduce throttling, speed up limit increases, and make large-scale fleet events safe and predictable.
- Own features end to end, from design through deployment and operation, and deliver ambiguous projects with minimal guidance.
- Take part in on-call, debug issues across services, and fix root causes so problems don't come back.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System
(DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50
locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as latency-
based routing (LBR), Private DNS, Geo DNS routing, DNS failover, and
integration with a plethora of AWS services. On top of that, we offer fast
change propagation with a 100% availability SLA. Our service is quickly
growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new services in the naming and routing space.

In the Amazon Route 53 team we like to “work backwards”: start by
understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software
engineering. We are looking for a software development engineer who is
experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands by collaborating remotely with teams. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build highly available, low-latency distributed systems that power DNS and traffic management for customers operating at global scale, handling billions of queries daily.
- Own the full software lifecycle — from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and operational support — for critical services with stringent availability and performance requirements.
- Write high-quality, maintainable code in languages such as Java, Rust, or C++, and contribute to architecture decisions that improve scalability, resiliency, and efficiency.
- Solve complex technical problems involving networking protocols, fault tolerance, and large-scale data processing, balancing trade-offs between performance, cost, and reliability.
- Mentor junior engineers, participate in code and design reviews, and raise the technical bar across the team.
- Drive operational excellence by building monitoring, automation, and tooling that reduce operational load and improve system health.
- Collaborate with product managers, senior engineers, and cross-functional partners to deliver features that delight customers.

About the team
Amazon Route 53 team works on deep, technical problems that span a
variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to
networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. Our
team has onsite and offsite engineers who collaborate remotely majority of the time. We are looking for a software development engineer who will lead the team and who feels strongly not only about building good software but also about running that software in the real world.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB
jobs.description:
Want to help shape the future of one of the largest NoSQL database services on the planet?

The Amazon DynamoDB team is looking for deeply technical, team-first-mentality full stack software engineers who are willing to commit themselves to our goal to grow the business 10 times over the next 2 years.

DynamoDB is a key-value database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

You will be responsible to maintain a high bar in terms of execution, operational readiness, code and design quality. You will serve as a mentor for junior engineers and help them grow. You are comfortable working with other seasoned DynamoDB engineers and hold your ground during design and customer experience reviews.

This is a hands-on position where you will own everything from end to end: design, design reviews, implementation, code reviews, iterative feature launches, operations, mentoring, driving continuous improvement, and more.

Key job responsibilities
Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You’ll bring a passion for innovation, data, search, analytics, and distributed systems. You’ll also:

- Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
- Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions.
- Build high-quality, secure, performant, highly available, always-on products.
- Automate and improve repetitive operational processes.
- Deep dive and continuously improve performance to deliver superior customer experience.
- Scale distributed systems with optimal balance between performance and cost.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also:
- Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
- Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
- Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
- Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About the team
About the team

Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Network Support Engineer, Leo Networking Software
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s Low Earth Orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Network Operations Center (NOC) team within Leo Networking Software is responsible for tier 1 support for software defined network services at Amazon Leo. You'll join a growing team of network operations engineers supporting Amazon Leo's global satellite network. Our services operate at scale and support workloads critical to customer network performance and availability, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.”

Key job responsibilities
- Respond to and escalate network-related incidents in a timely manner, diagnosing and troubleshooting network issues including connectivity problems, performance degradation, and security concerns.
- Support deployment and onboarding of network capabilities across geographic regions, assisting in the monitoring, testing, and reporting of new network infrastructure including satellites, gateway sites, and points of presence.
- Monitor and investigate network performance to ensure maximum efficiency and operational uptime for customers.
- Build and enhance tools, develop best practices, and refine operational procedures to measurably improve network operations.
- Manage severity 2 and 3 tickets while attending on-call rotations during business hours and weekends.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including network, software, and security engineers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
jobs.description:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day. We ship changes through automated pipelines and measure our work by the manual effort and errors we remove. We value clear writing, careful reviews, and engineers who ask why a process exists before they automate it.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

As a Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools, and systems that you need to succeed. We pride ourselves on our ability to imagine and invent solutions to problems of the future. You’ll be essential in this forward-thinking approach to development. Together with the team, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

If you’re a dedicated problem solver, this is the role for you. Identifying and overcoming challenges is at the heart of everything you do; whether it’s looking ahead to our listeners problems, or analyzing every inefficiency, you thrive when you strive for perfection. With a knowledgeable team around you, and opportunities to challenge yourself, it’s a perfect environment to develop and apply your new skills.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will...

- Develop, test, and maintain software components and applications for the world's largest audiobook creator and provider
- Identify and resolve software defects through code review, log analysis, metrics examination, debugging, and other troubleshooting methods
- Write maintainable and scalable code for software components as part of an agile engineering team
- Collaborate with stakeholders to envision, design, develop, test, and launch customer-centric software that inspires and impacts users
- Apply computer science, engineering, and analysis principles to solve moderate-scale problems
- Continuously enhance testability, operational excellence (OE), and documentation for owned software components
- Handle data classification, storage, and management in accordance with company policies
- Participate in the interview process and provide mentorship to fellow engineers

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Security Automation
jobs.description:
We are reinventing how Amazon’s builders and security engineers handle security review and issue management. The Security Automation team owns the automations and agentic experiences at the center of that work. We build new systems, integrate with existing ones, and build the services that power our agents. Our goal is to help builders and security engineers understand the security posture of a service quickly and with confidence, and to build tools that automatically fix security vulnerabilities.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you will own the design and delivery of major pieces of this work, such as the services behind our agents, new automations, and the integrations that connect them to existing systems. You will take problems that are not fully defined, design the solution, and take it to production. You will also help set the technical direction for your area and mentor other engineers on the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate features and components of agentic experiences, from requirements through production.
- Write design documents for your area, evaluate tradeoffs, and make sound decisions on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
- Build new systems and integrate with existing ones to reduce security overhead and speed up issue resolution.
- Work backwards from customers, partnering with your team and stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into well scoped solutions.
- Write high quality, well tested code, and review the code and designs of your peers.
- Take part in the on call rotation and drive operational excellence for the systems you own.
- Mentor less experienced engineers and help raise the team’s engineering bar.

A day in the life
You spend most of your time designing and building. You work through designs with your teammates, write and review code, talk with the customers who use what you build, and keep the systems you own healthy in production.

About the team
Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) helps Amazon’s builders ship software securely. Our team, Security Automation, builds the automation and agentic experiences that bring this directly to builders and security engineers, so that securing software becomes continuous and increasingly automated. We are early, we are ambitious, and we are reinventing how one of the world’s largest software organizations ships securely.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security Experiences values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. You will find endless knowledge sharing, training, and other career advancing resources here.

Work/Life Balance

We value work life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there is nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, Programming Foundations
jobs.description:
Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

This is a rare opportunity to combine deep systems-programming expertise with company-wide impact. You will evolve foundational toolchains and libraries used by nearly every service at Amazon, contribute directly to open-source projects, and guide the migration of critical workloads to Rust. If you enjoy solving complex problems in broadly distributed software stacks and want your work to make every builder at Amazon more productive, we would love to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build developer tools, compilers, libraries, and frameworks that Amazon engineers rely on daily, with a focus on advancing Rust adoption across the company.
- Lead the architectural direction for shared software components, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term extensibility, performance, and security.
- Collaborate with engineering teams across Amazon to identify pain points, define technical strategies, and deliver solutions that improve the builder experience at scale.
- Contribute to upstream open-source projects, shaping the direction of the Rust ecosystem and ensuring Amazon's toolchain stays current with industry innovations.
- Mentor engineers on your team and across the organization, raising the quality bar through code reviews, design guidance, and coaching.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a pull request for a new Rust library integration, then pair with a teammate to debug a tricky compiler issue affecting a partner team's build pipeline. After a design review with engineers from another organization, you spend focused afternoon time writing code for a toolchain improvement that will roll out to thousands of builders. Regular syncs with product and partner teams keep you connected to what engineers actually need, while dedicated blocks of solo coding time let you tackle the hardest technical problems.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Data Center Builder Tools
jobs.description:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE III) to lead the design and evolution of the real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems.

In this role you will

Own the architecture: of the real-time middleware and controls, the data-exchange layer, canonical type system, and communication patterns (publish/subscribe and request/reply) that connect distributed control applications across languages and hardware and drive it through multiple iterations as requirements scale.

Set technical strategy: for how the platform integrates with industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols (e.g. IEC 61131-3, EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus, OPC-UA, IO-Link) and how new device drivers are built, so the platform scales to many protocols without bespoke effort.

Define the edge-to-cloud contract: how telemetry, metrics, and commands flow between devices and AWS services, with the right delivery guarantees, quality-of-service, and failure semantics for each class of data.

Solve the defining hard problems: of a system where correctness means both the right result and the right timing, bounded latency, determinism, resource constraints on embedded hardware, and graceful degradation when connectivity is lost.

Multiply the team: establish engineering standards, mentor SDE I/IIs and raise the bar in hiring, reviews, and design, and align hardware, controls, security, and operations partners around a shared technical vision.

If you're excited by low-level systems, real-time data and connecting physical equipment to the cloud at scale and by being the technical leader who makes it happen this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE III on this team, you are a technical leader accountable for the architecture and long-term health of the controls and middleware platform, not just individual components. You will operate across multiple workstreams and teams, make the consequential design decisions, and remain deeply hands-on where it matters most.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Architecting the platform, not just components: owning the end-to-end design of the controls and real-time middleware across embedded/edge controllers and the cloud, making the durable decisions on type systems, serialization, memory layout, schema evolution, and communication patterns that everything else depends on.

* Driving multi-year technical strategy: defining the roadmap for the next iteration of "What comes next", industrial protocol support, and cloud integration, sequencing the work, and making explicit build-vs-buy and short-term-vs-durable tradeoffs with the data to back them.

* Owning real-time correctness at system scale: reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, determinism, and failure modes across a distributed system adjacent to physical control loops, and setting the standards that keep those guarantees intact as the system grows.

* Leading cross-team and cross-discipline efforts: turning ambiguous, org-level requirements into clear technical direction, and aligning hardware, controls, security, and operations partners (and other software teams) around shared interfaces and contracts.

* Raising the engineering bar broadly: establishing standards for testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, operational excellence, and code quality, and holding the team to them through design and code review.

* Growing engineers: mentoring Junior and Mid level SDE, developing their technical judgment, and contributing as a strong interviewer and bar raiser in hiring.

* De-risking the hardest problems: personally diving into the highest-ambiguity, highest-impact technical challenges (new protocol integrations, performance-critical paths, cross-language data exchange) and bringing them to a proven, maintainable end state.

The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer with a track record of owning the architecture of complex software systems and delivering them to production. You have depth across several of: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication and the breadth to reason about how all of these fit together into a coherent platform. You are comfortable working close to the metal (memory, concurrency, serialization, timing) and setting direction at the system and organizational level. You influence beyond your own team, make sound decisions under ambiguity and hardware/timing constraints, and lift the engineers around you. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage.

A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
The Data Center Builder Tools team develops tooling for device frameworks, and device lifecycle management in AWS Data Centers. This includes both frontend and backend services use by internal development teams and on-site customers. Our tools power the industrial controls systems deployed in our data centers.

We're looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining satellite networking software systems that solve real customer problems. In this role, you will own the technical and strategic direction of your team's products, shaping a 1–2 year roadmap while tackling complex, ambiguous challenges. If you thrive on turning customer needs into impactful software and developing the next generation of engineering talent, we'd love to hear from you.

We are focused on building scalable, reliable solutions and investing in the growth of every team member. If you're excited about leading a team that values technical excellence, thoughtful problem-solving, and continuous improvement, this is the place for you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Robotics Perception
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will lead productization across perception, localization and mapping (SLAM), navigation, and spatial memory on the robot. This software tells the robot where it is and what is around it, so planning, manipulation, and safety can act. You will partner with applied scientists to turn their research prototypes into fast, reliable production components on embedded GPUs. You will set the architecture, interfaces, and engineering standards the team builds to, and decide where models run and how they share compute. You will lead designs across science and engineering teams, and build the evaluation that shows whether a change made the robot better.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the technical direction for the robot's perception, SLAM, navigation, and spatial memory software, and lead the engineers who build it
- Own how well the robot perceives and navigates in real facilities, and drive the fixes when it falls short
- Work with applied science leaders to bring research from prototypes to production
- Make tradeoffs across the stack, such as what runs on the robot versus in the cloud and how models share limited compute
- Define how perception and mobility work with planning, manipulation, and safety, and create alignment across teams
- Build the evaluation strategy that shows robot performance improvements, and use it to set priorities with science and program partners
- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentoring, and hiring

As a Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will help our robots know where they are and get where they need to go. You will integrate them with perception, task planning, and safety, and measure how well they work on real robot data. - Partner with scientists and engineers to turn SLAM, mapping, and navigation algorithms into production on-robot components

- Build the spatial memory that records what the robot has seen and where
- Make navigation reliable alongside perception and safety, including recovering when the robot gets stuck
- Measure how well localization and navigation work on real robot data, and use that to improve them
- Make it all run in real time on the robot's embedded compute, and debug failures on real robots
- Write design docs and experiment reports that are clear about tradeoffs and limitations

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, AWS Commerce Platform, AWSBillComputationService
jobs.description:
The AWS Billing provides the back and front-end services that enable AWS customers to purchase AWS services and understand and manage their infrastructure costs. Come to join our team to tackle some of the hardest scalability, performance, and distributed computing challenges in the world. We process trillions of events per month using stream processing techniques (Kinesis), process billions of line items via map reduce (EMR), and manage artifacts through the latest in database technologies (DynamoDB and Aurora). We process big data and provide tools for customers to interactively understand their bills.

We also provide the analytics that let customers manage billions of dollars of IT usage and spending. Because we sit at the nexus of all AWS services and interact directly with end-customers, we also work closely across all AWS teams to ensure that we offer a great customer experience.

As an engineer in the team, you will design, build and operate services that will help AWS to meet the needs of our customers. Delivering a reliable and high-performance service at AWS scale requires team work of engineers with technical expertise and creativity. At Amazon, we also expect engineers like you to interact with customers, other teams, to understand our business goals, and to innovate rapidly, delivering high-quality and ground-breaking functionality.

You are creative, curious, responsible, and able to work with others to rapidly turn an idea into working code. You’re excited about writing code, implementing big ideas, and helping to coach those around you to raise the team’s bar for code quality. You want the opportunity to grow your technical and professional skills while helping AWS grow. You relish the opportunity to dig into complex operational issues and to help customers build the next generation of applications.

If you enjoy engaging in passionate discussions with smart people and letting the best ideas rise to the top while designing and building systems that can scale and solving challenging problems just push our door to know more about us

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Provisioning - Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Join our dynamic team developing satellite technology that will revolutionize provisioning software for satellite vehicles. In this critical role, you will design and implement robust software solutions that directly impact the proper functioning of satellite systems. Your expertise in problem solving and coding will be essential as you tackle complex challenges in a high-stakes environment where precision and reliability are paramount.

This position offers the unique opportunity to work with sophisticated satellite technology while developing features that ensure seamless operation of these advanced systems. You'll collaborate with a technically strong team to solve challenging problems, implement innovative solutions, and maintain critical software infrastructure that powers our satellite fleet. This role provides significant growth potential for someone with the technical aptitude and drive to advance into a Sr. Engineer position.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop software solutions for satellite vehicle systems, implementing best practices in code organization, clarity, and error handling while balancing short and long-term technical needs.

Contribute to technical architecture decisions and software development for satellite over-the-air update capabilities, ensuring high reliability, performance, and security in a mission-critical environment.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot complex support issues, triage bugs, and implement solutions that maintain operational excellence of satellite systems.

Identify and resolve root causes of persistent problems in satellite software, making existing systems simpler while maintaining robust development practices.


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
Your day begins with a team standup where you'll discuss ongoing projects and address any blockers. You'll spend time in design and implementation discussions for new satellite features, working collaboratively with your team to solve complex technical challenges. Throughout the day, you'll write and review code, triage critical bugs, and provide expert support for over-the-air update issues that require immediate attention. You'll balance proactive feature development with responsive troubleshooting, ensuring the satellite software vehicle maintains optimal performance.

About the team
Our small, tight-knit team carries significant responsibility due to the criticality of the software we own. We take pride in our technical expertise, with each member being a subject matter expert in their core competency. When pressure mounts, we support each other to ensure mission success.

Our team's work directly impacts the proper functioning of satellite vehicles, making our software development efforts crucial to mission success. We value technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, and mutual support, creating an environment where talented engineers can thrive while working on technology that matters.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Identity Analytics

We build an AI-driven analytics platform that turns 50+ PB of raw logs and metrics into proactive, actionable insights for AWS Identity leadership and core service teams — including IAM and STS. AWS teams across the organization also rely on our platform for impact analysis related to AWS Auth.

Our platform is the foundation on which everything else stands: ingesting petabyte-scale data from dozens of Identity services, transforming it into structured, queryable intelligence, and serving it reliably to the ML models, LLM agents, and dashboards that our customers act on every day.

Are you excited by the prospect of building AI-powered solutions that let stakeholders access insights without needing to understand how the underlying data is organized or connected? Do you want to work on petabyte-scale data processing, enrichment, and querying engines? Do you want to work on a platform that directly shapes how AWS Identity services evolve — influencing decisions that affect hundreds of millions of customers globally? Do you thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where your engineering work drives measurable business outcomes?

As a Software Development Engineer II on the Identity Analytics team, you will implement and optimize features across our data platform, spanning software, data management, cloud infrastructure, ML models, and AI-powered solutions. You will design and operate the ingestion, transformation, and serving pipelines that feed our ML models and LLM-powered agents. * Implement, test, and optimize features across the data platform, including software services, data management, cloud infrastructure, ML models, and AI-powered solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Parallel Computing Service, AWS PCS
jobs.description:
Are you excited about building cloud infrastructure that enables researchers, scientists, and engineers to tackle some of the world's most computationally intensive problems? The AWS High Performance Computing (HPC) team is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (Sr. SDE) to help advance the AWS Parallel Computing Service (PCS). This service allows customers to plan, schedule, and execute HPC workloads across the full range of AWS compute capabilities.

As a Sr. SDE on this team, you will define architectures and lead the design and implementation of critical components for systems that operate at global scale. You will collaborate with engineers across multiple AWS teams to influence the underlying services your customers depend on, drive software quality and engineering best practices, and help your team deliver reliable, performant solutions faster. If you thrive when priorities shift, enjoy working through ambiguity, and want your work to directly impact how customers run large-scale compute workloads in the cloud, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn more about HPC at AWS see https://aws.amazon.com/hpc/

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of complex features for PCS, ensuring systems are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
- Own your team's architectural direction, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term extensibility, and guide technology choices that shape the service roadmap.
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across AWS to define requirements, align on system interfaces, and deliver integrated solutions.
- Drive engineering best practices across the team, including code quality, testing strategies, operational excellence, and effective use of generative AI tools to improve productivity.
- Mentor and coach other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall technical bar of the team.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with leading a design review for a new component, where you work through trade-offs with your team before writing a technical design document. After lunch you could be deep in code, building a prototype that validates a new approach to workload orchestration for very large clusters. Later, you join a cross-team sync with partner AWS service teams to align on an API contract. Throughout, you balance hands-on engineering with guiding teammates on their own projects, ensuring the pieces come together into a cohesive product.

About the team
The AWS High Performance Computing team builds services that empower customers to run complex computational workloads simply and efficiently in the cloud. We work at the intersection of distributed systems, scheduling, and cloud infrastructure, serving researchers and engineers across industries who need reliable, large-scale compute.

Our team values knowledge sharing and mentorship. We maintain an inclusive environment where engineers at every experience level learn from one another through thoughtful code reviews and collaborative problem-solving. We are growing and investing in new capabilities, and this is an exciting time to help shape the future of parallel computing on AWS.
