jobs.title: SDEII Specialist GenAI Tooling, Specialist Technology Team (STT), AWS WWSO SA Field Initiatives
jobs.description:
You will own major features and services across two connected products that deliver specialist expertise to the AWS field:

- AWS Specialist Agent (ASA) – A production multi-agent system that gives field teams deep technical expertise across all AWS domains on demand. ASA is available in SpecReq, AskAWSentral, Pathfinder, Slack, Kiro, and any MCP or A2A client. It answers routine technical questions directly and escalates complex (L300+) challenges to human specialists with a pre-researched solution packet, so specialists spend their time on the highest-value customer problems.

- Specialist Knowledge Vault (KV) – An AI-first knowledge service that uses purpose-built crawlers to index specialist content from Highspot, YouTube, Broadcast, GitHub, Workshop Studio, Alchemy, and more, which removes manual consolidation. KV lets 46 Technical Field Communities (TFCs) endorse golden content, add agent steering, build reusable playbooks, and flag outdated or incorrect content, so the agent answers with the specialist point of view built in.


This is an AI-first engineering role. As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate significant parts of the platform on your own. You will solve hard problems in retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent orchestration, and LLM evaluation at AWS scale, using the AI services AWS builds for its customers. You will also help raise the engineering bar for the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and scale Knowledge Vault crawlers and ingestion pipelines that bring specialist content from internal and external sources into the vault reliably and at low cost. Make clear trade-offs on freshness, cost, and quality.

- Lead embedding, retrieval, and ranking improvements end to end, from hypothesis and experiment design through evaluation and production rollout. Measure each change against agreed quality metrics.

- Build and maintain evaluation test sets, prompts, and guardrails. Use evaluation results to decide what ships, and help define the quality bar for agent responses.

- Design APIs and MCP/A2A integrations as clean, reusable interfaces that bring ASA and KV into the tools where field teams already work.

- Drive operational excellence for the services you own: define monitoring and alarming, lead incident response during on-call, fix root causes, and run COE and metrics reviews. Leave the software easier to maintain than you found it.

- Work with Product Management, Applied Science, and TFC stakeholders to turn ambiguous field problems into well-scoped projects. Balance customer needs with team priorities.

- Raise the team's bar through thorough code reviews and design reviews. Mentor and onboard SDE Is and new team members, and take part in recruiting and interviewing.

A day in the life
You start the day with a standup, where you share progress, flag risks, and unblock teammates. You spend a focused block building a new retrieval or agent capability that you designed, then review a teammate's code and give feedback that helps them grow. You might set up an evaluation run to confirm that a ranking change improves answer quality before you roll it out, or meet with a product manager and a TFC lead to scope a new field request into a set of tasks. Later you walk the team through your design doc and work through the open trade-offs. On your on-call weeks, you handle alarms, lead the fix for the root cause, and turn what you learn into operational improvements.

About the team
We are engineers, applied scientists, and product managers. Engineers own their services from design through on-call. SDE IIs act as technical owners of major components and help senior engineers set the team's technical direction.

Our tenets:

- Meet customers where they work.
- Help specialists do more, not replace them.
- Build every integration as a clean API.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Leo Telemetry Platform
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This role is for a Software Engineer who will design, implement, and operate globally distributed systems that enable Leo to achieve low single-digit-second query responses within a near real-time analytics layer or lakehouse, and to support agentic AI capabilities on top. You’ll build these systems using the latest AWS technologies and best-in-industry software engineering practices.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Architect and implement a scalable, cost-optimized S3-based Data Lakehouse that unifies structured and unstructured data from disparate sources.
- Architect and implement a scalable, cost-performance-optimized OLAP-based analytics layer
- Establish metadata management with automated data classification and lineage tracking.
- Design and enforce standardized data ingestion patterns with built-in quality controls and validation gates.
- Architect a centralized metrics repository that becomes the source of truth for all Leo metrics.
- Implement robust data quality frameworks with staging-first policies and automated validation pipelines.
- Design extensible metrics schemas that support complex analytical queries while optimizing for AI retrieval patterns.
- Develop intelligent orchestration for metrics generation workflows with comprehensive audit trails.
- Lead the design of semantic data models that balance analytical performance with AI retrieval requirements.
- Implement cross-domain federated query capabilities with sophisticated query optimization techniques.
- Architect a globally distributed vector database infrastructure capable of managing billions of embeddings with consistent sub-100ms retrieval times.
- Design and implement hybrid search strategies combining dense vectors with sparse representations for optimal semantic retrieval.
- Establish automated compliance validation frameworks ensuring data handling meets Amazon's security standards.

A day in the life
This role is for a Software Development Engineer who will build new cloud services and APIs that facilitate and orchestrate the Leo AI Foundations—enabling intelligent software operation across Leo devices such as satellites, ground gateways, and customer terminals. You will design and deliver low-latency, highly scalable architectures that are critical to providing high-quality internet service and AI capabilities to customers.

About the team
Leo AI Foundations builds the intelligent cloud backbone that powers AI-driven decision making across Amazon’s Leo constellation — from satellites and ground gateways to customer terminals. Our team designs and operates large-scale data and compute systems that enable training, inference, and agentic intelligence for optimizing network performance, routing, and user experience in real time. We combine expertise in distributed systems, data lakehouse architectures, and applied machine learning to deliver scalable, low-latency AI capabilities that integrate seamlessly with Leo's software-defined space and ground systems. We move fast, innovate boldly, and work across boundaries to make global connectivity smarter and more efficient.

Our team partners across Amazon’s Consumer and Digital business units to build, monitor, and protect a secure environment for the Amazon business. Designing, developing, and operating key system products and services leveraging AI
Ensuring designs align with the organizational and product architectures

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, OpenSearch Platform Team
jobs.description:
Amazon OpenSearch Service powers search, log analytics, observability, and vector workloads for tens of thousands of customers. Every one of those customers runs on software that our Data Plane Platform team ships, and keeping it current means updating and managing software updates across millions of instances at scale, safely and continuously. We own the release engine for the managed OpenSearch data plane: the pipelines, the automation, and the self-service release platform that take an upstream open source cut all the way to GA across every supported version and region.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us turn releasing OpenSearch from a hand-coordinated effort into a fully automated, self-service platform. The team has already sharply reduced release cycle time, increased release throughput, consolidated its pipelines, and driven per-engineer release effort close to zero. You will build pieces of that system: the tooling, orchestration, and AI-assisted automation that let teams release safely with less manual effort.

This is a hands-on builder role at the intersection of distributed systems, CI/CD, and developer experience, with a strong and growing emphasis on AI. You will own well-scoped components end to end, from design through operations, with mentorship from senior engineers on the team, and you will have real opportunity to apply AI and agentic automation to real release problems. The code you ship becomes part of the paved road the OpenSearch organization releases on.

Key job responsibilities
Build and operate the services, pipelines, and automation that update and manage software updates across millions of instances at scale, safely and continuously, across many versions and regions.
Build and extend the self-service release platform so builders across the organization can ship features quickly and reliably.
Improve release safety with staged rollouts, automated validation, rollback, and blast-radius controls so a bad change does not reach customers at scale.
Apply AI and agentic automation to the parts of releasing that still require manual effort today.
Own the operations of what you build: on-call, runbooks, metrics, and reducing operational load over time.
Partner with the engineering teams who build and release on top of your platform.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Border Network Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building systems that keep one of the world's largest networks running? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a team that builds traffic engineering and fast-reroute solutions for the AWS global backbone network — the infrastructure behind S3, EC2, Direct Connect, and every AWS service.

In this role, you'll design and build software that detects congestion and failures across 400+ global sites and automatically reroutes traffic to healthier paths. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems and networking, solving problems that directly impact the reliability and performance of AWS for millions of customers.

You'll be part of a hybrid team of software, systems development, and network engineers across the US and Australia. This position is based in Seattle and sits at the heart of AWS global networking.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain software services that steer traffic across the AWS global backbone network
- Develop and extend traffic engineering controllers that detect congestion and failures in real time and automatically reroute traffic to healthier paths
- Write clean, well-tested code in a production environment where availability directly impacts AWS customers
- Contribute to system design discussions — from API design to data modelling to choosing the right trade-offs for scale and reliability
- Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and automation tooling to give the team better visibility into network health
- Collaborate with network engineers, systems engineers, and partner teams to translate operational needs into software solutions
- Participate in code reviews, providing thoughtful and constructive feedback to teammates
- Participate in on-call rotations (typically one week every two months), working with the team to resolve issues and fix root causes
- Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve existing systems and processes

A day in the life
You'll spend most of your time building software that gives us visibility and control over traffic across the AWS backbone. On any given day you might be designing a new feature, reviewing a teammate's code, or debugging issues. You'll work closely with network engineers and partner teams — a lot of what you build is about detecting problems and mitigating them before customers notice. Beyond coding, you'll join design discussions and on-call rotations. The work mixes building new things with keeping existing systems reliable at massive scale.

About the team
We build the systems that keep traffic flowing across the AWS global backbone — connecting every region and edge location worldwide. Our network grows ~70% year-on-year, so the problems we solve constantly evolve. The team is distributed across the US, Canada and Australia, and this role is based in Sydney. We have a broad mix of experience levels and backgrounds, and we genuinely value mentorship and knowledge sharing. What matters most is curiosity and a willingness to solve hard problems.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Edgelink ML, Amazon Traffic Engineering

Streaming applications deliver live data to downstream detection, mitigation, and traffic insight systems, where latency is measured in seconds, not hours. You will own the data those real-time decisions depend on, and your work will show up quickly in how teams resolve real incidents. You will make queries over huge datasets dramatically faster and build the self-serve interface that lets teams investigate traffic patterns on their own. The platform is young, so you will have real say in architecture and direction while solving hard problems in ingestion, data quality, and low-latency delivery.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and ship streaming pipelines and telemetry features for real-time ingestion and observability at scale.
- Optimize and speed up data queries over large datasets through better data layout, partitioning, and query design.
- Build a self-serve interface that lets teams investigate traffic patterns without needing engineering help.
- Build data solutions that make edge systems easier to see, understand, and operate.
- Automate away toil and expand self-serve data query capabilities.
- Power insight reports that help teams triage availability issues and abuse incidents fast.
- Write clean, maintainable code that keeps the platform stable.
- Partner with other teams to bring in new telemetry sources and delight customers.
- Join the on-call rotation to keep the platform available 24x7.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Robotics
jobs.description:
The Amazon Robotics Pack team builds the software and robotic systems that pack nearly every customer order Amazon ships. Our work is on the critical path: when a pack machine or station goes down, shipments stop. We run thousands of machines, stations and robotic workcells across hundreds of fulfillment centers on several continents. Each one has to perform reliably every shift, for both the associates who work alongside it and the customers waiting on their orders.

To do that at scale, we're building physical AI that runs at the edge: software that sees, reasons and acts on the machine itself, in real time. Computer vision and machine learning on edge compute verify items, select the right box and catch defects before a package leaves the station. The same systems watch the machines themselves. They track throughput, jam rates, sensor and actuator signals, and vision-model accuracy, so we know which machines are healthy, which are degrading and why.

When something goes wrong, our systems should spot it first, diagnose it and guide the fix. That means turning machine telemetry into clear, step-by-step guidance for associates and Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) technicians, so they can restore a machine in minutes instead of hours. Every failure feeds back into our models and designs, so a fault fixed once at one site helps prevent it at every site. The hard part is doing this across a large, mixed fleet, with low latency on the floor and consistent quality everywhere.

A day in the life
1) Lead, hire and grow a team of software engineers
2) Own the roadmap for software that runs pack machines, stations and robotic workcells
3) Integrate computer vision, sensors and robotics into reliable real-time systems
4) Turn every failure into fleet-wide improvements to models, designs and runbooks
5) Solve optimization problems in packaging selection, workload balancing and throughput
6) Drive operational excellence: safe deployments, fast mitigation, root-cause COEs
7) Launch new robotics and automation into live fulfillment sites
8) Work backwards from associates, RME, site leaders and end customers
Influence partner teams across hardware, science, operations and product

About the team
Our team knows fulfillment end to end. We understand how an order moves through Amazon's network around the world, from inbound to the moment a package leaves the building. That broad view lets us make good decisions quickly and see how a change at one pack station affects the rest of the network.

We have a strong bias for action, backed by mechanisms that keep us focused on delivering. We don't let obstacles stop us. When we hit a blocker, we treat it as something to learn from, work through it and keep moving. That's the attitude we bring every day: we get results, whatever the challenge.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, EC2 Instance Networking
jobs.description:
Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in-house.

This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale - training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high-performance interfaces, low-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build.

You'll write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time
embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and
software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and mentor junior engineers on impactful and challenging projects
- Design and implement data plane networking software on custom hardware, working across the full software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations
- Build and improve network virtualization systems that deliver VPC connectivity, security policy enforcement, and performance isolation for EC2 customers
- Investigate and resolve complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
- Collaborate with partner teams across hardware, control plane, and ML platforms to deliver end-to-end solutions

Our team is looking for passionate, experienced software developer who can deliver high quality platform solutions to support our customers (buyers and merchants) enabling "Amazon Pay" to scale as the universal wallet for all of Amazon buyers.

As an engineer in Amazon Pay, you will be part of a dynamic team working on complex problems innovating on behalf of our customers. As an SDE II, you will play a key role in building a world-class, frictionless payments solution and merchant experience that helps us scale while retaining customer and merchant trust.

This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technology teams, working alongside some of the industry's top engineers. You will have access to mentoring programs, regular tech talks with principal engineers, and opportunities to develop your skills and advance your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.

If you're passionate about building transformative payment solutions that enable merchants and delight customers, we encourage you to apply.

Come join us as we work hard, have Fun and make History!


Key job responsibilities
- Deliver high-quality platform solutions supporting diverse customer and merchant use cases for Amazon Pay
- Develop and enhance web-based applications and web services that enable third-party merchants to integrate Amazon Pay
- Design and build large-scale, distributed systems to handle high-volume transactions in a 24/7 environment
- Contribute to the architecture, design, and evolution of new and existing systems focusing on reliability, scalability, and performance

About the team
AmazonPay, one of the fastest growing businesses of Amazon, enables e-commerce websites to accept, and customers to utilise the payment information stored in their Amazon.com accounts to pay for goods and services at sites off-Amazon. We develop software at every level of the stack from front-end user interfaces to backend server software and everything in between.

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Amazon Connect
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Want to disrupt an industry by delighting customers? Looking for a job where your work can have direct and massive impact? Excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services? Come be a leader on a team that is building a product that will touch millions of people daily.

Amazon Connect Customer is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect Customer is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect Customer, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect Customer leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Software Development Engineers to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

Industry analysts have said, “Amazon Connect Customer is quietly positioned to massively disrupt by enabling companies to focus on customer service, not service centers.” and “Amazon is totally disrupting the customer contact center space as they have many other market-spaces with customer-centric solutions with open platform integration with assistance from the partner community.”

About the team
ABOUT AWS:
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Direct Connect
jobs.description:
Do you want to build the software that connects the world's largest enterprises to the AWS cloud? Would you like to own distributed systems that keep a global network running, and use AI to change how that network is operated?

The AWS Direct Connect team delivers solutions that make it easy for customers to establish a dedicated network connection from their premises to the AWS cloud. AWS Direct Connect is available in more than 150 locations across more than 45 countries, and it connects AWS to our largest customers in data centers around the world.

We are building a new software engineering team in Dublin, working side by side with the Direct Connect network engineering team in the same office. You will build and operate the systems that keep Direct Connect customers healthy: data pipelines that analyze network traffic at scale to spot when a customer's traffic is degraded, services that identify which customers are impacted by a network event and keep them informed, and AI agents that automate how engineers handle operational tickets. Your work will help us find and resolve customer issues faster, and free engineers from repetitive operational work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate services and asynchronous workflows across all AWS regions and Direct Connect locations.
- Build data processing, monitoring services, and automation that help us detect customer impact during events and resolve it faster.
- Troubleshoot and root-cause customer-impacting issues, and drive deep dives and corrective actions to completion.
- Partner with network development engineers to automate repeatable operational work, using AI-assisted development and agent-driven workflows.
- Write and review design documents, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might root-cause a customer-reported issue that spans our services and the network, whiteboard a workflow design with a senior engineer, or pair with a network engineer to automate a task they do by hand today. You'll collaborate with software and network engineers in Dublin and the US on system design. On-call rotations give you direct exposure to how your services and the network behave in production at AWS scale. Expect a mix of heads-down building and collaborative design sessions.

About the team
We prioritize availability and invest heavily in deployment safety and monitoring. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint at our scale, so engineers have the autonomy to drive technical decisions and own the results. We favor automation over manual work, are early adopters of AI in our development and operations, and value clear, peer-reviewed documentation for our technical decisions.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, MADS
jobs.description:
Build the attribution systems that connect ad interactions with real customer outcomes. You'll process more than 50 billion events per day to produce the measurements that power experiences across all of Amazon Ads and help millions of advertisers understand the true value of their campaigns. Attribution is at the heart of advertising measurement, and your work will directly influence how advertising budgets are optimized at global scale.

Accurate attribution at Amazon scale is one of the hardest engineering problems in advertising. Our systems connect signals across advertising products, customer journeys, devices, channels and conversion sources. That means solving problems in massive-scale data processing, distributed systems, identity and signal fragmentation, evolving privacy requirements and complex attribution methodologies. The measurements we produce are foundational signals for reporting, campaign optimization, machine learning models, analytics applications and emerging AI-powered advertising experiences.

What Makes This Role Stand Out

- 50B+ events per day: petabyte-scale data pipelines using Spark, EMR, Apache Iceberg, DynamoDB and other AWS services
- Engineering meets science: work directly with applied scientists and economists to turn new measurement methodologies into scalable production systems
- End-to-end ownership: take an ambiguous measurement problem through design, implementation, launch and operations
- Direct business impact: the data you produce helps millions of advertisers make better investment decisions and powers optimization across Amazon's full advertising suite
- Build new, not just maintain: design new architectures that improve scalability, data freshness, correctness, reliability and cost efficiency

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop and deliver software that produces measurement data used across Amazon's full advertising suite, including display, search, native and video
- Build and maintain petabyte-scale data pipelines and services using Spark, EMR, Apache Iceberg and Java, developing new big data approaches to keep pace with rapid growth
- Solve complex attribution challenges as technical requirements, privacy rules and priorities change
- Collaborate with applied scientists, economists, product managers and engineers across teams to turn measurement methodologies into scalable production systems
- Apply a range of architectural approaches and design patterns to deliver maintainable, scalable, well-tested solutions in a high-throughput environment
- Contribute to technical design discussions, identify tradeoffs and propose solutions that balance performance, cost and long-term maintainability
- Uphold engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing strategies and operational excellence (alarms, runbooks, monitoring), and mentor peers through design and code reviews

About the team
The Measurement, AdTech, and Data Science (MADS) team defines and produces the metrics advertisers rely on to analyze the performance of their ad investments. Our charter covers the systems that compute and distribute estimated conversions at massive scale. We work across a rich technology stack, combining AWS services like EMR, Kinesis and AWS Batch with open-source technologies such as Spark and Presto, to deliver fast, reliable measurement at the speed advertisers demand.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 Capacity Telemetry and Autonomous Systems
jobs.description:
The EC2 Capacity Telemetry and Autonomous Systems team is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join our Seattle-based team. EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud) is part of Amazon Web Services, the global leader in public cloud infrastructure.

We build the systems that measure what EC2's capacity is doing in real time — what exists, what is in use, what is reserved, and where demand is going unmet — detect when any of it moves, establish why, and increasingly act on it without a person in the loop.

We sit within a group of software engineers and scientists who build the forecasting algorithms and modeling systems that determine how EC2 is built and packed, so that capacity is maximally utilized and maximally available through automated capacity planning and optimization. Those models run on what our systems measure, and the decisions they produce are executed by software we own.

This is a software engineering team at the crossroads of writing our own systems and operating the best of open source. We design and run distributed services with real availability and latency commitments. We build low-latency query and serving layers on engines such as Apache Druid, ClickHouse and Apache Pinot, and extend them where our workload outgrows what they do out of the box. We write optimization and decision engines that replace work people were doing by hand. We build APIs that other services depend on, and the React web applications that operators and planners run their day from. And we build agentic systems on top of all of it, so a problem gets diagnosed and resolved by software rather than escalated to a human with a chart attached.

The work is operationally real. Our consumers are live systems, and ours matter most at exactly the moments something else is going wrong, so availability is a design constraint here rather than something handled after launch.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, launch and operate production services end to end — you will write the design document, make the trade-offs, defend them in review, and own what you shipped
- Build high-throughput distributed systems that operate under real latency and availability commitments, and the query and serving layers behind them
- Build real-time detection and alerting that tells an operator what changed and why it matters, rather than requiring them to know what to look for first
- Build rules and decision engines that replace large-scale manual workflows with software
- Build optimization systems that return the best available answer within a fixed time budget, degrading to a simpler strategy rather than failing
- Build and extend the APIs other services depend on, and the React web applications our operators and planners work in
- Build agentic systems that investigate a problem, determine the cause, recommend a course of action and increasingly take it
- Raise the operational bar on what you own: monitoring, alarming, recovery paths and the tests that span service boundaries

A day in the life
Your day is a mix of building and deciding. A typical week has you deep in implementation on a service you own, in a design review arguing about someone else's, and in a conversation with the people who depend on what you build.

Your closest collaborators are the engineers and scientists who build the forecasting and optimization models next to you — they need what your systems produce, and what they produce has to land in systems you operate. Beyond the immediate team you will work with capacity planners and operators who make decisions from the software you build, with partner service teams whose systems you integrate with and occasionally contribute code to directly, and with the leadership who review the operational numbers your systems generate.

You will be expected to take on ambiguous problems and work independently, making business and technical trade-offs to deliver results — with support from teammates who will answer questions and work through day-to-day problems with you. Where no established pattern exists, we evaluate options, choose one, and write down why.

You will be a fully participating team member in daily stand-ups, design review sessions, demos, code reviews and other team gatherings. This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically one week every two months. We build fault-tolerant systems to minimize being paged during off-hours, and when we are paged we root-cause and fix so the same page does not come back.

About the team
Our mission is that EC2 capacity is maximally available and maximally utilized, managed autonomously rather than by hand. Every system we build moves work from a person to software and then makes that software accountable for the outcome.

We set tenets and target outcomes before a design exists, then build against them and settle the trade-offs in review. Design, implementation, prototyping, security review and documentation rotate across the team, so no system has a single point of knowledge and engineers end a year with more range than they began it.

We are invested in your growth. We assign projects that balance what the business needs against what will make each engineer more capable of owning something larger next time. As an experienced engineer you will have opportunities to mentor while working alongside senior and principal engineers across the organization. As a team, we enjoy connecting socially while respecting the balance between work and personal life.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer I, Inference models optimization, AWS Neuron Inference
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer I, you will design and implement business-critical features and contribute to optimizing the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like GLM, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

If this sounds exciting to you - come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
* Optimize open models to run best on Trainium, including optimizing sharding, developing NKI kernels and ensuring accuracy. This provides ready-to-serve models to our customers and also gives them a starting point to optimize their own.
* Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams that may include hardware design, firmware, compiler, runtime, and ML engineers to develop software that enables and optimizes custom ML accelerator silicon
* Write clean, maintainable code (C/C++, Python, or Rust) following best practices for systems-level and performance-critical development
* Participate in code reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and help deploy agentic tools to accelerate the enablement of new models on Trainium
* Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, debugging, and resolving issues across hardware-software integration boundaries, including on-call responsibilities
* Keep learning emerging technologies in ML accelerators, compiler optimization, computer architecture, and cloud-scale distributed systems

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning.
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.
Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others.
We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the agentic system that automatically improves campaigns for millions of Amazon advertisers. The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) auto-optimization framework uses LLM-based agents, together with auction simulation, ML models and optimization algorithms, to decide what to change, apply the change within limits the advertiser sets, measure the results and learn from them. You'll own the architecture and production systems behind this loop, and because the system spends advertiser money automatically, you'll also set its safety standards.

You'll lead the design and delivery of the core services: the agent execution engine and tool orchestration, the action layer that writes changes to live campaigns, evaluation and experimentation pipelines, model serving and tuning infrastructure, and monitoring. You'll work with applied scientists to turn prototype agent capabilities into production systems that run reliably across millions of campaigns. You'll also partner with science, product and operations to improve the agent architecture, success metrics and tuning loops. You'll work backwards from advertisers: every infrastructure decision should make optimization more effective, safer, or easier for advertisers to understand and trust.

What Makes This Role Stand Out
- Agents that act, not just advise: the system makes real changes to live campaigns, so it demands real production engineering
- 1.6MM advertisers: small gains in decision quality have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon's retail ecosystem
- Current agent stack: tool orchestration (including MCP), reasoning frameworks, RL fine-tuning and preference optimization
- Safety by design: spend limits, rollback, audit trails and automatic safeguards are core to the architecture

Key job responsibilities
- Own the auto-optimization platform's architecture and drive its engineering roadmap with engineering, science and product leaders
- Build the agent execution engine, covering orchestration, tool invocation, state management and scheduling across millions of campaigns
- Build the action layer that applies agent changes to live campaigns, with spend limits, advertiser controls, conflict handling, rollback and a full audit trail
- Set the safety standards for automated optimization, including observability, drift detection and automatic safeguards that pause optimization when outcomes get worse
- Build offline and online evaluation (simulation, A/B tests, holdouts) to measure decision quality, safety and incremental advertiser impact
- Build a reusable registry of tools and data (auction simulation, ML models, optimizers, campaign data), and integrate tuning pipelines (RL fine-tuning, preference optimization) with interfaces that let scientists version, roll out and roll back models
- Prototype new system designs and agent patterns, use data to decide which go to production, and meet latency, availability and cost targets, including LLM inference cost per advertiser
- Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, help with hiring, and own operations (on-call, COEs)

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

This team within SPB guides and supports 1.6MM advertisers in creating and managing their ad campaigns. At this scale, the variety of advertiser goals, campaign types and market dynamics is a huge technical challenge and also a big opportunity: even small improvements in guidance systems can have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon's retail ecosystem. Our vision is an agentic auto-optimization system that understands each advertiser and keeps improving their campaigns. It combines LLMs with auction simulation, ML models and optimization algorithms. Advertisers stay in control: they choose the instruction to execute and its limits, see what changed and why, and can step in at any time. We work with Ad Console, Sales and Marketing to find where optimization adds the most value, from campaign structure down to individual keyword bids. Our work builds on current agent architectures, tool integration (including MCP), reasoning frameworks, and model customization through tuning and preference optimization.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Managed Rendering for App
jobs.description:
Amazon's Store Authoring Foundations team is looking for a passionate, experienced software developer to help build the next generation of mobile shopping experiences on the Amazon Shopping app.

You'll work on the server-driven UI framework and mobile runtime that power dynamic experiences for hundreds of millions of shoppers on iOS and Android. Our technology enables thousands of Store builders across Amazon to author, deploy, and iterate on shopping experiences without app updates, combining native performance with the velocity of server-driven rendering. You'll design and build systems that span React Native, native iOS/Android, and backend services, operating at a scale where milliseconds of latency and fractions of a percent in error rates translate to millions of customer interactions.

The ideal candidate is passionate about mobile performance, reactive architectures, and building developer platforms that multiply the productivity of other engineers. This person has thrived in delivering high-quality, cross-platform solutions in a fast-paced environment and is energized by the challenge of balancing reliability at massive scale with rapid feature delivery. If you want to work on foundational infrastructure that directly shapes how customers experience Amazon on their phones, and see your impact in real-time metrics serving real shoppers, we'd love to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile infrastructure using React Native, Swift/Objective-C, and Kotlin that serves hundreds of millions of shoppers
- Build and optimize server-driven rendering pipelines that enable dynamic UI experiences without requiring app updates
- Own the full development lifecycle for features spanning native mobile clients, JavaScript runtime layers, and backend services
- Improve performance and reliability of the mobile rendering stack, including bundle loading, data fetching, and rendering prioritization
- Collaborate with partner teams to define and evolve bridge APIs, data contracts, and plugin interfaces that thousands of internal builders depend on
- Instrument, monitor, and respond to production metrics, driving down latency and error rates through data-driven iteration
- Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence practices for tier-1 mobile infrastructure
- Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance
- Contribute to technical roadmap planning, identifying opportunities to reduce complexity, eliminate tech debt, and improve developer experience for internal customers

A day in the life
This role is AI-native. You are expected to use AI tooling daily to accelerate development, code review, and problem-solving. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Amazon MSK, Managed Streaming for Kafka
jobs.description:
Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!

We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.

As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire core data plane stack that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of an AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate has experience designing large-scale systems supporting millions of transactions per second, enjoys solving complex software problems, and possesses analytical, design and problem-solving skills. Ideally you have an in-depth understanding of streaming data technologies like Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka, and experience with open-source data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Apache Storm. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with other engineers to build a large scale AWS service, and work with senior leaders to define your team's roadmap, including identifying design and code changes needed in the underlying open source platforms.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, Resilience Infrastruction and Solutions: Incident Mitigation
jobs.description:
At AWS, resilience is a promise to our customers: that their workloads keep running even when part of the cloud doesn't. The Resilience Infrastructure and Solutions (RIS) organization makes good on that promise, driving higher availability for AWS customers through fewer and shorter operational events. We build the services and programs that detect, mitigate, and recover from failures, from a single impaired Availability Zone to a full Region. When something goes wrong at cloud scale, our systems are what move customer traffic out of harm's way, often in under a minute, before most people notice anything happened.

You'll join a team of software engineers, product and program managers, and resilience specialists who work across AWS to raise the bar on availability. You'll partner with foundational services that depend on us as their default mitigation path, and you'll help customers protect workloads they can't afford to have go down. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Incident Mitigation team is looking for an experienced software engineer excited about building large-scale distributed systems that protect hundreds of thousands of customer resources across every AWS Region. You'll own the design and development of significant components of our mission-critical control and data planes, where correctness, speed, and scale are non-negotiable, since the moment they're needed most is during an active event. The work spans cross-service integrations with ELB, S3, EKS, DynamoDB, EC2, and other foundational services, and demands strong judgment in fault-tolerant and distributed systems design.

In this hands-on role you'll do everything from building rock-solid components to anticipating failure modes in design reviews to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a strong software developer with a track record of delivering, but someone who excels in communication, technical leadership, and customer focus. You'll help shape the technology and the direction of a growing, high-impact space inside AWS, writing high-quality code that measurably improves availability for every AWS customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of software systems spanning multiple features across the full development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are well-architected, extensible, and maintainable.
- Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, and maintainability, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, technical program managers, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, align on system design, and deliver integrated solutions.
- Coach and mentor engineers on your team and across related teams, driving adoption of engineering best practices and raising the quality bar for code organization, clarity, and documentation.
- Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems and reduce technical debt, leveraging generative AI tools and industry innovations where appropriate to improve team productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing design documents and code reviews, providing guidance that helps your teammates ship high-quality software. You might then dive into a complex system design challenge, weighing trade-offs with partner teams before writing code for a critical component. Afternoons could include mentoring a fellow engineer, prototyping a new approach using generative AI tools, or leading a discussion on operational improvements. Your work will balance hands-on coding with architectural leadership, giving you the chance to shape both the technical direction and the culture of your team.

About the team
Our team is focused on building software that customers rely on every day. We value collaboration, pragmatism, and a commitment to quality that shows up in everything we build. You will work alongside talented engineers who are eager to learn from each other and solve meaningful problems together. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for someone who will help define our technical roadmap for the years ahead. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas shape the future of our products, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Ads AI Core Infra
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about developing real-time, distributed, large-scale services? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that makes advertising and it's functions automated and frictionless? Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Engineering team? Then, our Software Development team wants you! We are expanding the Ads Engineering function in Melbourne. So do you want to work for a start up in one of the worlds biggest companies?

Come join us as an SDE!

Amazon Advertising is looking for a Software Development Engineer who shares Amazon Advertising’s passion for building and delivering a global, scalable, extensible, and secure services to support advertisers.

You'll become part of a highly motivated team of talented multi-functional builders (front and backend developers) who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. Your team will support the global technology roadmap for our Advertising AI Core Infra technology teams. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that, haven’t been solved at scale before - anywhere. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for self-motivated engineers who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of teamwork, and want to have fun while they make history and collaborate on beautiful products.

A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, and a history of delivering high quality code to solve complex business problems. Written and verbal communication in this role are critical: you will author narratives that will be consumed by Amazonians at all levels.

Key Technical Challenges:
Distributed and Scalable Architecture: The global Ads Availability team owns Tier 1 critical service infrastructure that forms the backbone of Ad serving. We have enabled this service infrastructure across multiple regions and Availability Zones.

High Availability: This role will provide critical support to the Global Ads Availability team that owns a key Ads wide Availability framework. It is critical to ensure that this framework remains highly available. High Availability architecture will help us make sure that the system is configured to handle different loads and different failures with minimal or no downtime.

Security is at the heart of all operations. This role will collaborate with Global teams to ensure Advertising services remain highly secure.

Key job responsibilities
• Business problem is defined. Technology strategy may not be defined.
• Delivers independently, with limited guidance.
• Solves complex software problems. Solutions are extensible and scale. Removes bottlenecks. Makes trade-offs: short-term vs. long-term technical decisions.
• Designs, develops, tests, and deploys software.
• Lead large projects. Knows how to divide so they can work in parallel with other SDEs and reassemble into a cohesive launch.
• 100% AWS Technologies

A day in the life
Your day begins with a quick team stand-up to align on priorities before diving into coding tasks. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with experienced Amazonians across disciplines, working on designing and building innovative technologies in our large distributed computing environment. You'll participate in code reviews, contribute to technical discussions, and help solve complex problems while working in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

About the team
Our growing team in Melbourne is passionate about solving business challenges through innovative technology. We hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers, focusing intensely on their needs in everything we do.

The challenges we solve are significant and impact millions of customers, advertisers, and products globally. We're looking for individuals excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity in an environment where ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years. Our team values collaboration and supports new members with knowledge-sharing and mentorship opportunities.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Customer Experience and Business Trends
jobs.description:
Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization is seeking a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to shape the future of Amazon Web Services (AWS) customer experience by improving service performance. Do you want to help improve the customer experience and performance of AWS core infrastructure, including Storage and Networking? We're seeking a performance-obsessed SDE to enable Amazon Benchmarking to deliver industry-leading performance insights and improvements across our entire service portfolio.

This role is tasked with enhancing a complex multi-cloud framework to orchestrate, run, and analyze performance benchmarking workloads. This infrastructure is used to measure AWS service performance, conducting comprehensive analyses that drive critical business decisions at the CEO/SVP level and help guide teams in delivering the best cloud services in the industry. The primary deliverables are the infrastructure and automation required to accelerate, simplify, and make efficient deep-dive performance investigations that identify recommendations to influence product direction across multiple AWS services.

This role requires exceptional software development skills and a passion for distributed system performance and statistics. The candidate will excel at simplifying complex systems for use across multiple stakeholders with diverse backgrounds. The ideal candidate has knowledge of containers, AWS services, and building Python libraries. This role will build tools to investigate performance bottlenecks while maintaining the highest standards of technical rigor and objectivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build infrastructure and automation to execute performance benchmarks across AWS services
- Own benchmark lifecycle from scoping, to execution, to delivery of findings and recommendations to AWS leadership
- Work with stakeholders across service teams to define customer-critical performance metrics
- Analyze results and create recommendations that directly impact AWS service improvements
- Collaborate with multiple teams to continuously raise the bar on AWS service performance

A day in the life
You will be working with a unique team that works across multiple core AWS services. You will build automation and performance benchmarks to study, explore, and improve the performance of AWS services. Your great detective skills will be exercised on a daily basis to dive deep into details of the performance of complex services. You should be comfortable collaborating in a fast-paced and uncertain environment, and contributing to innovative solutions, while demonstrating leadership. You should also be comfortable collaborating regularly and making recommendations with multiple levels of the team from development engineers to service team leadership. You achieve this by regularly working with multiple PEs and PMs across different AWS services. You are a true owner and will operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product. On a monthly basis team member studies are presented to the highest levels of AWS leadership.

About the team
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).

Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds – including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solutions Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.

With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?

With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a career that evolves as you do

We will take your location preferences into consideration. Preferences are based on business availability and are not guaranteed. Applicants will be considered at all locations in the United States including but not limited to:

- WA (Redmond)

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.

Conduct code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.

Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work.

Requirements

• You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery
• You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software.
• Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems
We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption
• Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision
• Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team
• Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices
• Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: SDE (Rust or C/C++) , Device Cloud Core Services
jobs.description:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

Join Device Cloud Core Services (DCCS), the team building the foundational platform that powers millions of Amazon devices worldwide. We create critical customer experiences, from the moment a customer unboxes their device to every interaction after that. Our engineers work across the full technology stack, from backend web services and mobile SDKs to device software, and solve hard problems in device onboarding, connectivity, enterprise device management, and data synchronization. In this role you will help build Aries, Amazon's platform for managing and securing Amazon devices for enterprise customers. If you like building scalable, reliable systems that change how customers and businesses use Amazon devices, from Echo to Kindle to Ring, this is your chance to shape the future of connected devices at Amazon scale.

Core Technical Requirements:

- Strong programming skills in Rust or C/C++
- Experience building integrations across device software and backend services
- Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and service integration
- Familiarity with device management, security, or compliance concepts is a plus
- Ability to write efficient, secure, and maintainable code

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain on-device software for Amazon's enterprise device management platform (Aries)
- Develop integrations between on-device agents and backend management services
- Implement device policy, compliance, and security capabilities for enterprise customers
- Work across the device and cloud boundary to deliver reliable, scalable enterprise features
- Partner with platform, security, and product teams to land features end to end

A day in the life
As an SDE on the Aries enterprise device management team, you'll build and maintain the on-device software that lets Amazon manage devices for enterprise customers. Daily activities include developing integrations between on-device agents and backend management services, implementing device policy, compliance, and security capabilities, and debugging across the device and cloud boundary. You'll collaborate with platform, security, and product partners to land features end to end, and work with teams across Amazon's device portfolio. Success means delivering reliable, scalable enterprise management capabilities that customers can trust to control and secure their fleets at scale.

About the team
The Aries team builds Amazon's enterprise device management platform. We own the device software and cloud services that let enterprise customers set up, manage, and secure their Amazon device fleets, including device policy, compliance, and security capabilities. Our work spans the device and the cloud, and we partner closely with platform, security, and product teams across Amazon Devices to bring enterprise grade management to Amazon hardware.
