jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This position is to develop new features and maintain embeded software on satellite. You will work to increase and maintain satellite availability to 99.99%. You will provide solutions to prevent SW regression. You will participate to debugging of issues in space (SW and HW), and provide mechanism to detected early, provide mitigation when appropriate, and provide fixes (both new design and bug fixes) to address the problems.

You will work with HW engineers, PE and SDEs from various team to improve our stack.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
* Develop software solutions to effectively manage the infrastructure required for secure, large-scale operation of our system.
* Take ownership of the complete software development lifecycle, encompassing design, testing, deployment, and mission integration.
* Engage in end-to-end participation in major engineering projects, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Take the lead in identifying and resolving software architectural deficiencies, and facilitating the delivery of higher-quality software at an accelerated pace, enabling faster iterations towards the right solution.
* Effectively communicate your ideas to achieve optimal outcomes for both your team and the customer. Encourage diverse perspectives and incorporate feedback to enhance results.
* Drive the adoption of software best practices, including security, quality, and operational excellence.

A day in the life
You participate in our team standup and aligned on priorities / status. You work on a feature or troubleshooting an issue reported from space and/or integrated lab venues. You review code from your peers and participate in design / test plan reviews.
You often have cross-functional meetings with other teams to ensure the solution/fix to a problem is the right long term solution. You provide automation for a feature or a bug fix.


About the team
The Merlin platform team is a group of 9 SDEs working on embedded SW for the satellites . We are responsible to control the ASICs in our payload modules and detect & remediate faults (SW and HW).

Our vision is to move beyond disconnected planning tools and manual decision-making toward intelligent, event-driven systems where changes in network demand, capacity, or labor requirements can automatically trigger downstream model execution, planning adjustments, and operational actions. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of distributed systems, Applied Science, and Agentic AI. You will design scalable model orchestration platforms, integrate ML models into production workflows, and build agentic systems that leverage LLMs, MCP, and tool-based integrations to connect data, and operational systems. If you enjoy building new systems, solving challenging engineering problems at scale, and turning emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions with measurable business impact, this role offers an opportunity to help define the future of Middle Mile planning technology.

Key job responsibilities
The position focuses on building scalable planning and execution platforms across multiple planning horizons within Sort cneters. You will partner closely with Product, Science, Site Operations, and cross-organizational teams including AFT and Sort Tech to develop intelligent systems that connects planning systems and operational execution. This includes building agentic systems, model orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation to streamline complex workflows and enable data-driven decision-making.

In addition, you will:

- Design and build scalable distributed systems and full-stack applications that solve complex operational challenges at Amazon scale.
- Architect and develop intelligent automation solutions that integrate AI capabilities, science models, and enterprise systems.
- Build reliable platforms for executing, orchestrating, and monitoring ML and optimization models in production.
- Lead end-to-end technical design and delivery, translating broadly defined business problems into scalable, extensible solutions.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to influence architectural decisions and drive innovation.
- Drive engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for software quality, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing while contributing to the team's technical direction.

A day in the life
As an engineer on our team, your day could involve designing an event-driven workflow that automatically re-evaluates labor and capacity plans when network demand changes, building agents that connects planning data with ML models to generate actionable recommendations, or scaling distributed orchestration platforms that executes hundreds of optimization and simulation workflows across the Sort Center network. You will work closely with Scientists to host new models, collaborate with Product and Operations teams to understand real-world planning challenges, and partner with engineers across Amazon to integrate systems that have traditionally operated independently. Some days will focus on architecture and technical design, while others will involve hands-on development, experimentation with emerging AI technologies, reviewing code, or improving the reliability and performance of production systems. You will have the autonomy to influence technical decisions, take ownership of meaningful projects, and see your work translate directly into operational improvements across Amazon's Middle Mile network. Our environment encourages engineers to experiment, challenge existing approaches, and build solutions that balance innovation with operational excellence.

About the team
Out team builds and operates platforms that power planning and operational decision-making across Amazon's Sort Center network. This charter spans long-term strategic planning, mid-term optimization, and short-term execution, connecting science-driven recommendations with systems that turn plans into operational actions. The engineering ecosystem includes full-stack applications, distributed model execution platforms, data processing pipelines, and decision automation services, built on AWS technologies including ECS, AWS Batch, SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions, Aurora DB and DynamoDB. We are evolving these platforms into an intelligent, connected ecosystem through event-driven orchestration and agentic systems. With a rapidly expanding charter spanning planning, execution, and AI-powered automation, this is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up, shape foundational architectures, and influence how Amazon's Middle Mile operates at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Software Dev Engineer, Route 53 Health Checks and Console Core
jobs.description:
Build the service that checks the health of millions of endpoints around the world every few seconds, and the consoles customers rely on to run DNS and route traffic at global scale. As a Senior SDE on the Amazon Route 53 Health Checks and Console Core team, you will own the technical direction for the team and drive the plan with leadership, lead how we use AI to design, build, test, and operate software, and grow the engineers around you. You will own the distributed health checking infrastructure and the public API in front of it, build the AI tooling every Route 53 service team depends on, and launch new AI services for DNS and Route 53. You will help define what our customers use next.

We are based in Vancouver, BC. We own Route 53 Health Checks, a highly available endpoint monitoring service that helps Route 53 DNS, Amazon Elastic Load Balancing, Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, and many other AWS services maintain high availability for their customers. We also own the core tooling, standards, and shared infrastructure that every Route 53 console is built on. This is a full stack role. You will design and operate the services and APIs behind Route 53 Health Checks, and you will take our console tooling from something our team uses to something every Route 53 service team builds on, while we hold the quality bar on what ships. Your work will reach across more than 10 service teams and the product managers, designers, and engineers you partner with throughout AWS networking.

AI is central to how we work and what we build. As a senior engineer on the team, you will own how we work with it. You will define the AI development process the team runs on across coding, testing, and operations, decide which tools and practices we adopt, measure whether they make us faster and safer, and roll what works out to the service teams that build on our platform. You will own the results of the team, not only your own code. You will drive our yearly plan, turn goals into projects with milestones and estimates, sequence the work across the team, and track it to delivery. When a plan slips or a risk shows up, you raise it early and change the plan. You will lead projects that span several engineers, drive the designs behind them, and mentor engineers through design reviews and code reviews.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical direction and the roadmap for the team, and lead projects that span several engineers from requirements to launch.
- Drive the yearly plan for the team with leadership, break goals into projects with milestones and estimates, and recommend what the team builds first
- Track delivery across the team, raise risks early, and adjust the plan when priorities or dependencies change.
- Define and run the AI development process for the team across coding, testing, and operations, and roll it out to service teams across Route 53.
- Mentor and grow the engineers on the team, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews, and operational reviews.
- Design, build, and operate the distributed health checking infrastructure and public API behind Route 53 Health Checks.
- Build and vend the AI tooling that service teams across Route 53 use to design and build their own console changes, and hold the quality bar on what they ship.
- Own and build new AI services and capabilities for DNS and Route 53, from idea to launch.
- Operate what you build. Take part in on call, own metrics and alarms, and drive root cause analysis on production issues.
- Work with product managers, designers, and engineers across more than 10 service teams in AWS networking.
- Turn requirements that are ambiguous and change quickly into products customers rely on.
Our health checking stack is primarily Java and Linux, with lots of interaction with public AWS services and Amazon internal tools. Our console stack is TypeScript and React. We do not expect you to know all of it, but we do expect you to be excited to learn it.

A day in the life
Our customers are the developers and businesses who use Route 53 to manage DNS and route traffic for their applications around the world, and our job is to make that easy, reliable, and fast. No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a design with an engineer you mentor, then work with the team on a new AI practice to cut the time from idea to production. After lunch you might review a change a service team submitted and hold the bar on the console patterns and the design guidelines, then spend the rest of the afternoon on the health checking infrastructure itself, on the checkers that monitor millions of endpoints or the public API in front of them. Some days you go deep on a distributed system, other days you are building tooling or trying out a new AI tool and deciding whether the team should adopt it. You drive the plan for what the team builds next with leadership, track how it is going, and partner with service teams across AWS networking to ship features that reach customers everywhere. When a hackathon idea grabs you, there is room to chase it.


About the team
We are a tight knit team that cares about our customers and about running a highly available platform on the Internet. We like to experiment and to learn out loud, whether that is a hackathon, a demo of something you just built, or a session digging into a new AI tool together. We are good at making sense of ambiguity and shipping products people rely on, and we welcome bold ideas and give you the ownership to take them all the way. And when we are not building, we make time to have fun together with regular team outings.

If you want to lead hard problems at scale, help shape the plan for a team that builds with AI, and help decide where an AWS service goes next, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
jobs.description:

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DSP Tech
jobs.description:
Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.

This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
• Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
• Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
• Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
• Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
• Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability
• Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions

A day in the life
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.

About the team
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AFT Flow, AFT OB&Flow
jobs.description:
Have you ever ordered from Amazon and been amazed at how fast you receive the shipment? Ever wondered how Amazon delivers to customers so fast and on promised time? Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) organization owns the software and infrastructure that powers Amazon’s world-class fulfillment centers. These systems underlie everything we do – tens of millions of items in the catalog, hundreds of millions of units of inventory, and billions of transactions each year!

The AFT Flow team represents a critical vertical within our organization, with a focused mandate on orchestrating and optimizing goods movement throughout Amazon's fulfillment network. The team's core mission is to develop and implement innovative solutions that achieve optimal facility throughput by coordinating processes, labor resources, robotics, and automated systems while seamlessly integrating physical and digital operations. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, AI Foundations, Amazon Leo AI Foundations
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's initiative to launch a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites to provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Leo AI Foundations team builds the intelligence that will run Leo as an AI-native business. We combine applied science and engineering with Leo's domain expertise, own the shared AI foundation for the business, and lead work that spans teams and systems, so that progress in one part of Leo becomes a capability the whole business can use. Leo Lens is our command center for this AI network. It is pioneering agentic AI for diagnostics, reporting, troubleshooting and mitigating issues across our end-to-end network stack, and it automates workflows for mission operations, ecommerce and developer use cases. Through Lens, it is our vision that agents work as one system to keep the network secure and reliable, resolving failures before customers experience them, while Leo's teams keep authority over consequential decisions.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead one of our engineering teams. You will own a roadmap in one of our tracks as we build the infrastructure for the AI that operates the network, from the agents themselves to the orchestration, knowledge access, evaluation and security controls that connect them. You will hire and grow a team of software engineers and applied scientists, partner with the domain teams that own satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and deliver production systems where reliability, security and measurable impact are the bar.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, lead and develop a team of software engineers and applied scientists, from hiring and onboarding through career growth and performance.
- Own the team's roadmap and delivery: translate the AI Foundations charter into goals, milestones and launches, and report progress and risks to senior leadership.
- Lead the technical design and architecture of agentic AI systems for Leo, covering agent development, data integration and the platform services that connect agents to Leo's knowledge and systems.
- Bring deep, current knowledge of AI, including large language models, agent frameworks, retrieval and evaluation methods, and apply it to guide the team's technical choices and to raise the AI fluency of the partner teams you work with.
- Deliver production AI systems with the evaluation, access controls and operational readiness required to act on a live network, and expand agent autonomy only as evidence shows it is safe and effective.
- Own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives, including infrastructure migrations and platform improvements, with domain teams who retain ownership of their services.
- Set and uphold the engineering bar for the team: design and security reviews, testing, operational excellence and on-call health.
- Make prioritization calls in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, balancing stability against new capabilities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because you are building something that has not existed before. You will set the direction for your team and remove what stands in its way. You will sit with the engineers and scientists who own Leo's satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and decide with them how your team's expertise in AI can unblock them or move them faster. You will meet the operators who keep the network healthy and turn their hardest problems into the next capability Lens delivers. You will hire and grow the people who build this, and represent your work to Leo's senior leadership.

About the team
We are an AI-native team of software engineers and applied scientists in Redmond, and we move fast. We use AI in how we build, not only in what we build, so a good idea can be a working experiment the same week and a production capability the next. We think beyond how things have been done, test our ideas against real problems, and keep only what proves itself. We ship lightning fast, and we hold a high bar for quality and production readiness while doing it.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
jobs.description:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day. We ship changes through automated pipelines and measure our work by the manual effort and errors we remove. We value clear writing, careful reviews, and engineers who ask why a process exists before they automate it.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AFT Sortation, AFT Mansort
jobs.description:
Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.

About the Mansort Team

The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.

Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.

Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.

Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.

Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.

Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.

Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.

Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, SageMaker AI Inference
jobs.description:
Demand for large language model (LLM) inference is growing fast, and the engineers who make it faster and more efficient are shaping the future of AI at Amazon. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to focus on inference performance optimization, kernel tuning, and LLM serving efficiency. You will work across the full software development lifecycle to design, build, and measure systems that reduce latency and improve throughput for production inference workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role where your work directly translates into better performance for internal teams and, ultimately, for Amazon's customers. If you are an engineer who enjoys profiling bottlenecks, writing high-performance code, and finding elegant solutions to hard systems problems, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement kernel-level optimizations and inference pipeline improvements that reduce latency and increase throughput for LLM serving workloads.
- Profile, benchmark, and tune model inference performance across hardware and software stacks, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable gains.
- Write well-organized, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and mentoring newer engineers on the team.
- Collaborate with applied scientists, ML engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate model requirements into production-ready inference solutions.
- Evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and generative AI techniques for inference optimization, recommending adoption where they improve efficiency or quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing benchmark results from an overnight profiling run, then dig into a kernel implementation to shave milliseconds off a critical inference path. After lunch you could pair with an applied scientist to understand a new model architecture's compute profile and plan your optimization approach. Throughout the day you will participate in code reviews, document your design decisions, and share findings with the broader team so that improvements compound across projects.

About the team
Our team owns SageMaker AI inference at Amazon, and inference performance optimization is becoming increasingly important as LLM workloads scale. One or more programming languages such as: Python, Java, Rust, Go, etc.
System design
Network fundamentals
Collaborate with other engineers towards broader organizational goals and projects
Collaborate with product and program managers, principal engineers for feature definition and delivery
Work with other AWS teams to build innovative solutions that create value for our customers, supporting them in their network deployment activities

We introduced a revolutionary concept in the way we manage networks and own the central point of decision making for any change needed in ML networks. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Transactional Services
jobs.description:
The Transactional Services team builds some of the most foundational distributed systems that underpin and power many large AWS services. We build and own a high performance, highly available replicated log service used by a range of AWS services as a commit log and for streaming data.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to own and a build major part for our control plane. Your work will be critical to the scalability and availability of the service. Working on a foundational service, your work can have a large, positive impact for AWS customers.

Job responsibilities include:

* Designing, developing, and operating highly available and scalable control plane services that manage the lifecycle, placement, and metadata of one of AWS's largest distributed systems — handling hundreds of millions of operations per second.
* Improving service quality, operational excellence, and reliability — building monitoring, automation, and operational tooling that prevents customer impact.
* Providing input to project plans and delivery commitments and developing quality features in line with those commitments.
* Working with a talented team, gaining and sharing knowledge through code reviews and design reviews.
* Mentoring other engineers.
* Driving technology, product and process improvements.

The role involves end-to-end ownership, from requirements to design, implementation, deployment and ongoing production support. You will have the opportunity to work with senior and principal software engineers on a daily basis.

In joining our team, you'll enjoy a competitive salary, great benefits, and a creative and comfortable work environment. Our team has multiple opportunities for growth on technical and leadership frontiers, with variety of project types on our roadmap to fit your personal career growth path.

For more information on Amazon Web Services please visit: http://aws.amazon.com

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

jobs.description:

Amazon's Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellation is on the path to general availability, and we need engineers who can help make our network services scalable, resilient, and ready for millions of customers worldwide. As a Software Development Engineer on the Software Defined Network controller team, you will design and build the control plane software that orchestrates a global telecom network spanning satellites, ground stations, and cloud infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and space technology, solving multi-dimensional resource allocation problems at a truly global scale. If you are a collaborative, curious engineer who thrives on complex systems challenges, we want to hear from you.

- Design and deliver scalable, high-throughput, low-latency network architecture using AWS services such as Amazon Elastic Container Service, DynamoDB, Amazon Simple Storage Service, Amazon Kinesis, and Step Functions.
- Build and maintain highly available software that drives networking control plane operations across physical and virtual nodes, including satellite topology management and routing algorithms.
- Identify and implement automation, redundancy, and optimization improvements that strengthen network resilience as we approach general availability.
- Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple services and external partners to coordinate cross-service features and integrations.
- Participate actively in code reviews, operational support, and root cause analysis to ensure service reliability, and mentor teammates on software design and best practices.

The Software Defined Network controller team builds the brain behind the LEO satellite network. jobs.title: Sr Software Dev Engineer, ALG Software and Network Integration and Test
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advance satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

About the Role
In the Integration & Test (I&T) team, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, develop, and own software tooling and frameworks that enable integration testing within system lab environments for space-based and terrestrial applications. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and systems verification — you will define how teams test, not just what they test.

Working within Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering Integrated Systems Solutions, you will architect and deliver reusable test platforms, automation frameworks, and lab infrastructure software that accelerate verification of complex integrated hardware and software systems. You will serve as the technical owner of lab tooling strategy, driving decisions on architecture, interfaces, and developer experience while collaborating across inter-disciplinary teams, partners, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience working on complex Hardware/Software systems with a diverse set of talented individuals, as well as with partner organizations.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed


Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the technical vision, architecture, and long-term roadmap for test automation frameworks, orchestration platforms, and CI/CD-integrated tooling consumed by I&T engineers and subsystem teams in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system lab environments
- Lead the end-to-end design, development, and evolution of software tooling — including test algorithms, scripts, calibration routines, and data visualization — required for verification and validation of complex hardware systems; drive architectural decisions that balance scalability, reliability, and maintainability across multiple product lines
- Establish and evangelize tooling best practices, coding standards, and reference architectures across the lab engineering organization; champion patterns for automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code that raise the bar org-wide and influence adjacent teams
- Analyze test data at scale and engage cross-functionally with engineering leadership, partners, suppliers, and customers to evaluate product performance, identify systemic trends, and drive proactive improvements that reduce defect escape rates
- Author and present technical design documents, test strategy white papers, and executive-level reports documenting test results, coverage, performance metrics, and KPIs; influence prioritization decisions through data-driven communication with senior leadership
- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of test anomalies, defects, and systemic failure modes; lead root-cause investigations, define corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across control systems in a high-rate production environment
- Identify strategic gaps in test infrastructure, author proposals with cost-benefit analysis, and drive multi-quarter implementation plans — making pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, long-term maintainability, and organizational scalability
- Mentor and develop mid-level and junior engineers through technical design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and career development guidance; raise the engineering bar across the team
- Drive cross-organizational collaboration with systems engineers, hardware teams, program management, and external partners to ensure tooling supports all phases of integration, test, verification, and validation across satellite and ground element campaigns; represent the team in technical reviews and architecture forums

About the team
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. These solutions are tailored to meet the needs of government and international customers for both space-based and terrestrial applications. The Integrated Engineering Solutions organization under ALG Engineering plays a vital role in the entire life cycle of the development of an engineering solution, including architecture development, requirements and interface definition through assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), verification, and post-delivery and operational support.

* Enhance collective algorithms and topologies for optimal training performance
* Use tools like Neuron Explorer to identify bottlenecks in compute and bus bandwidth utilization
* Monitor and analyze processor, DMA, firmware, and workload metrics
* Optimize collective operations to scale AI compute across the data center
* Work closely with the hardware team to co-optimize software and Trainium silicon
* Develop and optimize C/C++ implementations of collective communication patterns
* Investigate and implement improvements for specific training topologies used by modern LLMs

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS OpenSearch Service
jobs.description:
Imagine running search and analytics at any scale without thinking about clusters, capacity, or version upgrades. Where your queries return in milliseconds whether you're indexing a thousand documents or a hundred billion. Where the platform scales, heals, and secures itself so your team can focus on the questions, not the infrastructure.

That's what we build at Amazon OpenSearch.

Amazon OpenSearch is the fully managed and Serverless AWS service that lets customers deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, observability, and AI-powered retrieval. We serve hundreds of thousands of customers running mission-critical workloads across every AWS region, and we are part of the AWS Database and Analytics organization.

Come join the OpenSearch Control Plane team. We are responsible for a service that:

- Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
- Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
- Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched **OpenSearch Serverless NextGen** — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

**Operations is core engineering on this team, not overhead.** Engineers operate what they build, and we treat customer-impacting incidents with the same engineering rigor we apply to feature work. Reliability and Static Stability is a forcing function for design, not a phase after launch.

Key job responsibilities

- Invent and Simplify in equal measure — drive simplification of legacy designs as actively as you propose new ones; identify and eliminate accidental complexity across the team's surfaces; mentor others on simplifying-by-design
- Treat operations as core engineering — own the systems you build end-to-end, lead incident response and RCAs with customer-first urgency, and drive operational improvements that compound across the team
- Lead design and development of complex services across cluster management, capacity orchestration, scaling policies, query routing, security, and machine learning
- Build and apply AI fluency across the software development lifecycle — decompose problems for AI assistance, ground prompts in relevant context, validate AI-generated output, and use AI to accelerate both code and beyond-code work
- Mentor and grow engineers across the team; raise the bar for software development, operational excellence, and security
- Set technical direction and partner with the broader OpenSearch organization to align solutions with customer needs and market opportunities
- Contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Identity
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Tax Central AI Engineering
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Corporate Development Finance
jobs.description:
The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — billions of dollars in value across 700+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers & Acquisitions ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury.

When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset).

We are a small, high-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen.

You will lead the IMS technical program end to end. You will lead a team of 2-3 software engineers, set technical direction with them, drive design decisions, and raise the bar on engineering quality through design and code reviews. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end-to-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.

Tech stack: a serverless, event-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure-as-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI-assisted development tools used daily.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the technical program for IMS: the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree. Drive the architecture decisions with the engineering team.
• Define requirements and acceptance criteria for the data model and the financial calculations (such as IRR, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress). Go deep enough to validate the results and challenge design trade-offs.
• Own the roadmap and delivery for the React web application and the Amazon Bedrock-based AI assistant, from requirements through launch.
• Work directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem to turn open-ended requests into clear requirements, prioritize the roadmap, manage dependencies and expectations, and balance near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.
• Run the deadline-bound work the team cannot miss, including the quarterly close.
• Lead integrations with partner data teams across multiple systems.
• When it speeds up a decision, prototype, script, or query data yourself. You can read and review production code, but the engineering team owns it.

About the team
Corporate Development Finance (CDF) is a cross-functional team that serves as the finance partner to Amazon’s corporate venture capital funds (the Industrial Innovation Fund, the Alexa Fund, and the Climate Pledge Fund), to Amazon’s warrant program, and to portfolio management across Amazon’s global investment and warrant portfolio. The team comprises finance professionals, program managers, and technical roles building the infrastructure to support a growing and increasingly complex portfolio.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Devices Software & Services
jobs.description:
The Amazon Devices Software & Services team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a high-velocity, specialized team. This is not a traditional framework or infrastructure role - we are building a new groundbreaking customer experience that will define how millions of users worldwide interact with their technology - making it more proactive, intuitive, and invisible.

We’re building the systems that put AI into production — the runtime, services, and tooling that turn large language models and autonomous agents into reliable, safe, scalable products. As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll design and ship core software in this stack: model and tool integrations, the agent execution loop, evaluation and quality pipelines, and the APIs that product teams build on. You’ll own meaningful components end to end, make real design decisions, and write production code that runs against real users and real data.
This is a hands-on building role for an engineer who wants to go deep on AI infrastructure — not just call an API, but engineer the reliability, safety, and performance around it. You’ll also work in an AI-native development environment: we use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of our daily software-development lifecycle, and we hold that velocity to a hard bar of automated testing and code review. We expect engineers who can move fast and keep the quality gates green.


Key job responsibilities
- Invent New Paradigms: Move beyond traditional voice UI to build "Ambient Intelligence" experiences that span Alexa, Fire TV, and mobile/wearable surfaces, focusing on proactive assistance rather than reactive commands.
- Rapid Innovation: Operate in a fast-paced environment where you will prototype, test, and deploy features that leverage multimodal inputs (camera, audio, and documents) to create personalized customer magic.
- Cross-Surface Continuity: Ensure that a customer’s experience is persistent and context-aware beyond the device boundaries - whether they are at their desk using Alexa.com, in their living room with Fire TV, or on the go with a wearable.
- Design, build, test, and operate scalable backend services and libraries that power AI/LLM-driven features.
- Integrate and harden model providers, tools, and agent capabilities behind clean, versioned interfaces — with sane failure behavior, observability, and cost/latency awareness.
- Build evaluation and regression tooling so AI behavior is measured, gated, and trustworthy — not vibes.
- Apply security-conscious, fail-closed design to anything touching credentials, user data, tool execution, or autonomous actions.
- Work fluently alongside AI coding assistants: decompose tasks an agent can execute, critically review AI-generated code, and keep engineering rigor high at AI speed.


A day in the life
In our team, you will get to build new products and features from the ground up. You will define and build features and tools used by thousands of developers for building for millions of customers. We work across multiple internal teams as well as product to define what we are building and make it a reality. SDEs on this team are actively writing code, as well as working on designs and mentoring others. As the Device OS org we get to work horizontally across many exciting new device types.

About the team
We’re a platform team that builds the shared AI/agent infrastructure used across multiple products. We care about correctness, safety, and developer experience in equal measure. We operate test-first, review adversarially, keep our core clean and reusable, and treat AI as a tool that raises the engineering bar.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Lightsail
jobs.description:
Amazon Lightsail makes AWS accessible to developers and business customers who want to get their cloud stacks running in seconds without the complexity of traditional infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Lightsail team, you will build features and services that simplify compute, storage, networking, and website hosting for customers who need things to just work. The team is expanding quickly, adding new capabilities like website hosting and agent hosting, and you will help shape what comes next. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding customer problems through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are an engineer who enjoys building products you would actually use yourself, and you want to do that at AWS scale, we would like to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build features for Amazon Lightsail's distributed systems, working in Java, Go, JavaScript, and React across both backend services and frontend experiences.
Collaborate with partner teams across AWS — including Amazon EC2, Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) — to integrate Lightsail capabilities with the broader AWS ecosystem.
Own the operational health of the services you build by identifying root causes of production issues and driving permanent fixes, ensuring customers experience reliable performance.
Participate actively in design reviews and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and mentoring other engineers on writing clean, maintainable code.
Evaluate new technologies and approaches, including generative artificial intelligence tools, to improve team productivity and the quality of solutions delivered to customers.

A day in the life
You start your morning checking operational dashboards for a Lightsail service you recently launched, then join a design review where you and a teammate work through how to integrate a new hosting capability with an existing AWS service. After lunch, you pick up a feature task, writing backend logic in Java and wiring up the React console so customers can try it out. Later, you review a pull request from a teammate, leave detailed feedback, and update documentation so the next engineer who touches this code can ramp up quickly.

About the team
Amazon Lightsail sits within AWS and has a distinctive mission: make cloud infrastructure simple and approachable for non-enterprise customers. While we run on the same AWS infrastructure that powers the world's largest workloads, our focus is on removing complexity so developers and small businesses can launch and scale without a steep learning curve. We are an inclusive team that values knowledge sharing and mentorship, and we intentionally assign projects to help each engineer grow. Right now we are investing in new hosting and agent capabilities, so there is plenty of room to have a direct impact on what we build next.

jobs.title: SDE, Constellation Operations, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Software Development Engineer you will own the development, implementation, and test of operational tooling built to execute the Leo mission. You will work with engineering teams across ground and space systems, to understand how the system functions and deliver an integrated solution to prepare for and execute the mission. Because of the scale of the mission, you will be focused on tooling that supports and enables the Mission Operations team — identifying areas of improvement and initiating changes to improve the productivity of the fleet.

You will prepare for each launch and on-orbit demonstration, design and conduct operational tests, and drive automation efforts with scalability in mind, ensuring that the constellation functions at peak performance with limited manual intervention. You work alongside flight directors and Leo software teams to design and implement operational improvements and tooling, develop and perform analysis on system data, and identify areas and mechanisms for further improvement.

The ideal candidate will be detail oriented, have strong organizational skills, able to work independently, juggle multiple tasks at once, and maintain professionalism under pressure. You should have deep knowledge software engineering practices, understand how software and hardware systems interact, and can drive design and implementation of operational execution of objectives in complex systems. Familiarity with space systems is desired.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

jobs.title: Network Development Engineer II , ALG Software and Network Integration and Test
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advance satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

We're looking for a Network Development Engineer who can design, build, and operate network infrastructure across data center and engineering environments. You'll own architectures that support production systems, integration environments, and engineering labs — delivering reliability and scalability while enabling teams to move fast.
You'll bring data center networking fundamentals — switching fabrics, routing, segmentation, automation — and apply them across environments with varying requirements, from production-grade availability to rapid reconfigurability for hardware integration and system validation.

You deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions — whether refreshing aging infrastructure or standing up something new. You're comfortable designing a scalable switching fabric and equally comfortable helping an engineer debug why their test hardware can't reach a shared resource. You bring production-grade thinking to every environment you touch, and you understand that great infrastructure enables great engineering.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.



Key job responsibilities
• Design & deploy network architectures — switching fabrics, routing, segmentation, and connectivity across data center and infrastructure environments
• Automate network provisioning, configuration management, and operational workflows; build tooling that enables infrastructure to scale at higher volume
• Operate & sustain multi-tenant network environments including technology refresh, scaling, and optimization — delivering simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions
• Troubleshoot & resolve complex cross-domain network events spanning physical layer through application connectivity; diagnose root cause and mitigate impact
• Collaborate with hardware, systems, and software engineering teams to define requirements and ensure smooth rollout of new designs and products
• Lead projects in network deployment, sustaining engineering, and infrastructure scaling
• Maintain standards for change management, documentation (SOPs, implementation guides, knowledge transfer), and configuration control; ensure compliance across the networking toolset

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Neuron Inference
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer II - AI/ML, you will design and implement business-critical features and own the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like the GLM, GPT-OSS, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Are you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and maintain systems that solve complex problems while delivering meaningful results. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards from customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. This role offers the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, collaborate with talented engineers, and grow your skills while making a real impact. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and shipping high-quality code, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role contributes to building distributed inference support for PyTorch in the Neuron SDK, and tunes models to ensure the highest performance and maximize efficiency running on AWS Trainium. Strong software development in Python, system-level programming, and ML knowledge are all critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle, including distributed-computing-based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architectures.
* Understand and produce NKI (Neuron Kernel Interface) kernels, and design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware, using knowledge of the underlying Trainium hardware architecture to guide optimization decisions.
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling.
* Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators.
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques, and share proposals, findings, and learnings with internal developers and external customers via high-quality designs and documentation.


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, systems engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and contributing to the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you'll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions and code reviews, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you're always working on the most important initiative.You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. From there, you might dive into designing a new feature, writing and reviewing code, or pairing with a teammate to debug a tricky issue. You will participate in design discussions, contribute to sprint planning, and document your systems so that others can learn from and extend your work. Expect regular collaboration with product and engineering partners as you shape solutions that serve customers at scale.

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others. We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS IAM AuthRuntimeClient

- Build high-quality, highly available, always-on products.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and solve complex problems from first principles.
- Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.
