jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
jobs.description:
AWS Security's Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon's security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping
Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking a senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a technical leader who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems where the business need is understood but the technology strategy is not yet defined, who owns outcomes across system boundaries, and who thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals. You will own the architectural direction of the SecComms platform, lead projects staffed by multiple engineers, and act as a force multiplier for the team.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team - engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable leading discussions and building consensus in this environment across both technical and non-technical domains.

Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery

• Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements, then define the technology strategy to meet them where none yet exists, translating ambiguity into well-designed, extensible software.
• Solve complex problems with multiple risks and roadblocks using solutions that are as simple as possible, both directly and by directing the work of other engineers, and explain those problems to others in simple, concise terms.
• Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; identify one-way-door decisions and advocate for the right long-term solution rather than short-term workarounds.
• Produce exemplary, well-tested, documented code that sets the standard others emulate and adheres to the Amazon Code Bar.

Operational Excellence
• Lead ongoing operational support for the team with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response; effectively prioritize trade-offs between operational improvements and other work.
• Drive resolution of the root causes of operational issues and address systemic issues that reduce support costs across the team's services.
• Take the lead in identifying and solving architecture deficiencies and areas where software bottlenecks innovation, including in systems you depend on but do not own.
• Ensure software failures are addressed with permanent fixes that prevent recurring incidents.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership
• Partner with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and adjacent teams to understand the business and customer value of the team's software, and influence the roadmaps and technical decisions of teams you depend on but don't control.
• Build consensus and make an inclusive space for differing views when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise across organizational boundaries.
• Make effective priority trade-offs between feature development and operational work, prioritizing long-term results - software quality, business requirements, customer experience, and maintainability - across your team's and related teams' products.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

• Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team; train new team members on how the SecComms software is constructed, tested, operated, and secured, and how it fits into the broader Amazon Security architecture.

• Seek diverse perspectives and feedback early, and proactively identify and drive adoption of industry innovations including new tools, design patterns, and AWS capabilities to ensure the team's skills keep pace.

About the team

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Neuron Explorer
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Trainium and Inferentia cloud-scale machine learning accelerators and the Trn3/Trn2/Trn1 and Inf2/Inf1 servers that use them. This role is for a Sr. Software Development Engineer on the Developer Experiences (DevEx) team within AWS Neuron, based in Toronto.

The Neuron Explorer team makes AWS Trainium performance visible. We own Neuron Explorer, the tool for profiling, debugging, and optimizing machine learning workloads on Trainium and Inferentia. We build profiling, debugging, and analysis tools that let engineers see how efficiently models and kernels use the hardware, pinpoint bottlenecks, and decide what to optimize next. Neuron Explorer traces execution from source code down to hardware operations across both single-node and distributed applications. Our goal is to cut through complex execution data so customers can optimize faster and reach higher performance on Trainium.

As a Sr. Software Development Engineer for the Neuron Explorer team, you will design, build, and operate the full stack behind Neuron Explorer — from low-level performance data collection and analysis engines to interactive visualizations and developer workflows. You will own features end to end, spanning the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI, and you will help push our AI-powered recommendation and analysis capabilities that automatically surface bottlenecks and guide optimization.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build performance data collection pipelines and analysis engines that transform raw hardware execution data into actionable insights for Neuron Explorer users.
- Develop interactive visualizations and developer workflows that make complex profiling data understandable, helping customers pinpoint bottlenecks across single-node and distributed training workloads.
- Own features end to end across the full software development lifecycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — ensuring reliability and maintainability.
- Collaborate with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to surface the right performance information so internal and external customers can optimize AI workloads on Trainium and Inferentia hardware.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities into Neuron Explorer's recommendation engine, building features that automatically identify optimization opportunities and guide customers toward higher performance.

A day in the life
You will work across the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI that make up Neuron Explorer, partnering with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to expose the data customers need to optimize their models. You will work with senior technical leaders and management to define product direction and deliver it to customers, including teams bringing massive-scale multi-modal large language models to peak performance on Trainium. We build the full stack of software, servers, and chips to accelerate machine learning at the highest scale.

About the team
Inclusive Team Culture

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences.

Work/Life Balance

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Some days you'll dig into customer escalations, tracing issues through logs and metrics. Other days you'll experiment with AI tools to improve engineering processes. The Identity and Registry team owns the foundational services at the core of AWS IoT — device identity, registry, shadow, and provisioning. Our team values operational excellence, customer obsession, and a strong ownership culture where every engineer has a direct impact. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Telemetry Platform
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Are you passionate about developing mission-critical software systems? As part of the Atlas team, you'll build and maintain the backbone software infrastructure that powers our entire organization. Your work will include:

- Creating systems and services for ingesting, processing, and visualizing vast amounts of satellite telemetry data

- Building real-time monitoring systems to identify anomalies, detect emerging trends, and proactively alert stakeholders to critical situations that require intervention

- Ensuring extremely high reliability, uptime, and performance across systems that receive and manage telemetry streams from thousands of endpoint

The systems we build serve a fundamental role in the successful functioning of the satellite constellation, and several supporting teams. They depend on us to have mission-critical reliability, uptime, and performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements.
- Collaborate with your fellow team members to form a strong foundation for a software organization in Leo.
- Help on-board new team members.
- Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build high-available software services.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
The Atlas software engineering group is responsible for developing and maintaining the critical software infrastructure that enables multi-region telemetry data ingestion, health monitoring, and trend analysis across Amazon's Leo systems. As the core team building and managing these foundational data pipelines and analytics systems, the Atlas team bears significant ownership and responsibility to ensure high availability, performance, and scalability are met to satisfy business needs.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Efficiency & Performance, Alloy, Region Flex Efficiency
jobs.description:
Amazon runs one of the world’s most complex eCommerce platforms, where operational efficiency directly drives profitability and customer satisfaction. Efficiency is core to Amazon’s DNA, reflected in the Leadership Principle of Frugality and the Flywheel strategy that lowers cost structures to fuel growth. With the cost of operating Amazon’s global infrastructure measured in billions of dollars, achieving true economies of scale rather than allowing scale to increase costs is essential to our success.

The Alloy team serves as Amazon’s central efficiency organization, leading company-wide cost optimization through intelligent and automated use of AWS resources. Our work spans thousands of internal services, enabling large-scale efficiency improvements with minimal engineering effort from partner teams. We drive optimization across multiple layers of Amazon’s stack, focusing on GPU efficiency infrastructure for AI/ML workloads through centralized scheduling, software performance profiling, and end-to-end storage optimizations through data lifecycle management. These cross-cutting initiatives transform isolated team optimizations into scalable, safe, and reusable systems that continuously improve efficiency across Amazon.

As a Software Development Engineer in Alloy, you will collaborate with service and infrastructure teams across Amazon to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks in large-scale distributed systems. You will design and build mechanisms to measure, analyze, and automate performance improvements, using data to set and drive company-wide efficiency goals. You will work closely with Principal and Distinguished Engineers, gaining exposure to Amazon’s most advanced systems while developing deep technical expertise and leadership skills. Your work will directly influence how Amazon’s software and services operate at scale, delivering measurable cost savings in the tens to hundreds of millions of dollars each year and advancing Amazon’s commitment to operational excellence and sustainability.

In this role, you will:
- Solve performance and efficiency problems that manifest at scale.
- Design metrics and measure performance and cost efficiency of services in Amazon's ecosystem.
- Collaborate with service teams to identify inefficiencies, and design and implement solutions.
- Design and develop highly available components and profiling tools.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across the full development lifecycle—from product definition and scoping through coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance—ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business and customer needs, translating requirements into scalable system designs that account for performance, security, and extensibility tradeoffs.
- Identify and resolve operational issues at their root cause, driving improvements to team operations and reducing support costs through proactive problem-solving and process enhancements.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools where appropriate to augment productivity and quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs and accelerate development workflows.
- Mentor and coach fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, actively training new team members on system architecture, construction, and operational best practices.

About the team
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly impacts Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer has a voice in technical decisions, and we encourage thoughtful debate to arrive at the best solutions. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for engineers who are excited to help shape our technical direction, grow their skills, and contribute to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Minerva
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using Software Engineering as a way to enable automation, knowledge extraction, and artificial intelligence through the use of Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Recommender systems, Computer Vision, and Optimization? We are building a team of experienced SW Engineers to support this vision.

On this team you will partner with a mature team of Scientists to create the infrastructure and processes needed to support multiple use cases including abstracting text, image, and audio to support ML models, analyze and model customer reading behavior to measure engagement and detect risks, study and optimize manufacturing and fulfillment processes, and build AI-based systems.

Come join us as we continue to revolutionize the book industry!

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Software Development Engineer to help advance the quality and capabilities of industry-leading large language models and Generative AI systems.

In this role, you will build scalable solutions for discovering, processing, curating, transforming, and delivering high-value data used across model evaluation, training, and post-training workflows. You will work with large-scale and heterogeneous datasets, including data produced by partner teams, long-context data, and other data sources that can help improve model development.

You will collaborate closely with scientists, ML engineers, evaluation teams, and other engineering teams to identify valuable data sources, understand downstream data requirements, and develop mechanisms that make data easier to discover, standardize, validate, transform, and consume at scale.

Your work will help expand the breadth, quality, and usability of data available for Generative AI development and establish scalable data infrastructure, quality standards, and workflows that enable downstream teams to evaluate and improve models more effectively.

This is an opportunity to solve challenging problems at the intersection of data infrastructure, evaluation data, and Generative AI, and to directly influence the data foundation supporting Amazon’s next generation of AI models and experiences.

Key job responsibilities
Quickly learn and apply emerging technologies, methodologies, and best practices in Generative AI, data processing, and large-scale model development.

Design, build, and maintain scalable platforms and infrastructure for discovering, scanning, processing, curating, and delivering data used to support LLM evaluation, training, and model improvement.

Develop systems and mechanisms to identify useful evaluation data produced by partner teams, understand its characteristics and usability, and make relevant data easier to discover, standardize, validate, and consume.

Expand the breadth and quality of data available for model development, including evaluation datasets, long-context data, training data, and other high-value data sources.

Build scalable capabilities to transform heterogeneous data from different sources and formats into standardized, high-quality datasets that can be reliably consumed by downstream evaluation and training workflows.

Partner closely with Applied Scientists, ML Engineers, evaluation teams, and other engineering teams to understand data needs, identify gaps in available data, and translate those needs into scalable data solutions.

Investigate design approaches, prototype new technologies, evaluate technical feasibility, and drive data infrastructure solutions from concept to production.

Build reliable, high-quality data discovery and processing pipelines that operate at massive scale while improving data quality, coverage, observability, efficiency, and developer productivity.

Influence technical architecture and establish engineering best practices for data discovery, curation, transformation, and delivery across Generative AI model development workflows.

A day in the life
As an SDE with the AGI team, you will build scalable systems that discover, process, curate, transform, and deliver high-value data for model evaluation, training, and post-training workflows.

You will work with large-scale, heterogeneous data sources and partner closely with scientists, ML engineers, and evaluation teams to understand downstream data needs and make useful data easier to identify, standardize, validate, and consume.

You will influence technical architecture, establish engineering best practices, and build reliable infrastructure that improves data quality, usability, and developer productivity across Generative AI model development.

About the team
Join our AGI team and work at the forefront of Generative AI. We build scalable data and model development infrastructure that helps teams discover, process, curate, transform, and use high-value data to support the development of large language models and other foundation models.

You will collaborate with talented engineers and scientists working across model development, evaluation, data, and large-scale distributed systems. Together, we solve challenging technical problems at massive scale and build mechanisms that make valuable data easier to identify, standardize, validate, and consume across evaluation, training, and post-training workflows.

This is an opportunity to influence how next-generation AI systems are developed, expand the breadth and quality of data available to model development teams, and help shape the future of artificial intelligence at Amazon.

Mission of the team:

We build scalable data discovery, curation, transformation, and infusion capabilities that accelerate the development of high-quality foundation models. By identifying high-value data across 1P and other relevant sources—including data produced through evaluation workflows—we make that data easier to discover, standardize, validate, and use across evaluation, training, and post-training.

Our mission is to expand the breadth, quality, and usability of data available for model development, enabling downstream teams to more effectively evaluate models, address data gaps, and improve model performance.

jobs.title: Senior SDE, OpenSearch, AWS OpenSearch
jobs.description:

Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage and secure vast volumes of data in the cloud? Do you want to have direct and immediate impact on a large number of AWS users? Do you want to be part of a fast-growing AWS service and work in a fast paced startup style environment?

Amazon Opensearch makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale Opensearch (for log analytics, application monitoring, full-text search, and more! Amazon Opensearch is a fully managed service that delivers Opensearch’s easy-to-use APIs and real-time capabilities along with offering predictable performance and seamless scalability for production workloads.

The OpenSearch team is looking for innovative engineers with a passion for helping develop the next generation of security features to help users (both, opensource community users and AWS customers) secure and manage access to their data, all at cloud scale.

You should be somebody who enjoys working on complex system software, is customer-centric, and feels strongly about delivering results. jobs.description:
The Amazon Cloud Management Foundations team is looking for a Software Development Engineer who has a passion for security-at-scale. You will work on a team building services that monitor Amazon network hosts and their configurations. We develop the tools that keep Amazon safe from malicious actors by preventing, detecting, and mitigating security events. We work closely with our Application Security, Threat Intel, Security Operations, and Security Analyst teams to drive security improvements across the company.

Our team deals with large quantities of data, pushing the envelope on scale and various advanced analytical techniques to find and mitigate security threats. You’ll be expected to develop robust large scale distributed systems for processing data, and to provide technical leadership to other engineers to do the same. While you may not be a security expert just yet, you have a passion for solving security challenges in innovative ways. You’ll develop a broad and deep understanding of the overall Amazon security posture and develop many of the core technology components to improve and scale.

The mission of the Network Security team within Amazon Cloud Management Foundations is to ensure all network endpoints meet the Amazon Security bar. This requires building large distributed systems that are capable of auditing internally-owned network hosts for potential misconfigurations. This team also develops solutions that drive remediation of network host misconfigurations at Amazon-scale, ensuring it remains secure for our customers.

· Be a technical leader that is not afraid to challenge the norms and innovate.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Checkout Applications Team
jobs.description:
We're looking for an engineer to join our team building lightning-fast, frictionless checkout experiences for Amazon's retail website. This is a great time to join: we are modernizing the Checkout platform and adding support for agentic purchasing flows that will change how hundreds of millions of customers complete their orders.

As a Software Development Engineer on the Checkout team within the Purchase Experience organization, you will design and deliver full-stack features across the entire software lifecycle using Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React. You will work on distributed systems at massive scale and plug generative AI into checkout infrastructure. If you like solving hard problems and shipping software that customers use every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build full-stack features for the Checkout platform using Java, TypeScript, and React (Native and Web), covering the full software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.
- Own and improve distributed microservices that run frictionless, high-scale checkout experiences, keeping performance and maintainability in balance.
- Plug generative AI frameworks into checkout workflows to support agentic purchasing flows for customers.
- Work with product managers, UX designers, and engineers across 300+ teams to turn business and customer needs into reliable, well-documented solutions.
- Coach fellow engineers through code reviews and technical guidance, helping maintain a high-quality codebase and spotting ways to improve team operations.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing metrics and operational health for the services you own, then jump into building features that millions of customers will use at checkout. You might spend the morning pairing with a teammate on a system design for a new agentic purchase flow, then write and test code in the afternoon. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers and researchers, and business intelligence engineers to create the best purchase experiences for our customers.

About the team
The Checkout team's mission is to offer the most trusted and easy purchase experience on Earth. Collectively our team builds experiences that empower customers to collect and manage the items they intend to buy; provide the critical order details that enable them to make informed purchase decisions; surface contextual product and program-related benefits/recommendations to help them basket build and deepen their relationship with Amazon. We celebrate purchase completion while guiding them towards the next step of their shopping journey. Our team of builders owns the software, systems, and processes that enable 300+ teams at Amazon to innovate on behalf of our customers each year in the final stages of a customer’s purchase journey. We are investing in modernizing our platform and launching agentic purchasing capabilities.

We care deeply about building an inclusive environment where everyone can be successful. We also invest in our people: you will get four weeks of innovation time per year to work on passion projects or build generative AI solutions, meeting-free Fridays for focused work, a monthly learning day to explore new skills, and two weeks per year dedicated to hackathons and group learning.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX)
jobs.description:
As a Principal Engineer in Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), you will be one of the most senior technical leaders in the organization, setting technical direction for platforms and services that thousands of Amazon builders depend on. You will tackle ambiguous, large-scale problems that span multiple teams and systems, and translate them into clear, durable technical strategies.

Principal Engineers at Amazon are hands-on technologists and force multipliers. You will combine deep technical expertise with broad influence — writing and reviewing designs, raising the engineering bar, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering with engineering leaders to make the right long-term architectural and investment decisions. Your work will directly shape developer experience, software quality, delivery velocity, and operational safety at Amazon scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Set and drive technical strategy for complex, high-impact platforms and services used broadly across Amazon's engineering community.
- Decompose ambiguous, large-scale problems into simple, scalable, and maintainable solutions, and define multi-year technical roadmaps.
- Lead the design and architecture of distributed systems that operate reliably at massive scale.
- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, operational excellence practices, and mentorship of senior and principal-track engineers.
- Partner with engineering, product, and science leaders to align technical direction with organizational goals and customer needs.
- Identify and prioritize the highest-leverage opportunities to improve how Amazon builders develop, build, test, deploy, and operate software — including opportunities created by Generative AI and agentic development.
- Influence engineering standards and best practices across team and organizational boundaries.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, SoC HAL
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon at the heart of AWS machine learning servers, and we are hiring a senior engineer to own the architecture of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) that brings these chips to life. If you love working where hardware meets software, writing the code that boots, configures, and debugs some of the largest custom silicon in the world, this is your team.

As a Software Development Engineer III on the SoC HAL team, you will set the software architecture for the driver stack across multiple hardware blocks and chip generations, partner directly with the hardware designers who build the silicon, and raise the engineering bar for a small, fast-moving team inside a large organization. No machine learning background is required (you will pick up ML concepts from colleagues if you want to). This role can be based in Cupertino, CA or Austin, TX.


Key job responsibilities

- Own the design and end-to-end implementation of the HAL/driver software architecture for new chips, including the abstractions, interfaces, and patterns the rest of the team builds against.
- Apply hardware/software co-design principles, partnering early with RTL designers and design verification engineers to shape the manageability and debuggability of the silicon before tape-out.
- Deliver and maintain HAL blocks across the stack (for example PCIe, DDR / HBM memory, DMA, system fabric, interrupt controllers, and boot / firmware), and support prior chips with feature additions and bug fixes.
- Set the standard for how the team tests and continuously deploys the software stack to internal customers, including pre-silicon and hardware-in-the-loop flows.
- Make durable, well-reasoned technical tradeoffs and drive cross-team decisions that span hardware, firmware, and higher-layer system software.
- Mentor and coach other engineers, lead design and code reviews, and act as a technical lead for architecture and engineering best practices.


A day in the life
A typical day moves between writing and reviewing C++ for the HAL, working through a hardware interface question with an RTL or design verification engineer, and shaping the architecture for a block still being designed. You might debug a failure spanning software and silicon, then define the abstractions a new chip will need. Your stakeholders are the hardware design, verification, firmware, and system-software teams; your customers are the internal software teams that rely on the HAL to boot, configure, and debug the chip. Problems range from talking to brand-new hardware to scaling the stack across chip generations.


About the team
Annapurna Labs designs and deploys some of the largest custom silicon in the world, including the Trainium and Inferentia machine learning accelerators. Our SoC HAL team builds the low-level software that boots, configures, and manages these chips, sitting between the hardware and the system software that runs the server. We are a small team that works closely with hardware, holds a high engineering bar, and gives engineers real ownership to shape the architecture they build. Split between Cupertino, CA and Austin, TX with no site preference, we value mentorship, clear written design, and software that outlasts any single chip.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, SIFT
jobs.description:
Every day, the people closest to our customers and partners learn things that matter — in meetings, in deal rooms, in the field. For years most of that went nowhere useful: stuck in an inbox, a memory, a note no one opened again. We changed that. We built a product that captures those raw field inputs, automatically finds the patterns hiding across thousands of them, and uses AI to turn what used to be hours of manual report-writing into minutes — and it's now part of how a large, fast-growing community does its job every day.

That's the part that makes this interesting: it already works, at real scale, for a lot of people — and that raises the bar rather than lowering it. The hard problems now are the ones you only get to when something is genuinely in production and genuinely depended on. How do you keep quality high as usage climbs and the data gets messier? How do you make AI-generated output people trust instead of double-check? How do you extend a system people already rely on without breaking what they count on? This is applied AI in the critical path of real work — where "mostly right" isn't good enough and someone notices the moment it's off.

That's where you come in.

Here's the kind of thing you'd own and solve:

- Scale what's already working.
Take services that are live and heavily used and make them faster, sturdier, and ready for the next order of magnitude of users and data.

- Grow what the product can connect to.
Expand the set of tools and integrations the system exposes through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so the product can plug into more data sources and let AI assistants do more on a user's behalf — safely and reliably.

- Raise the quality bar on AI output.
Improve how the product turns messy, free-form input into trustworthy, structured, searchable records — with smarter summarization, tagging, and quality gating so strong output ships and weak output doesn't.

- Extend the product thoughtfully.
Add new capabilities and data sources to a system people already depend on, without disrupting the workflows they rely on every day.

- Make the trends sharper.
Improve how the product spots patterns across a huge body of individual stories, so people see what's emerging without digging for it.

- Let people talk to their data.
Build and refine the natural-language experiences that let someone ask for what they need — and get an answer built from real data, and only the data they're allowed to see.

- Keep it healthy.
Own the reliability and operations of what you build, dig into production issues when they happen, and raise the operational bar for the whole team.

What sets this apart: you're joining something that already succeeded — and the interesting work is everything that comes next. You get the best of both worlds: the real users, real feedback, and real impact of a product in heavy use, plus a wide-open set of hard problems around scaling it, deepening the AI, and taking it places it hasn't gone yet. You'll make architectural calls that matter, see your impact quickly because the people using it will tell you exactly what's working, and be expected to lift the engineers around you — mentoring, reviewing designs, and being someone who makes the whole team sharper, not just your own code.

We're looking for someone who's built and operated real backend systems at scale, is comfortable improving a live product without breaking it, and is genuinely excited about applying AI to a hard, valuable problem rather than chasing the buzz. Hands-on experience with generative AI and large language models is a strong prerequisite — and familiarity with Amazon Bedrock in particular will set you up to make an impact fast. If you like owning things end to end, caring about the person on the other side of the screen, and raising the bar on something people already love — you'll feel at home here.

Key job responsibilities
You'll own features end to end — from the user interface down to the backend services behind them — designing, building, and running them in production, where real people rely on them every day.

- Own whole features from the screen a user sees to the services and data underneath, making the design calls across the full stack and shipping each one to production.
- Build and scale the services that turn raw, free-form field input into structured, searchable, trustworthy records — keeping them fast and reliable as usage grows.
- Expand the tools and integrations the product exposes through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), connecting it to more data sources and letting AI assistants safely do more on a user's behalf.
- Wire large language models into the product and raise the quality bar on what they produce — sharper summarization, tagging, and quality gating so strong output ships and weak output doesn't.
- Build the natural-language experiences that let people ask for what they need and get answers grounded in real data — and only the data they're allowed to see.
- Write the design docs, run code reviews, debug the gnarly production issues, and mentor the engineers around you.

A day in the life
You're working where solid engineering meets applied AI — shipping real features people use the moment they go out.

You might push a feature you own from the screen a user sees down to the service behind it: write the code, get it reviewed, shepherd it through testing into production. A good chunk of your time goes into making the AI better — tuning how it drafts and summarizes, then checking the output against real examples to prove it improved. As one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push this product even further. As our database continues to grow, we need to scale the product even further. We are rearchitecting DynamoDB’s global footprint to make it even more scalable.
DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions.

The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on building services that operate at a massive scale and are responsible for routing large amount of data. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

- Design, Develop, Manage, optimize, and re-imagine highly distributed, large-scale services.

- Be hands on. Work with others on the engineering team to manage day-to-day development activities, participate in designs, design reviews, code reviews, and implementation.
- Deliver quality features on-time and on-budget. Execute against project plans and delivery commitments.
- Contribute to the intellectual property of Amazon through patents and external publications.

A day in the life
Amazon DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

jobs.description:
Ever wonder what happens in the milliseconds between a customer scrolling and seeing a relevant ad? The Ad Events Hub team builds the infrastructure behind that moment — processing trillions of ads daily at a scale few teams in the industry ever touch. Your work will appear on Amazon.com and dozens of other websites, reaching tens of millions of customers and driving measurable revenue impact.

We build and operate the data systems powering the ad serving stack across Amazon's advertising businesses — including a signal intelligence layer that transforms raw session behavior into real-time signals and a distributed ultra-scale caching layer. These are tier-1 systems running at four 9s availability and five 9s reliability. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineers, Scientists, Product Managers, and Program Managers to build new advertising experiences, and grow technical skills in an environment built on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and own tier-1 services that determine ad-serving eligibility across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
- Build global, auto-scalable, high-throughput services that work across all ad programs — from campaign management through event logging
- Collaborate with software engineers, scientists, Product Managers, and Program Managers to deliver compelling advertiser and customer experiences
- Set technical direction for services spanning multiple Sponsored Ad programs, contributing to architectural decisions that ensure sustained, rapid feature delivery
- Lead and inspire teammates to raise the bar on software quality, reliability, and operational excellence

At Audible, we cherish the diverse backgrounds and perspectives within our team, recognizing that they are essential for fostering robust conversations and finding the right solutions for our customers. We encourage each individual to bring their unique experiences to the table, knowing that diversity fuels our creativity, enriches our collaborative efforts, and leads to better outcomes. By embracing differing viewpoints, we unlock the full potential of our team and create a culture of inclusion and respect.

We have exciting opportunities that will challenge you to leverage your technical expertise and make a significant impact. As a technical role model and high-impact contributor, you will have the chance to work alongside a team of exceptionally talented individuals who share your passion for innovation and success. Together, you will create transformative experiences for our audience.

ABOUT YOU
You feel pride in every step forward, however big or small. We look for individuals who take ownership of their work, show initiative, and set high standards. - Design, develop, and test software components and applications for one of the largest creator and provider of audiobooks in the world
- Collaborate with stakeholders to imagine, design, develop, test, and launch software that impacts our customers and inspires your peers
- Be proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is (and isn’t) appropriate to use them
- Independently clarify technical requirements, assessing development estimates and apply a broad range of design approaches
- Review code of other team members and provide constructive direction
- Mentor and lead developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon 1P Credito
jobs.description:
Are you excited about building the future of digital lending at massive scale? Do you want to design and build systems that power credit experiences for millions of customers in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing fintech markets?

The Credit & Lending team at Amazon Pay is building Amazon's next-generation lending platform to enable seamless credit experiences for millions of customers across Latin America. We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer to join our Brazil engineering team and build highly scalable, resilient lending systems from the ground up.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You'll design and deliver critical components of the lending platform including underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, regulatory reporting, and customer-facing experiences. You'll work with latest fintech challenges: real-time decisioning, payment orchestration, compliance automation, and financial data integrity at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants deep ownership, loves solving hard technical problems, and is energized by the ambiguity and pace of building something new in a regulated, high-stakes domain.

What You'll Do
Design and build core services for the 1P Lending platform in Brazil—spanning underwriting, servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Write high-quality, production-ready code for backend and Frontend services, with a focus on reliability, testability, and operational excellence.
Own system architecture decisions for your area—API design, data modeling, event-driven flows, and integration patterns with internal and external partners.
Build for compliance—implement systems that meet Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank reporting, PIX, Open Finance) with auditability and data integrity baked in.
Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.
Solve ambiguous problems—break down complex business and regulatory requirements into clean, extensible technical solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.
Contribute to platform reuse—build shared libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns that enable scaling across LATAM markets.
Raise the bar—participate actively in code reviews, design reviews, and hiring. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team culture.

A day in the life
Own a critical product pillar of the 1P Lending platform in Brazil (define the product vision, technical strategy, and execution roadmap.
Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).
Establish operational excellence—own system availability, latency, monitoring, alarming, on-call processes, and incident management for your product area.
Influence the broader platform by contributing reusable components, shared libraries, and cross-market architectural patterns.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Promotions Calculations Lifecycle (PCL)
jobs.description:
Amazon’s Worldwide Deals and Promotions organization builds the systems that compute and apply promotional benefits to hundreds of millions of customer orders every day. The Promotions Calculations Lifecycle (PCL) team owns the checkout-time calculation path: deciding which promotions apply to a cart, how benefits combine, and what the customer ultimately pays — correctly, at low latency, and at worldwide scale.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) to own the design, build, and operation of services on this critical path. You will work on high-throughput, low-latency systems where correctness is customer-facing and measured in real money. This is a hands-on engineering role for a builder who enjoys deep technical ownership, solving ambiguous problems with team members, and raising the operational bar for services that must work worldwide on Day 1.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end to end the design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operation of components and services on the promotions calculation path, from design document through post-launch monitoring.
- Design and build scalable, low-latency services and features that compute promotional benefits correctly at checkout for customers worldwide.
- Raise code quality through thorough, timely code reviews, strong testing practices, and secure, maintainable, well-instrumented code.
- Drive operational excellence — participate in on-call, reduce operational load through automation, and constructively identify and fix sources of defects and toil.
- Collaborate across teams with partner engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver cross-functional initiatives that span multiple months.
- Work through ambiguity by breaking down loosely defined problems, unblocking yourself and others, and making pragmatic decisions that move the team forward.
- Mentor and uplevel peers and newer engineers through design feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

A day in the life
A typical week combines focused building with the collaboration and operational rigor that keep a Tier-1 service healthy. You might start the day reviewing a design document for a change to how benefits combine at checkout, then pair with a teammate on the Universal Benefit Service (UBS) to reduce calculation latency on a high-traffic path. You will write and review code, add tests and metrics, and ship changes through the team’s continuous deployment pipeline.

You will take part in the on-call rotation for services the team owns, using operational signals to find and remove recurring sources of defects and toil. You will work with partner teams across Worldwide Deals and Promotions, and with product managers, to turn ambiguous requirements into concrete designs. You will also invest in the people around you — giving design feedback, mentoring newer engineers, and sharing what you learn so the whole team levels up.

About the team
The Promotions Calculations Lifecycle (PCL) team sits within Amazon’s Worldwide Deals and Promotions organization. We own the checkout-time path that determines which promotions apply to a customer’s cart, how those benefits combine, and the final price the customer pays. Our services run worldwide and are on the critical ordering path, so correctness, availability, and latency are first-order requirements — the systems we build directly shape both the customer experience and Amazon’s financials.

We are a team of builders who value deep technical ownership, operational excellence, and raising the bar for one another. We invest in mentorship and career growth, work backwards from the customer, and take pride in making complex systems simpler and more reliable over time. You will join a group where your work is highly visible, your decisions matter, and there is ample room to grow as an engineer.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
The Off-Search Online Sourcing team builds the real-time ad retrieval systems behind every Detail Page, Home Page, and non-Search surface on Amazon — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes. You'll design and deliver the low-latency services, model serving infrastructure, and distributed indexing pipelines that determine which ads shoppers see, enriched with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so ads surface products that can reach customers quickly.

This is a team that ships fast — rapidly experimenting with new models, indexes, and signals in production through A/B experiments to grow both advertiser results and shopper engagement. You'll partner closely with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models from research into production, and use experimental results to decide what ships.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency services that retrieve and enrich ad candidates within strict latency budgets across Amazon's non-Search surfaces
- Build and scale model serving infrastructure for real-time embedding inference, partnering with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models into production
- Develop distributed indexing pipelines that build and refresh large approximate nearest neighbor search indexes across hundreds of millions of ads
- Deliver real-time fulfillment signals — delivery speed, locality, return eligibility — that improve ad filtering and ranking quality for shoppers
- Launch new retrieval models and indexes behind A/B experiments, analyze results, and use data to decide what ships to production
- Deliver features end to end — from design and code reviews through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and on-call operations
- Improve operational excellence through caching, graceful degradation, monitoring, and root-cause analysis
- Mentor peers through code and design reviews, helping raise the engineering quality bar across the team

A day in the life
On a typical day you might start by reviewing latency dashboards for your retrieval services, then dive into building a new distributed pipeline to refresh a nearest neighbor index. After lunch, you could be partnering with an applied scientist to integrate a new embedding model into the serving path, setting up the A/B experiment framework to measure its impact. Between coding sessions, you'll review pull requests, debug a latency regression, and check on the results of a running experiment to decide whether a new signal improves shopper engagement enough to ship.

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry-leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace.

The Off-Search Online Sourcing team within SPB builds the real-time systems that choose which ads shoppers see on the Detail Page, Home Page, and other Amazon pages — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and enriching every candidate with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so shoppers see ads for products that can reach them quickly.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Frustration Free Setup
jobs.description:
Frustration Free Setup (FFS) team is looking for a talented, experienced engineer to develop device setup solutions for Amazon and third-party products. The role focuses on creating seamless customer experiences through SDK development and cloud services integration. You will join a team responsible for setup experiences across Amazon devices (Echo, Fire TV, Fire Tablets, and Kindle) and third-party devices with Alexa integration.

Software development engineer positions require both depth and breadth of knowledge in design and development, experience with agile methodologies, proficiency in a high-level language, experience building highly scalable systems involving distributed services and persistent storage. You will own the design of major deliverables and have opportunities to build them from scratch. This is a high visibility and fast-paced environment where you will make a direct impact on the customer experience and the bottom line of the company.

Successful candidates are creative, innovative, and take great pride in both the deep technical contribution and the positive business results of their work. They are capable of translating high-level, ambiguous business goals into working software solutions.


Key job responsibilities
As an SDE in this group, you will lead and mentor other talented engineers. You will be responsible for building the best customer experience, keeping latency, security, and usability in mind. You will interact with Product Managers and Designers and convert their vision into a technical solution. You will collaborate with other Software Engineers to guide the team on development best practices and set examples by using them in solutions that you build.

This position requires in-depth knowledge of design and development of interactive applications. You should have experience with agile methodologies, working experience with at least one high level programming language, and experience building scalable and robust solutions. You will own the end-to-end design of major deliverables, working closely with a team of SDEs and Product Managers to execute them.

About the team
Frustration-Free Setup (FFS) is an Amazon program that enables Device manufacturers to incorporate technology to make device setup as easy for customers as opening a box and powering on a device. We’ve done the hard work behind the scenes to make the customer’s experience delightfully fast and straightforward. FFS integrates into most device types - including smart speakers, cameras, TVs, and health devices.

jobs.title: SDE II, AVMS, AVMS
jobs.description:
Our customers are Amazon, internal stakeholders, and Amazon’s customers. Our engineers work directly with stakeholders, get close to customers' needs, and are empowered to take technical risks to build the best-in-class software with respect to quality, scale, and insights. The technical foundation this team builds, helps keep all of Amazon (Fulfillment Centers, Physical Stores, Whole Foods, Fresh, etc.) secure.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Shopping Personalization AI
jobs.description:
Amazon's Personalization organization builds the AI systems behind how hundreds of millions of customers discover and shop. We extract and reason over customer signals in real time, power LLM-driven recommendation experiences, and build AI-native discovery surfaces that combine products, content, and contextual recommendations. Our work sits at the intersection of generative AI, large-scale distributed systems, and customer-facing products, delivered through high-performance web and mobile experiences at Amazon scale.

In this role you'll design and build features that shape how customers discover products - tailored to their preferences, helping them find exactly what they need, even before they know they need it. We're defining how LLMs integrate into real-time personalization, how noisy behavioral signals become durable customer understanding, and how AI-powered experiences ship reliably at scale. You'll work across multiple technical teams, ship iteratively, and see your work in the hands of customers quickly. This organization values experimentation, moves fast, and gives engineers real ownership over what they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who leads through technical depth and sound judgment. Someone who owns team-level architecture, provides system-wide design guidance, and brings perspective on both current and future technology choices. You take on customer problems where the technological strategy is not yet defined, and you drive productive discussions to align teams on the best path forward. You don’t just deliver high-quality software yourself - you set the standard that others follow. You actively mentor multiple engineers, drive adoption of engineering best practices, and ensure your team has strong operational foundations. You make the team permanently stronger, not dependent on your presence. When the right solution isn’t technical - when it’s a process change, a culture shift, or a staffing decision - you recognize that and act accordingly.

Key job responsibilities
- Own team architecture of personalized recommendation system operating at Amazon scale
- Lead the design and delivery of cross-teams projects end-to-end, with focus on maintainability, scalability, performance, and reliability
- Collaborate with Product and Science to define technical roadmap and experiences based on data
- Build AI-powered experiences including personalized recommendations, relevance explanations, and knowledge-driven features using LLMs and generative AI
- Define and drive measurement strategies including analytics events and experiment configurations to track business and technical metrics
- Create clarity from ambiguity and make sound technical decisions in a problem space where established patterns don't apply
- Drive adoption of engineering best practices through exemplary personal coding practices
- Proactively simplify existing systems and resolve endemic, root-cause problems

About the team
Our team is part of Amazon's Personalization organization, a high-performing group that leverages Amazon's expertise in machine learning, big data, distributed systems, and user experience design to deliver the best shopping experiences for our customers.

Our vision is to enhance customer shopping experience on Amazon by leveraging personalization techniques. We strive to save customers valuable time by tailoring their journey to their individual needs, interests, and preferences. Our goal involves identifying personalization opportunities to develop and optimize customer experiences, thereby improving the overall search and discovery process across Amazon.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Embedded, Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are the SpaceSDK and LLP team.
SpaceSDK is a framework for generating, building, and running software applications for satellite components that run embedded Linux. The SDK is used by applications across Amazon Leo systems to to manage concurrency, inter-process communication and to provide common functionality.
LLP (Low Level Platform) is an RTOS platform for smaller resource constrained micro-controller based components on the satellite.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop embedded software in Rust, C++, or other modern languages.
Write system applications for the various satellite systems and device interfaces like CAN, I2C, etc.
Scale up SpaceSDK and LLP to support an increasing number of Satellite components and/or features.
Board bring-up and porting
Develop monitoring and telemetry for Satellite components.
Develop security features for satellite systems.
Collaborate with other software and hardware teams
Troubleshoot and solve critical issues on satellites orbiting in space
Be a champion for the quality, reliability and security of critical code.

A day in the life
We are a fast paced team working on developing and maintaining a critical software framework used by key components on a satellite. We like to solve challenging software engineering problems, as well as root cause failures on in-orbit satellites and help mission control recover satellites.

We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space-based systems design. Come help us solve the difficult and rewarding development challenges in building highly reliable, efficient and low-cost satellite!

jobs.title: Senior SDE, UTR Automation

You will play an important role in developing technology that will transform the future of delivery, working on challenging problems at unprecedented scale. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) onboard, learn, receive coaching, improve performance, and collaborate with AI to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS EKS
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer to join our growing Amazon Elastic Container Services for Kubernetes (EKS) team. Amazon EKS is our managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy for customers to use Kubernetes without needing to become experts in provisioning and operating Kubernetes. EKS manages time-consuming administrative tasks like setting up, operating, scaling and updating Kubernetes, freeing customers up to focus on their applications.

The EKS Networking team builds the networking stack that connects customer workloads running on EKS clusters. We own the VPC CNI, which runs in the majority of EKS clusters worldwide, and an eBPF-based network policy enforcement path that replaced third-party dependencies with a native implementation. We are now building a service mesh, an Istio or Istio-like capability (traffic management, mTLS, policy, and observability) that avoids the per-pod sidecar tax by leaning on the kernel and the networking stack we already own. You will be joining a fast paced team working on greenfield projects, building the control plane for that mesh.

You will own the control plane: the system that turns customer intent (routing rules, policy, identity) into live configuration distributed to the data path across large clusters. You own service discovery, the config-distribution surface, and the mTLS identity and certificate-rotation story end to end. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design and build the control plane that distributes configuration to the mesh data path at scale, including the config-distribution protocol (xDS or equivalent) and its efficiency and convergence properties.
- Own service discovery and endpoint health across large, high-churn clusters, including on-demand lookup patterns for very large endpoint counts rather than replicating full state everywhere.
- Own the mTLS identity story: SPIFFE-style identity issuance, certificate rotation, trust domains, and Layer 4 authorization policy.
- Guarantee control-loop correctness: convergence, staleness bounds, caching, and graceful behavior under failure.
- Partner with the data path, kernel/eBPF, and protocols engineers whose subsystems consume the configuration you distribute.
- Raise the bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers on the team.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Off-Amazon Selection
jobs.description:
Lead and grow a team of software engineers building internet-scale catalog, discovery, and commerce systems for Off-Amazon Selection (OAS). You will own the technical vision, roadmap, and operational excellence for distributed systems that make the world's selection discoverable and shoppable. Partnering with Applied Scientists, you'll apply Large Language Models and generative AI to build intelligent primitives that transform how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products across Amazon surfaces. You'll recruit and develop engineers, drive architecture in ambiguous problem spaces, and deliver robust, scalable systems at Amazon scale while earning trust with product, science, and partner engineering teams.

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will build, lead, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers, setting a high bar for quality and for the engineers you hire, mentor, and develop at every level. You will own the technical vision, roadmap, and architecture for distributed catalog, discovery, and commerce systems at internet scale, pioneering AI-native software development and partnering closely with Applied Scientists to build intelligent primitives that change how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products. You will own the full software development life cycle, from design through deployment and operational excellence, driving services at Amazon scale with instrumented health signals so issues are caught early and decisions are data driven. Most of all, you will thrive where problems are not yet well defined, turning ambiguous, cross team challenges into clear plans with owners and dates, and earning the trust of product, science, and partner engineering teams along the way. It is a rare chance to shape both the systems and the team that make the world's selection discoverable and shoppable for customers everywhere.

A day in the life
As SDM for Off-Amazon Selection, no two days look the same. You might unblock an engineer on a catalog ingestion design, then join a working session with Applied Scientists on how an LLM-powered capabilities handles product matching at scale. You will review design docs, weigh in on architectural trade-offs, and sequence a multi-quarter roadmap against ambiguous requirements. You will invest in your people through 1:1s, career conversations, hiring, and coaching.

About the team
Off-Amazon Selection builds the next generation of catalog, discovery, and commerce systems that make the world's selection discoverable and shoppable for customers. We work at the intersection of distributed systems and applied science, using machine learning and generative AI to solve problems at scale. We think in terms of durable primitives and mechanisms rather than one-off features, building for scale, reliability, and reuse. We are a collaborative, high-ownership team that values camaraderie, diverse perspectives, and a strong engineering culture, and we tackle ambiguous, challenging problems together.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, EC2 Nitro Networking , EC2 Nitro Networking
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Identity and Registry, AWS IoT Core
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS IoT Core enables billions of devices to connect securely to the cloud — and the Identity and Registry team is at the heart of it. We own the foundational primitives that give every IoT device its identity, manage its metadata, and govern how it interacts with the cloud at massive scale.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that customers rely on to provision, authenticate, and manage their IoT fleets — from a single prototype to billions of devices in production. You'll work on challenges spanning distributed systems, security, identity management, and scalable metadata storage and retrieval, directly shaping the experience for some of the world's largest IoT deployments.

This is a high-impact role where your work will be felt across the entire AWS IoT platform and by customers spanning multiple industries — from smart home and automotive to broadcasting and industrial automation. If you're excited about building foundational infrastructure that operates at Internet of Things scale and solving hard problems in device identity and registry, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain core services that power device identity and state management for AWS IoT Core, serving billions of devices worldwide
- Build and operate highly available, low-latency distributed systems that handle device provisioning, authentication, metadata and state management
- Own the full software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain a high engineering bar across the team
- Contribute to system architecture by authoring and reviewing design documents, identifying trade-offs, and proposing solutions to complex technical problems
- Improve operational excellence by building monitoring, alarming, and automation tooling; participate in on-call rotations and drive root cause analysis for operational events
- Collaborate cross-functionally with other AWS IoT teams to deliver integrated customer experiences
- Mentor and support fellow engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, and constructive code reviews
- Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, developer productivity, and system efficiency, including leveraging AI to automate workflows, enhance testing, and accelerate delivery

A day in the life
You'll spend focused time writing code — building new APIs, tuning system performance to reduce latency at billion-device scale, or improving provisioning workflows. You'll collaborate with teammates through design reviews and code reviews, and partner with other IoT Core teams on cross-cutting features. Some days you'll dig into customer escalations, tracing issues through logs and metrics. Other days you'll experiment with AI tools to improve engineering processes. No two days are the same, but every day you're building the foundation that enables billions of devices to connect to AWS IoT.

The Identity and Registry team owns the foundational services at the core of AWS IoT — device identity, registry, shadow, and provisioning. We build and operate systems that enable billions of devices to securely connect, be managed, and interact with the cloud. Our team values operational excellence, customer obsession, and a strong ownership culture where every engineer has a direct impact. We're a collaborative group that enjoys tackling hard distributed systems problems together, and we're committed to growing each other through mentorship and open technical debate. We're looking for builders who are excited to work at IoT scale.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.
