jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
jobs.description:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , Amazon Foundational Security Services (AFSS)

Arlington, VA, USA | Herndon, VA, USA

When was the last time you heard of a cyber-attack that took down a host of companies due to poor Authentication controls? Likely a few times in the last few months. Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud or a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, AWS Security is the place for you.



Key job responsibilities

There is ample opportunity to innovate and deliver high impact outcomes. You will collaborate with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that will influence the Amazon developer experience. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle across the entire Amazon development community, including design, implementation, documentation, deployment, and operations across multiple products.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Lambda, AWS Lambda Control Plane
jobs.description:
Software Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin)

When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. The machinery that makes that possible is the control plane: the systems that validate, orchestrate, and propagate every function's state so the data plane can execute it flawlessly at any scale.

As part of the team you'll design, build, and operate the distributed systems that sit between customers and the Lambda data plane:

You'll own the full path from API request to running function. The APIs you build are the public surface of Lambda — high-throughput, strictly consistent, globally available — serving customers and CloudFormation alike. Behind those APIs, you'll design the asynchronous workflows that orchestrate a function's lifecycle: taking a customer's intent — a new function, a code deploy, a version publish — and propagating it safely to the systems that actually execute functions. That means solving metadata propagation at global scale: ensuring every configuration change reaches the right compute fleet, in the right region, with the right ordering guarantees, even under partial failures.

We operate at the scale of one of the largest services in AWS. Availability is a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought.

What we're looking for

- Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production — the kind where "retry" isn't a strategy, it's a starting point.
- Comfort with ambiguity: you'll own problems end-to-end, from API contract through data-plane handoff.
- Strong fundamentals in at least one of: Java, Python, or TypeScript (our stack spans all three).
- A bias toward simple, operable solutions — systems that are easy to reason about at 3 AM.

About the team
We're a Dublin-based engineering team within AWS Lambda. We invest in growing engineers through meaningful ownership, direct mentorship, and exposure to problems that don't have textbook answers. We value diverse perspectives and hire for collaboration — the best systems here are built by teams, not individuals.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II - AWS Networking Applications, SIDR
jobs.description:
What do we do here? Amazon Web Services runs one of the largest networks in the world. Our organization designed a new routing protocol built for the demands of modern workloads, and our team built the control plane that implements it — governing how traffic moves across the fabrics of the Amazon data center network, reacting to both static topology and real-time state at a scale few systems operate at.

Why now? Our control plane is expanding to cover more of AWS's network, and we're growing the team to match. We're looking for a software engineer who wants to go deep on large-scale distributed systems, hyperscale data center networks, SDN, and global software deployment.

What you'll do?
- Design and build the stateful control-plane software that applies intended network state across thousands of devices and guarantees they converge correctly and safely — including failure handling and rollback.
- Own features end-to-end: requirements, design, implementation, code review, worldwide deployment, and operations.
- Work with partner teams and customers to bring new algorithms and capabilities into production at scale.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Rust, C++, Java, Go)
- Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services
- Solid grasp of CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with large-scale, fault-tolerant systems and operational ownership (on-call, incident response)
- Exposure to Rust, or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on a new language
- Experience reasoning about consistency, coordination, or state machines in distributed systems

Who we are: a highly motivated team of software developers who thrive on hard distributed-systems problems and building at a scale few engineers get to work on. If you like working hard, having fun, and making history — talk to us.

Who are we looking for? Smart, talented engineers who like hard problems. Networking background not required — we'll teach you. Come work hard, have fun, and make history with us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Leo Security
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for a senior software development engineer to be a founding engineer on the Engineering and R&D team within Leo Space Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. You will build a neuro-symbolic reasoning platform: large language model agents combined with a knowledge graph and real-time asset state store that ground every conclusion in verifiable fact, so every automated decision is auditable. The platform automates incident response, threat analysis, offensive security testing, and detection authoring, backed by a high-throughput streaming pipeline that takes a detection from concept to production in hours. This is a unique opportunity to build a security platform from early stage through global scale, at a consequence level few teams ever encounter.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.


Key job responsibilities
You will own architecture decisions across the platform, providing system-wide design guidance and ensuring our services are secure, scalable, and operationally simple. You will design and build the distributed systems that carry the platform, from telemetry ingestion and real-time correlation through agent execution and observability, in an environment where a wrong automated action has real operational consequences. You will drive automation relentlessly: replacing manual security operations with software, building the evaluation and backtesting infrastructure that proves a model or detection is correct before it is trusted in production, and creating deployment guardrails that prevent human error in high-consequence environments. You will partner with applied scientists to turn research prototypes into production capabilities, mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and set the standard for code quality across the team. You will operate what you build, owning operational health, incident response, and reliability for services the security organization depends on.

A day in the life
One morning you might lead a design review for a new detection pipeline stage, challenging the team to eliminate every manual step and asking what happens when each component fails or is fed hostile input. That afternoon you could be writing code to tighten the guardrails on an agent tool, or profiling the correlation path to shave seconds off the time from event to detection. The next day you might investigate an anomalous pattern in your service metrics, treating it as hostile until proven otherwise, then work with a scientist to backtest a candidate detection against retained telemetry before it ships. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platform, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and question any process that relies on a human doing the right thing under pressure. The team is new, so the architecture decisions you make now will carry the platform for years.

About the team
Leo Space Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R\&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains.

#### Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

#### Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#### Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Within the engineering group, we develop world-class solutions to complex scientific and engineering problems at Amazon scale. You will work alongside world-class scientists to build a suite of fully automated, scalable, and robust products driven by the data systems you develop.

As Prime expands its science-driven capabilities globally, we are growing the engineering team to meet increasing demand for reliable, high-throughput data infrastructure. Do you want to work with Amazon's best engineers on hard problems at massive scale? Do you want to impact over 300 million Prime members worldwide? Are you someone who likes using big data to drive high-impact business decisions? If so, come join our team!

Build and maintain big data pipelines for machine learning applications at Amazon scale, ensuring stability and performance across terabyte-sized datasets
Advance data engineering infrastructure using tools such as AWS Glue, Spark, Amazon EMR, and EMR Serverless to support science and analytics workloads
Design and implement proactive data quality monitoring and alerting (e.g., anomaly detection) across production pipelines to safeguard downstream models
Collaborate with scientists and analysts to create coherent data models and analysis-ready datasets that improve the customer experience for over 300 million members worldwide

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Corporate Development Finance
jobs.description:
The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — more than $200 billion in value across 700+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury.

When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset).

We are a small, high-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen.

You will manage a team of 2 to 4 software developers - setting technical direction, unblocking the team, conducting code reviews, and raising the bar on engineering quality. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end-to-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.

Tech stack: a serverless, event-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure-as-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI-assisted development tools used daily.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the architecture and the hardest technical problems in IMS, including the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree.

• Own the data model and the financial calculations (such as internal rate of return, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress), and write the code and tests that the rest of the team builds on.

• Build the React web application that business users work in every day, and own the Amazon Bedrock–based AI assistant that lets them ask questions about the portfolio in plain language.

• Work directly with leaders across the M&A ecosystem to turn open-ended requests into concrete requirements, sequence the work, manage dependencies, and deliver each program. You own the outcome, not just your part of it.

• Run the deadline-bound work the team cannot miss, including the quarterly close.

• Lead integrations with partner data teams across multiple systems.

• Define infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, raise the bar in code and design reviews, and keep stakeholders and engineers aligned as work progresses.

About the team
Corporate Development Finance (CDF) is a cross-functional team that serves as the finance partner to Amazon’s corporate venture capital funds (the Industrial Innovation Fund, the Alexa Fund, and the Climate Pledge Fund), to Amazon’s warrant program, and to portfolio management across Amazon’s global investment and warrant portfolio. The team comprises finance professionals, program managers, and technical roles building the infrastructure to support a growing and increasingly complex portfolio.

We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Are you inspired to work with a team than launches products with direct and massive impact on Amazon’s customers? Are you excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services?

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.
See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Software Development Engineers to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

As a developer on our team, you’ll own code end-to-end from design to development, and work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. You’ll have a sound understanding of computer science fundamentals and practical industry experience, working across the stack with technology involving Front-End technologies like React, open-source libraries, a full-stack code base, MicroServices, Data platforms, and more.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
jobs.description:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Senior SDE, OpenSearch, AWS OpenSearch
jobs.description:
Are you interested in building security for a cloud-scale distributed log analytics and search platform? Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage and secure vast volumes of data in the cloud? Do you want to have direct and immediate impact on a large number of AWS users? Do you want to be part of a fast-growing AWS service and work in a fast paced startup style environment?

Amazon Opensearch service makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale Opensearch (for log analytics, application monitoring, full-text search, and more! Amazon Opensearch service is a fully managed service that delivers Opensearch’s easy-to-use APIs and real-time capabilities along with offering predictable performance and seamless scalability for production workloads.

The OpenSearch team is looking for innovative engineers with a passion for helping develop the next generation of security features to help users (both, opensource community users and AWS customers) secure and manage access to their data, all at cloud scale.

You should be somebody who enjoys working on complex system software, is customer-centric, and feels strongly about delivering results. You should be passionate about solving security hurdles in innovative ways. You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial feel of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale, and to gain top-notch experience in cloud computing. You'll be surrounded by people who are smart, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world class service is critical to customer success.

About OpenSearch
---------------------------
OpenSearch is a community-driven, Apache 2.0-licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases with innovations in core search, vector search, and analytics capabilities. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine - one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Opensearch Security team, you will:
1. Design, develop and support security for a world-class platform serving individuals and businesses of all sizes
2. Building technologies that help customers strengthen their security posture and better meet security requirements in the AWS Cloud
3. Work at the core of the AWS OpenSearch service, with ample opportunities to contribute to open source
4. Work on challenging problems in areas such as data storage, query optimization, JVM performance optimization, security, machine learning and more.
5. You will join a team that values strong intuition, but seek metrics and other data sources to back up their assumptions.
6. Supporting plugin teams in meeting the security requirements for host logging, patching, and vulnerability detection.
7. Continually challenge what exists and explore what should be changed to best meet evolving customer needs
8. Participate in setting a vision and objectives for AWS OpenSearch in alignment with customer needs and market opportunities

jobs.description:
Want to help shape the future of one of the largest NoSQL database services on the planet?

The Amazon DynamoDB team is looking for deeply technical, team-first-mentality full stack software engineers who are willing to commit themselves to our goal to grow the business 10 times over the next 2 years.

DynamoDB is a key-value database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

You will be responsible to maintain a high bar in terms of execution, operational readiness, code and design quality. You will serve as a mentor for junior engineers and help them grow. You are comfortable working with other seasoned DynamoDB engineers and hold your ground during design and customer experience reviews.

This is a hands-on position where you will own everything from end to end: design, design reviews, implementation, code reviews, iterative feature launches, operations, mentoring, driving continuous improvement, and more.

Key job responsibilities
Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You’ll bring a passion for innovation, data, search, analytics, and distributed systems. You’ll also:

- Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
- Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions.
- Build high-quality, secure, performant, highly available, always-on products.
- Automate and improve repetitive operational processes.
- Deep dive and continuously improve performance to deliver superior customer experience.
- Scale distributed systems with optimal balance between performance and cost.

A day in the life

- Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
- Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

- Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Fauna
jobs.description:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer to build cloud services that keep the fleet humming. In this role, you will build the cloud foundation and applications that connect robots to customer experiences and internal operations as we scale.

The ideal candidate has built distributed systems that connect physical devices to cloud services end to end. They are comfortable building and operating the services they own from prototyping through launch and beyond. They make sound architectural tradeoffs across privacy, security, reliability, delivery speed, and cost when requirements are still evolving. They work effectively across robotics, product, and operations teams while remaining hands-on in design and implementation.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the cloud services that connect a growing fleet of robots to customer experiences and internal operations

- Build operational telemetry ingestion pipelines that process high-frequency robot signals

- Select technologies where the stack is undefined, document the decisions, and set patterns for a growing team

- Join the on-call rotation for the services you own and drive incident response

- Work with science, engineering, and product teams to define requirements and operationalize new workflows

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won't arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We're changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We're building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you'll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It's an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we're interested in hearing from you.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Leo AI Foundations, Amazon Leo AI Foundations
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's initiative to launch a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites to provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Leo AI Foundations team builds the intelligence that will run Leo as an AI-native business. We combine applied science and engineering with Leo's domain expertise, own the shared AI foundation for the business, and lead work that spans teams and systems, so that progress in one part of Leo becomes a capability the whole business can use. Leo Lens is our command center for this AI network. It is pioneering agentic AI for diagnostics, reporting, troubleshooting and mitigating issues across our end-to-end network stack, and it automates workflows for mission operations, ecommerce and developer use cases. Through Lens, it is our vision that agents work as one system to keep the network secure and reliable, resolving failures before customers experience them, while Leo's teams keep authority over consequential decisions.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead one of our engineering teams. You will own a roadmap in one of our tracks as we build the infrastructure for the AI that operates the network, from the agents themselves to the orchestration, knowledge access, evaluation and security controls that connect them. You will hire and grow a team of software engineers and applied scientists, partner with the domain teams that own satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and deliver production systems where reliability, security and measurable impact are the bar.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, lead and develop a team of software engineers and applied scientists, from hiring and onboarding through career growth and performance.
- Own the team's roadmap and delivery: translate the AI Foundations charter into goals, milestones and launches, and report progress and risks to senior leadership.
- Lead the technical design and architecture of agentic AI systems for Leo, covering agent development, data integration and the platform services that connect agents to Leo's knowledge and systems.
- Bring deep, current knowledge of AI, including large language models, agent frameworks, retrieval and evaluation methods, and apply it to guide the team's technical choices and to raise the AI fluency of the partner teams you work with.
- Deliver production AI systems with the evaluation, access controls and operational readiness required to act on a live network, and expand agent autonomy only as evidence shows it is safe and effective.
- Own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives, including infrastructure migrations and platform improvements, with domain teams who retain ownership of their services.
- Set and uphold the engineering bar for the team: design and security reviews, testing, operational excellence and on-call health.
- Make prioritization calls in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, balancing stability against new capabilities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because you are building something that has not existed before. You will set the direction for your team and remove what stands in its way. You will sit with the engineers and scientists who own Leo's satellites, gateways, customer terminals and network services, and decide with them how your team's expertise in AI can unblock them or move them faster. You will meet the operators who keep the network healthy and turn their hardest problems into the next capability Lens delivers. You will hire and grow the people who build this, and represent your work to Leo's senior leadership.

About the team
We are an AI-native team of software engineers and applied scientists in Redmond, and we move fast. We use AI in how we build, not only in what we build, so a good idea can be a working experiment the same week and a production capability the next. We think beyond how things have been done, test our ideas against real problems, and keep only what proves itself. We ship lightning fast, and we hold a high bar for quality and production readiness while doing it.

jobs.title: SDE-II, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? What if you could build the AI-powered systems that make that happen — and make it faster, cheaper, and more sustainable?

Watch this video to learn more about our organization, SCOT: http://bit.ly/amazon-scot

Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization is responsible for the end-to-end systems that plan, optimize, and execute the movement of billions of packages across the world's most complex logistics network. We build real-time, intelligent, and fully automated systems that touch every aspect of the delivery experience — from the moment a customer clicks "Buy" to the package arriving at their door.

What you'll work on:

What we're looking for:

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Mobile App Foundations, BuilderWorks

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.description:
Ever wonder what happens in the milliseconds between a customer scrolling and seeing a relevant ad? The Sponsored Products Marketplace AdClicks team builds the infrastructure behind that moment — processing trillions of ads daily at a scale few teams in the industry ever touch.

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help design, develop, and own large-scale, highly available services that centrally process advertising signals (ad impressions, views, clicks, video unmutes, and more) across Amazon's performance advertising businesses — including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

Our systems join millions of ad events per second from diverse sources, orchestrate business-specific enrichments (robotic traffic detection, validation of chargeable events, geotagging, event cardinality), and vend ad event data to power real-time campaign optimizations, attribution, reporting, analytics, and billing. You'll build services handling billions of requests per day while maintaining millisecond-level latencies and meeting strict SLA requirements — all operating on one of the world's largest product catalogs and massive distributed datasets.

A successful candidate will see their work live on Amazon.com and across numerous partner websites, viewed by tens of millions of customers, driving quantifiable revenue impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and own Tier-1 services that determine ad-serving eligibility across Performance Advertising Core Engine
- Set the technical vision for services spanning multiple Sponsored Ad programs (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display)
- Build global, auto-scalable, high-throughput services that work across all ad programs — from campaign management through event logging
- Collaborate with software engineers, Product Managers, and Program Managers to deliver compelling advertiser and customer experiences
- Advise senior leadership on technical opportunities and risks to ensure sustained, rapid feature delivery
- Lead and inspire teammates to raise the bar on software quality, reliability, and operational excellence
- Measure success through quality of execution, pace of innovation, and increased customer and advertiser satisfaction

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is reimagining the advertising landscape through industry-leading generative AI technologies — revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond.

We are at the forefront of reinventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle: from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We're a passionate group of innovators developing responsible, intelligent AI technologies that balance advertiser needs, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges at massive scale and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer , Hub Tech
jobs.description:
We are Lockers team! We solve the problem of package delivery to customers. A lot of time Amazon customers have to go through hassles of coordinating delivery time with carriers and are not able to receive their packages. We solve this problem for them. We allow customer to get their package (and do their returns) when and where they want. In other words, we make the package delivery asynchronous in nature. Is that an important problem? Our key stakeholders and dependencies are centralized under unified leadership, enabling us to make swift decisions and execute rapidly. Over the past three years, we've successfully launched two new products. Presently, we're embarking on the development of the latest generation of lockers designed to accept packages from any carrier or retailer, with robust return capabilities. This ambitious endeavor aims to facilitate a tenfold scale-up within the next three years, aligning with our strategic goals. Additionally, we offer various customer-facing features and maintain direct integration with retailers.

If you are looking for an opportunity to solve deep technical problems and build innovative solutions in a fast paced environment working with smart, passionate software developers, this might be the role for you. * Drive best practices and engineering excellence

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, Scaling Efficiency, CloudTune
jobs.description:

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end design, implementation, and operation of distributed systems that serve Amazon-scale workloads.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Simple Storage Service, S3 Express
jobs.description:
Managing trillions of objects, retrieving them in sub-millisecond time, deploying software to tens of thousands of hosts, and achieving 99.999999999% durability (yes, that's 11 nines). These numbers hint at the scale of problems you'll tackle every day on Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3). S3 powers businesses across the globe, and we are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team building the index layer of S3 Express, our high-performance storage tier. You will own the technical direction for your team's distributed systems, guide engineers through algorithmically complex challenges like noisy-neighbor isolation and sub-millisecond latency, and help shape what could become the largest data storage service on the planet. If you care deeply about growing people, inventing new solutions, and operating at cloud scale, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical vision and roadmap for the S3 Express NameSpace index layer, defining how the system evolves to meet customer latency and durability requirements over the next one to two years.
- Lead a team of software engineers through the full development lifecycle, including system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational health for distributed storage services running on tens of thousands of hosts.
- Drive solutions to complex performance problems such as noisy-neighbor isolation and sub-millisecond retrieval, partnering closely with front-end and storage system teams to deliver cohesive results.
- Build and develop an inclusive team of engineers by investing in coaching, career development planning, and strategic project assignments that grow future technical leaders.
- Establish operational metrics and audit mechanisms that give your team clear visibility into system performance, customer experience, and service reliability at scale.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing latency dashboards and durability metrics for the S3 Express index layer, then join a design review where your engineers walk through a proposal for reducing tail latency. After lunch, you could be working with the front-end systems team to align on an upcoming integration, followed by a one-on-one coaching session with an engineer preparing for their next career step. You'll move between strategic planning and hands-on technical guidance, ensuring your team has the context and support they need to ship high-quality software.

About the team
The S3 Express NameSpace team owns the index layer that underpins Amazon S3 Express, a high-performance storage tier built for workloads that demand single-digit-millisecond access. We sit within the broader Amazon S3 organization and partner closely with front-end and storage system teams to deliver an end-to-end customer experience at massive scale. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, technical curiosity, and an inclusive environment where every engineer's perspective makes the product better. If you want to solve problems that few teams in the industry ever encounter, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production-ready AI agents at scale. AgentCore Harness, launched at AWS Summit New York in June 2026, provides a managed agent loop that enables customers to define an agent through configuration rather than build and operate orchestration infrastructure themselves.

Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, test, deploy, and operate core components across the Harness control plane and data plane. You will solve challenging distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low-latency streaming. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, contribute to technical designs, and deliver high-quality solutions for customers.

Harness sits at the intersection of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, and Evaluations. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle.

A central part of this role is making sophisticated agent capabilities dramatically easier to use. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. Your work will help customers move from an idea to a secure, observable, production-ready agent in minutes while preserving the flexibility advanced builders need for customization.

You will help develop capabilities that make agent development faster and more accessible. This may include simplifying how customers connect tools and memory, building richer agent templates and skills, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the build-test-deploy loop, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release changes.

This is an opportunity to join a newly launched service at an early stage, contribute to its architecture and customer experience, and deliver capabilities with broad industry impact. Machine learning experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for strong engineers with distributed systems experience, sound technical judgment, a commitment to operational excellence, and the ability to deliver in a fast-moving environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate highly available control plane APIs, data plane services, and managed agent loops for production AI agents.
- Build secure, isolated execution capabilities spanning tool orchestration, memory, context management, streaming, identity, networking, observability, and failure handling.
- Develop integrations between Amazon Bedrock and third-party models, AgentCore services, MCP servers, AWS Step Functions, Strands Agents, and customer-defined environments.
- Implement versioning, endpoints, progressive deployment, rollback, evaluation, and optimization capabilities that help customers safely improve agent behavior.
- Analyze and improve latency, scalability, availability, resource efficiency, and cost controls across multi-tenant workloads.
- Simplify the developer journey across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local workflows by building cohesive abstractions, templates, defaults, and automation.
- Work directly with customers and partner teams to identify and reduce friction, accelerate time to production, and balance approachable experiences with the flexibility advanced builders need.
- Contribute to architectural decisions within Harness and collaborate with teams across AgentCore. Help raise the engineering bar through design reviews, operational readiness, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) Foundations- Traffic

- Design and develop features across Spark-based EMR pipelines, decoration jobs, and publication systems that process hundreds of billions of ad events daily
- Deliver end to end across the full development lifecycle — from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations under tier-one SLAs
- Navigate technical problems with competing constraints — regulatory deadlines, performance requirements, cost targets, and cross-org dependencies — and propose well-reasoned solutions
- Collaborate with engineers across Ads, Customer Trust, and identity-owning upstream systems to ensure Traffic's design decisions support downstream consumers
- Contribute to compliance initiatives (GDPR, ePrivacy) and scalability efforts for high-traffic events like live sports
- Maintain sound operational practices — alarms, telemetry, runbooks — for a system where data freshness and accuracy directly impact billing
- Mentor peers through design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

A day in the life
On a typical day you might start with a stand-up to align on priorities, then dive into building or extending a Spark pipeline to handle a new decoration requirement. After lunch, you could be debugging a data freshness issue against a tier-one SLA, tracing it through the ingestion path to a root cause. Between coding, you'll review pull requests, participate in design discussions for upcoming compliance or scalability work, and collaborate with downstream consumers to understand how they use your datasets.

About the team
The Traffic Applications team owns the data ingress system for all of Amazon Ads — ingesting hundreds of billions of ad events daily, decorating them with dimensional and identity data, and publishing structured traffic and billing datasets to consumers across the Ads ecosystem. The system operates under strict SLAs for data freshness and accuracy on tier-one advertising metrics, owning three of the five metrics used for billing. As the first MADS system to encounter regulatory and identity changes, Traffic's architectural decisions propagate across the entire MADS stack, making design choices here uniquely consequential.

jobs.title: Sr Software Dev Engineer, Stores Foundational AI -SFAI
jobs.description:

We are searching for pioneers who are passionate about technology, innovation, and customer experience, and are ready to make a lasting impact on the industry. You'll be working with talented scientists and engineers to innovate on behalf of our customers. If you're fired up about being part of a dynamic, driven team, then this is your moment to join us on this exciting journey!

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will leverage your engineering background and expertise to help develop generative AI for shopping. As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will:

Architect and build scalable ML infrastructure that powers the training and deployment of large language models—directly shaping the future of AI-driven shopping experiences for all Amazon customers
Drive technical innovation by designing experimentation frameworks and tooling that accelerate breakthrough insights, enabling scientists and engineers to iterate faster and smarter
Lead cross-functional initiatives partnering with applied scientists and engineering teams to translate frontier research into production systems that delight customers
Mentor and elevate the team through technical leadership, code reviews, and architectural guidance—raising the bar for engineering excellence across the organization

Improve RL training stability (PPO / GRPO / RLOO) by monitoring and tuning key metrics such as reward, KL divergence, and policy stability

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Security Automation, Security Automation, Amazon Security Experiences
jobs.description:
Security should move at the speed of the builder, not the other way around. The Security Automation team is looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead a team that brings agentic and automation experiences to the hundreds of thousands of builders and security engineers who ship software at Amazon. The experiences you own help builders find and fix security issues as they write code, and help security engineers do their highest judgment work instead of repetitive manual steps. Your work is used across Amazon to help teams ship software securely at the speed and scale of the world’s largest startup.

You will join an established organization and own the design and delivery of agentic experiences such as in context security guidance, automated and candidate fixes, and self service workflows that let builders resolve issues without leaving their tools. You will hire and lead a full two pizza team of Software Development Engineers and set your team’s technical direction in service of a broader automation and agentic vision.

This is a mix of building new systems and extending existing ones. You will measure success by how much you compress the time from idea to securely deployed in production, so that security becomes an accelerant for builders rather than a checkpoint they wait on.


Key job responsibilities
• You are accountable for the team’s structure, software, and strategic direction.
• You partner with engineers on your team by delegating oversight of components, processes, and operations.
• You lead with empathy and recognize the need to create a sustainable workload for your team. You understand that there will be times where extra effort is needed to meet business goals, and you lead your team through those situations with positivity.
• You build a team that delivers successfully without you. When you are involved, you use your technical judgment to question proposals and test assumptions in order to improve the outcome for customers, stakeholders, and your team.
• You independently own a software architecture, product, or suite of products with considerable business impact. The software is part of a larger business strategy.
• You work backwards from the customer, defining a vision of their need and how the product at hand will successfully resolve it.
• You tackle complex problems and proactively mitigate risks before they become roadblocks.
• You provide your team with the necessary support to take responsibility for their systems end to end.


A day in the life
You lead a team that treats security automation as a product. You review designs for new agentic experiences, coach your engineers through hard technical tradeoffs, and work with security engineers and builders to make sure what you ship removes friction rather than adding it. You keep the team focused on the north star: every manual step you eliminate is time a builder gets back and risk that is resolved earlier.

You identify areas where new best practices and workflows are needed and develop them. You prioritize and delegate work while clearing roadblocks to success, delegating as necessary while maintaining ownership.


About the team
Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) helps Amazon’s builders ship software securely. Our team, Security Automation, builds the automation and agentic experiences that bring this directly to builders and security engineers, so that securing software becomes continuous and increasingly automated. We are early, we are ambitious, and we are reinventing how one of the world’s largest software organizations ships securely.

jobs.title: PCIe System Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services). Here you'll move like a startup, build at the scale of the world's largest cloud, and push the limits of what hardware can do.

Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is looking for PCIe System Integration Engineer.

As PCIe System Integration Engineer, you will integrate our new PCIe products, ensure the design works well and drive complex system debugs involving HW, FW and SW components. You will work on an amazingly wide scale and will also provide leadership by driving the teams around you to raise the bar and deliver higher quality products on behalf of Amazon customers.
This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you will work with thought leaders in multiple areas of technology. You will set high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and will be constantly looking for ways to improve the performance, quality, costs, and reliability of AWS products and services.
We are changing the industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
- Approve future products micro-architecture related to the interface you own
- Define new products Validation strategy and lead the execution
- Support ongoing integrations of new products
- Monitor and raise the operational excellence related to the interface you own.
- Lead triage, debug and root cause analysis of systems in AWS data centers
- Analyze customers` mode of work / requirements and provide resolutions accordingly
- Cooperate with multiple AWS teams to improve quality and reliability of products operation in the fleet
- Provide Annapurna Labs’ ASIC design, SW development, QA and architecture teams information and requirements from customers’ fleet operation perspectives and represent the customer voice

About the team
Our SPIV team owns the performance and reliability of PCIe and Ethernet across every AWS server. We work end-to-end across the full product lifecycle, including:
• Pre-silicon IP vendor engagement

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AI Foundations, Amazon Leo AI Foundations
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. The AI Foundations team builds AI agents that turn Leo's best troubleshooting expertise into diagnoses in minutes instead of hours, helping keep the network available for every customer.

As a Software Development Engineer on AI Foundations, you will design and build production agentic systems on AWS that reason over real satellite, ground, and network data. You will work directly with principal, Sr. Principal engineers and network operators, and your work will shape how Leo is operated at scale.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate AI agents and services that diagnose network and connectivity issues using telemetry, logs, and engineering knowledge.
- Turn proven engineering tools and data sources into reusable agent tools so teams across Leo can build on them.
- Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent accuracy, coverage, and latency, and use them to gate launches.
- Own your services in production: on-call, operational metrics, root-cause analysis, and security reviews.
- Partner with principal engineers, operators, and program managers to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features.
- Write clear design docs, give thoughtful code reviews, and help teammates adopt agentic development practices.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing overnight evaluation results and spotting a class of network failures your agent misdiagnosed. You trace the gap to a missing data source, then sit down with the principal engineer who owns that subsystem to agree on how to expose their tool to the agent. After lunch you build the integration and add new test cases, then review a teammate's pull request. Late afternoon, you join an operations review where an operator walks through a real incident your agent helped resolve, and you leave with a clear next priority.

About the team
We are an AI-native team of software engineers and applied scientists in Redmond, and we move fast. We use AI in how we build, not only in what we build, so a good idea can be a working experiment the same week and a production capability the next. We think beyond how things have been done, test our ideas against real problems, and keep only what proves itself. We ship lightning fast, and we hold a high bar for quality and production readiness while doing it.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Prime Benefits
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming the shopping experience for millions of Prime members worldwide? Join Amazon's Benefits, Pricing & Constructs team where you'll build innovative technical solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction and engagement. You'll tackle complex architectural challenges that span multiple tech stacks, designing scalable systems that serve millions of Prime members globally.

In this role, you'll drive technical innovation in the benefits space by adopting novel approaches and technologies. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create operationally sustainable solutions while mentoring fellow engineers and contributing to a culture of technical excellence. This is your opportunity to solve challenging problems that cut across diverse technologies while building high-impact products that enhance the Prime membership experience.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement scalable technical solutions for key Prime benefit products that reach millions of members worldwide, ensuring operational sustainability and performance at scale
Lead technical problem-solving for complex architectural components, contributing to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance
Collaborate with senior engineers to develop architecture solutions and provide meaningful feedback through active participation in code reviews for team members at all levels
Drive technical innovations in the benefits space through adoption of novel approaches and technologies, balancing customer requirements with team operational needs
Mentor junior engineers on software development best practices while documenting team software construction, testing, and operational procedures for knowledge sharing

A day in the life
You'll start your day analyzing performance metrics for Prime benefit systems, then dive into leading technical design sessions with senior engineers to architect solutions for upcoming features. Mid-morning, you'll conduct code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and ensuring operational excellence standards. Afternoons often involve hands-on development work, implementing scalable solutions that will serve millions of customers, followed by mentoring sessions with junior engineers where you share best practices and guide their technical growth.


About the team
The Worldwide Prime Benefits, Pricing & Constructs team drives Amazon's north star vision to create Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program. Our mission focuses on four key areas: increasing potential value through innovative benefits, making Prime members aware of their program value, scaling new constructs to reach distinct customer segments, and growing long-term free cash flow through strategic partnerships and pricing decisions.

You'll join a collaborative team that values knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and technical innovation. Our inclusive environment celebrates different perspectives and experiences, fostering growth through continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects that directly impact millions of Prime members across the globe.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Autopilot
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Amazon Brand Stores are the exclusive destination where brand owners showcase their content and product catalog with custom creative — attracting millions of visits daily across Amazon.com and beyond. The Brand Stores team is using generative AI to reinvent every layer of this experience: store creation, optimization, performance analysis, and customer insights. You'll own new brand-building experiences across both the advertiser-facing tools and the shopper-facing storefronts, making foundational technical decisions on how generative AI transforms the way brands connect with customers.

This is a full-stack role spanning customer-facing (CX) and advertiser-facing (AX) applications. Brand Stores serve as the landing page experience where advertisers direct shoppers to learn more about their brands, and are seamlessly integrated with Sponsored Ads. You'll drive cross-functional collaboration with Product Managers, TPMs, SDEs, and leaders across the org to deliver end-to-end solutions that bridge human creativity with AI at Amazon scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design and delivery of new generative AI-powered brand-building experiences across advertiser-facing (AX) and shopper-facing (CX) applications, making foundational architectural decisions that shape the platform
- Lead the technical direction for integrating generative AI into store creation, optimization, and shopping experiences — defining how these technologies are applied, evaluated, and scaled
- Design and build full-stack applications and APIs that power Brand Stores for millions of daily visits, owning quality, scalability, and reliability of your systems
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product Managers, TPMs, SDEs, and org leaders to translate product vision into well-architected technical solutions
- Establish engineering best practices across the team — raising the bar on code quality, operational excellence, and system design
- Apply data analytical skills to drive customer insights and performance improvements, using data to inform architectural and product decisions
- Mentor engineers across the team and serve as a technical resource that peers seek out for design guidance and expertise

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

The Brand Stores team within Sponsored Products and Brands is chartered to create agentic brand store building experience, automating brand store creation, personalization, and optimization across global marketplaces, serving millions of brand owners world-wide.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, DC Robotics
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game-changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.

AWS is seeking a Robotics Software Engineer to build and maintain the software systems that power robots operating in our data centers. You will own the software that enables robots to reliably collect rich sensor data at scale, navigate complex environments, and communicate with cloud-based services. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building production-quality, fault-tolerant software for physical systems — spanning sensor integration, distributed communication, edge-to-cloud data pipelines, and fleet-level orchestration. This role closely collaborates with mechanical engineers, ML engineers, and operations teams to ensure robot software is robust, testable, and deployable across a growing global fleet.

As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.

About the team

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
