jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Vulnerability Management - Remediation Engineering (PitCrew), Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew), AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM)
jobs.description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) is accountable for the end to end vulnerability lifecycle across all of AWS: finding, contextualizing, and assessing vulnerabilities, and driving remediation at machine speed, without manual work from builders and at the lowest cost to AWS.

The Remediation Engineering Team (PitCrew) builds and operates the capabilities that close the gap between a finding being known and it being gone. Our mandate is to automate mitigation, remediation, and assessment. We develop capabilities for mitigation and remediation outside of patching: recognizing potentially vulnerable and unused software components and retiring them on behalf of service teams, delivering remediations to builders as changes they can review and approve, and acting on hosts and their payloads within minutes when a patch is unavailable or too slow. We also build the tooling AVM security engineers use to codify, classify, and track the blockers that keep service teams from remediating on time, and the automation behind assessment and attestation: contextualizing findings with asset-level signals such as network reachability and compensating controls so that severity reflects true risk and every critical finding is a true critical, attesting to accepted residual risk, and generating evidence of those decisions continuously for auditors and customers.

As a Software Development Engineer II on PitCrew, you will design, build, and operate services that act on hosts and containers across AWS at fleet scale. You will own features end to end: working with security engineers to understand a problem, writing the design, implementing it, deploying it, and operating what you ship. The work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, host and container internals, and security, and much of it is about making changes to production systems safely and reversibly at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and operate services and automation that mitigate, remediate, and assess vulnerabilities across AWS fleets, reducing the attack surface and mean time to remediate without a human in the loop.
- Build the contextualization that turns raw findings into accurate, prioritized risk for builders, so service teams act on true criticals first.
- Own the full lifecycle of your software: requirements, design reviews, implementation, testing, deployment, metrics, alarms, and on-call.
- Build tooling that security engineers use daily, and work closely with them to turn investigation, remediation, assessment, and attestation workflows into software.
- Make changes to production hosts and containers safe by default: reversible, observable, attested, and gated appropriately.
- Raise the bar on operational excellence through metrics, dashboards, and continuous improvement of the systems you own.
- Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team's technical direction through design reviews and documentation.

A day in the life
You will spend most of your time designing and writing software, reviewing designs and code from teammates, and working with AVM security engineers and the partner teams that consume what we build. You will participate in the team's on-call rotation for the services we operate.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human-in-the-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them.

We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.

Key job responsibilities
• Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions
* Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Co-op, Amazon Robotics - Spring 2027
jobs.description:

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

As a member of the Amazon Robotics Firmware team, you will work as part of a cross functional team to shape the next generation of robotic systems used throughout Amazon’s order fulfillment network. You will work closely with not only other embedded software engineers but also our team of electrical, mechanical and safety engineers to deliver a lasting impact to millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Robotics develops state-of-the art robotics for Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers. We are combining computer vision and custom robots to solve real-world problems at huge scale. Amazon Robotics automates fulfillment center operations using various methods of robotic technology including autonomous mobile robots, sophisticated control software, language perception, power management, computer vision, depth sensing, machine learning, object recognition, and semantic understanding of commands. Amazon Robotics has a dedicated focus on research and development to continuously explore new opportunities to extend its product lines into new areas. Our team partners with a variety of customers across Amazon worldwide to conceive, develop, prototype and deploy a wide range of robotic systems.

Amazon Robotics empowers a smarter, faster, more consistent customer experience through automation. We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology for operating robotics systems. At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE Intern, you will own designing, developing, integrating, troubleshooting, and optimizing critical automation systems that will be deployed at very large scale. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

You will act as a key contributor to our product development roadmap and help develop software features, tools, and mechanisms to operate large robotic fleets (10,000s). At Amazon Robotics, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth. Amazon Robotics internship/co-op opportunities will be based out of the Greater Boston Area in our two state-of-the-art facilities in Westborough, MA and North Reading, MA. Both campuses provide a unique opportunity to have direct access to robotics testing labs and manufacturing facilities.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. • Having an understanding of and interest in the technical principles, theories, and concepts in embedded firmware development and testing
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, test, deploy and operate innovative robotics products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Inference
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's
possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer II - AI/ML, you will design and implement business-critical features and own the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like the GLM, GPT-OSS, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-successAre you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and maintain systems that solve complex problems while delivering meaningful results. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards from customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. This role offers the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, collaborate with talented engineers, and grow your skills while making a real impact. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and shipping high-quality code, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role contributes to building distributed inference support for PyTorch in the Neuron SDK, and tunes models to ensure the highest performance and maximize efficiency running on AWS Trainium. Strong software development in Python, system-level programming, and ML knowledge are all critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle, including distributed-computing-based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architectures.
* Understand and produce NKI (Neuron Kernel Interface) kernels, and design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware, using knowledge of the underlying Trainium hardware architecture to guide optimization decisions.
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling.
* Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators.
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques, and share proposals, findings, and learnings with internal developers and external customers via high-quality designs and documentation.


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, systems engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and contributing to the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you'll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions and code reviews, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you're always working on the most important initiative.You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. From there, you might dive into designing a new feature, writing and reviewing code, or pairing with a teammate to debug a tricky issue. You will participate in design discussions, contribute to sprint planning, and document your systems so that others can learn from and extend your work. Expect regular collaboration with product and engineering partners as you shape solutions that serve customers at scale.

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others. We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

jobs.description:
Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our SDE interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As a SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
________________________

By applying to this position, your application will be considered for Summer 2027 internship roles. All intern roles require in-person work and are 12 weeks in duration, starting in May/June and ending in August/September. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in the United States.

Please note that the majority of our internships are in the Summer of 2027 and applicants will be processed based on business need; however, there may be additional openings that include the following period -

Fall 2027 (Start August/September; End November/December)

During the application process, you will be given the opportunity to select a preference or interest in other seasonal start dates. Please note that placement in a non-summer season is not guaranteed and is subject to availability.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

We will take your location preferences into consideration. Preferences are based on business availability and are not guaranteed. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in the United States including but not limited to:

• CA (Sunnyvale, San Diego, Santa Monica, Northridge)
• WA (Redmond, Seattle)
***Locations are subject to change***

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.




Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
• Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation
• Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
• Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness, including for AI-generated code.
• Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
• Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output and when not to
• Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns, including AI-assisted.
• Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
• Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Demand Side Platform
jobs.description:
As a Software Development Engineer within Cinder org, you will (a) drive the design, development, and continuous improvement of our ad-serving systems via your own contribution and experimentation, and (b) invent and deliver initiatives to simplify our systems, reduce the unit cost to serve, and improve reliability.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering results on an ad exchange at scale, be detail-oriented, data-driven, and possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You must be able to thrive and succeed in a fast-moving environment with abundant ambiguity and competing priorities. You will have technical curiosity, drive for results, and at the same time embody ownership at the business level and contribute to product development. You will work closely with a talented team of software engineers, to innovate solutions to decrease the overall maintenance and operational overhead of our software systems. You will effortlessly collaborate across large teams, navigating ambiguous situations, and be customer-obsessed. You will also have an opportunity to learn new technologies and develop well-rounded skills to grow your career to a senior software development engineer.

Key job responsibilities
As an engineer in the Cinder org, you will:
- Solve complex, interesting problems to optimize the real-time ad serving flow and deliver impact for our customers
- Develop and maintain ad serving and supporting systems that serve multi-format ads at multi-million TPS scale while keeping costs optimal
- Own and drive your projects end to end
- Partner with other teams to guide them toward the right technical solutions
- Maintain a high technical bar for the team
- Collaborate with teammates to improve the overall ad serving ecosystem

About the team
The Cinder org builds and operates a high-performance (~2.5M peak TPS), low-latency service that fulfills all Amazon DSP demand across multiple ad formats. The system processes hundreds of billions of requests annually while maintaining millisecond-level response latencies and meeting strict SLA requirements.

The Cinder bidder delivers ad opportunities from Amazon-owned properties and external publishers in an efficient, scalable, and privacy-centric manner.

As a member of the Cinder org, you'll have ample opportunities to take on leadership roles, make a meaningful impact on Amazon DSP, and grow your career.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Trust CX AI Innovation and Policies
jobs.description:
About the Team
Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

Role Overview
We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer II to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Principal Engineers and Managers to design and implement privacy-preserving AI architectures, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.

This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—balancing performance with privacy, building explainable AI systems, and creating guardrails that protect customers while enabling delightful experiences.


Key job responsibilities
What You'll Build

Privacy-Preserving AI Systems:
* Design and implement federated learning and differential privacy techniques for on-device and hybrid AI architectures
* Build privacy-preserving data pipelines that minimize data collection while maintaining model quality
* Create consent management frameworks and data minimization systems that give customers control
* Architect on-device vs. cloud processing trade-offs that optimize for both privacy and performance


Consumer-Facing Trust Features:
* Develop explainable AI interfaces that help customers understand how AI makes decisions
* Build transparency controls that show customers what data is used and how
* Create privacy dashboards and settings that give customers meaningful control over their AI experiences
* Implement cross-device identity management with privacy-first design principles

Key Technical Challenges
* Latency vs. Privacy Trade-offs: Optimize time-to-first-token and response times while maintaining strong privacy guarantees through on-device processing and selective cloud offloading
* AI Safety at Scale: Reduce hallucinations to <1% while maintaining 95%+ accuracy across diverse customer queries and contexts
* Ambient Computing Privacy: Build privacy controls for always-on environments that balance proactive assistance with clear boundaries
* Multimodal AI Systems: Architect distributed systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while preserving privacy across modalities
* Real-time Evaluation: Create low-latency evaluation systems that assess model outputs for safety, accuracy, and bias before reaching customers

What Makes You Successful
Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.

AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.

Why Join Us
* Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily
* Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust
* Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams
* Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection
* Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone


About the team
Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Graviton
jobs.description:
Working for Annapurna Labs is thrilling, fast-paced, and a constant learning experience. The AWS Graviton SW team is looking for a Senior Embedded Engineer to join us in building next-generation platforms. In this role, you will develop firmware and low-level software for our custom silicon, participate in board and chip bringups, and help bring Graviton devices into the AWS fleet at scale. If you're passionate about working at the intersection of hardware and software — from first silicon power-on to production deployment — this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain embedded firmware (C/C++) for Graviton platform components, including host MCU and related subsystems
- Participate in board and chip bringup activities — from early silicon validation through production readiness
- Develop and maintain boot loaders, drivers, and RTOS-based firmware for multi-core ARM devices
- Collaborate with hardware engineers to validate new board designs, reading schematics and using lab tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) for hands-on debugging
- Develop firmware flows and commands used during fleet testing, monitoring, and operational events (e.g., Gamedays)
- Contribute to the full lifecycle of platform development — from prototype to high-volume production in the AWS fleet
- Work cross-functionally with silicon, platform, and fleet health teams to ensure reliability and performance at scale

A day in the life
You'll be debugging a new chip's first boot sequence in the lab, writing firmware for hardware monitoring, or collaborating with hardware engineers on next-generation platform designs. You'll work across Annapurna Labs teams - from silicon design to fleet operations - ensuring our Graviton platforms are robust and ready for the world's largest cloud.

About the team
The AWS Graviton SW team is looking for a Senior Embedded Engineer to join us in building next generation platforms. At the platforms team, you'll be working on large and complicated boards, bringing our Silicon devices into the AWS fleet. You'll have the opportunity to shape our next gen platforms and work on the technologies that power the world's largest Cloud provider.
Are you ready to join the future?

jobs.title: Software Development Manager - AWS DNS, AWS Infrastructure DNS
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for highly available Tier 0 services such as DNS? Are you interested in leading an elite team of engineers building and operating some of the largest DNS systems in the world? Do you want to work on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security?

In Route 53, our mission is to make DNS invisible for our customers. It just works. Are you ready to create systems to power one of the largest e-commerce companies in the world? Amazon.com has over 70 million customers, and developers all over the world rely on our storage, compute, and virtualised services via Amazon Web Services. We support systems at massive, and ever-growing, scale. We rapidly integrate new technologies to expand our customer offerings. Our success depends on our world-class network infrastructure and our goal is to become “The Infrastructure Platform” for the world.

As our team grows, the AWS Infrastructure DNS team is seeking enthusiastic and talented Software Development Manager to lead a team that builds and operates the large-scale DNS systems used to drive the Amazon fleet. You will own systems that are critical to the platforms that Amazon's global retail, AWS and Kindle businesses run upon -- the DNS services in Amazon's data centers and integration of Amazon's systems with the likes of Amazon Route 53 to manage public DNS.

This is your opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of DNS systems, to grow as a technology leader, and to work with some really smart people. You are great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. You are smart, ambitious, love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You enjoy being a really great people manager. Building, motivating and mentoring a world-class systems & software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day-to-day people and performance management tasks.

You have strong Agile product management and delivery experience. In this role, you will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Scrum methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross-team projects.
You have a strong engineering background with an understanding of OO Design and DNS Technologies, network and OS expertise is a plus. Ideally, you have past experience working as a senior software development engineer. You enjoy keeping your technical skills reasonably current, to the point that you can still contribute to architecture discussions. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting exercises and drive technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

You also have strong operational experience and have a track record operating highly available fault tolerant systems. You know how to run a tight, lean, efficient operation. You will want to measure everything and be very data driven using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of your team. You thrive operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Technical and People Management, handle multiple priorities at once, find paths forward in difficult situations and lead independently.

A day in the life
Be a leader-servant of a team of high performing software engineers with relentless high standards. You will need to arbitrate difficult situations with no clear path forward. Participate in design review meetings and meaningfully contribute. Make contributions to code. Participate in an escalation rotation to make sure we keep our services highly available.

About the team
We are serious about career progression, growing engineers across many levels and life-work balance. We are looking for a manager with similar ethos and somebody who can make trade-offs and high impact decisions. The team owns goal critical to the success and growth of AWS so the leader will need to be comfortable relaying complex concepts to senior leadership.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Client Engineering
jobs.description:
The Client Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that manages a large-scale corporate computing fleet across Windows and macOS. Our mission is to make endpoint management secure, reliable, measurable, and increasingly autonomous.

We are building the next generation of Client Engineering capabilities: an autonomous fleet management platform that can understand endpoint state, identify risks and drift, make intelligent decisions, safely execute changes, and continuously verify the outcome—with humans involved when judgment or risk requires it.

This is not traditional desktop engineering or a simple device-management role. You will build distributed software systems that operate across hundreds of thousands of endpoints and directly impact how employees work every day.

The Role:
As a Software Development Engineer on the Client Engineering Autonomous Fleet Management team, you will design and build systems that enable autonomous endpoint operations at scale.

You will work across the endpoint, cloud, data, automation, and observability layers to build capabilities such as:

- Automated OS and application update orchestration
- Endpoint policy and configuration management
- Fleet health and compliance evaluation
- Configuration and software drift detection
- Safe rollout and deployment automation
- Automated endpoint remediation and recovery
- Automated incident detection, investigation, and resolution
- Intelligent identification and remediation of endpoint failures

You will help evolve endpoint management from a collection of administrative tools into a software-defined, autonomous operating platform.



Key job responsibilities
Build Autonomous Fleet Management Systems:
Design and develop highly scalable services and control-plane capabilities for endpoint policy, configuration, software, OS updates, compliance, and fleet state across a large enterprise environment.

Automate Endpoint Operations and Remediation:
Build intelligent automation that detects endpoint issues, configuration drift, and compliance gaps; determines appropriate actions; executes remediation; and verifies the endpoint has returned to the desired state.

Build Safe, Progressive Deployment Systems:
Develop rollout, canary, ring, health-gating, rollback, and recovery mechanisms that enable fleet-wide changes to be deployed safely while continuously measuring customer and endpoint impact.

Develop Fleet Observability and Intelligence:
Build telemetry, diagnostics, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis capabilities that transform endpoint signals into actionable insights and automated operational decisions.

Engineer Reliable, Secure, and Scalable Platforms:
Own production-quality software from architecture through operation, designing for scale, reliability, security, resilience, and measurable service-level objectives while contributing to the technical direction of autonomous Client Engineering.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Sable
jobs.description:
The Sable organization bridges the gap between the storage technologies offered by AWS and the features required to power Amazon's SDO (Stores, Digital, and Others) organization. Our primary offering, Sable, stores over 30 petabytes of critical Amazon data powering the Items and Offers Pipeline, Shopping Cart, Checkout, Retail & Digital Ordering, Transportation Systems, and Fulfillment Systems. Sable serves over 150 million requests per second at sub-millisecond latency, and is mission-critical for Amazon's SDO: when it is unavailable, customer-facing experiences and core business operations are directly impacted.

The Sable Data Plane team is part of the Sable organization and focused on two key areas: the Sable Data Node and Disaster Recovery. We are a tier-1 team operating some of the most critical storage infrastructure at Amazon, where correctness, durability, and availability are non-negotiable.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to take full end-to-end ownership of Sable feature delivery and operational improvements. You will independently drive design, implementation, and rollout of changes to a tier-1 system — advancing the platform without disrupting production traffic serving Amazon's most critical commerce flows.

This is a role for an engineer who is energized by hard distributed-systems problems and who takes genuine pride in operational reality: not just shipping good software, but ensuring that software holds up under the demands of a 30+ PB, mission-critical platform.


Key job responsibilities
- Work on deep, interesting storage problems at scale — anti-entropy, leader election, disaster recovery, caching, replication, and data durability — strengthening the correctness and resilience of the Sable Data Node and its recovery paths.
- Take end-to-end ownership of Sable features and operational improvements — driving design, implementation, and safe rollout independently, without impacting production traffic.
- Carry on-call responsibilities for tier-1 services, acting as an active contributor during high-severity operational incidents and driving mitigation and resolution with urgency.
- Conduct Root Cause Analysis for high-severity incidents and author operational runbooks.
- When incidents reveal that Sable customers are not following best practices, advocate directly to those customers to adopt Sable's recommended patterns and configurations, preventing recurrence.
- Proactively identify and advocate for opportunities to improve operational excellence across the platform.
- Identify and make improvements to the team's development and testing practices, raising engineering quality.
- Mentor junior engineers and interns, helping to raise the overall bar of the team.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software

You will design, craft, and deploy reliable embedded software for large quantity of consumer electronic products. Leo is breaking new ground with every device we design, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system.
· Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
· Developing embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
· Have experience with real-time embedded software philosophies and practices
· Have expertise with Linux and/or RTOS
· Review schematics, logic analyzer, and embedded software trouble-shooting techniques.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
As part of our Leo Customer Terminal Software Team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Project Leo products. The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Leo network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), Ads AI Core Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At Amazon Ads, we're re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent-builder SDK with pre-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi-step reasoning and multi-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions.

You will build Tier-1 services to handle millions of requests per day, while maintaining response latencies in the milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements. You will develop distributed solutions with service-oriented architecture to build high-performance platforms powering the next generation of AI-driven advertising experiences. Our systems and algorithms operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks. In this role, you will design new and rebuild existing solutions for the fast-growing scale of agentic infrastructure — including stateful runtime services, and pre-built platform components that agent-builder teams rely on to ship production agents.

You will not merely go through the full software development cycle but more importantly drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of AI-powered advertising at Amazon.

We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business.

A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.



Key job responsibilities
SDE-2s are autonomous contributors to their team's software. You deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle including working backwards from customers, software design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and documentation.

SDE-2s coach others on producing high-quality code, using processes such as code review as a teaching mechanism. They ensure that when their software fails, the root cause is identified and eliminated with a permanent fix. They ensure the software they produce can be maintained and extended by those not familiar with the code by writing clear documentation and making good design choices.

SDE-2s participate in an inclusive, constructive dialogue with other team members and members of closely related teams. They train new team members on how their software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.



About the team
Agent Fabric is Amazon Ads' AI infrastructure platform. We extend AWS AgentCore with advertising-specific capabilities and a managed, stateful runtime, cutting agent development from months to weeks. We own the platform end-to-end: the agent-builder SDK, the runtime that executes agents in production, and the knowledge and governance layers that keep it safe and accountable at scale. Our systems are in the critical path for GenAI projects across Amazon Advertising.

Stateful Runtime & Orchestration: an orchestration framework that turns a single agent turn into durable, resumable work: async conversations that persist after a turn ends and notify on completion, scheduled and event-driven workflows, and multi-step DAG execution with fan-out, cancellation, and retry. Checkpointing, task queues, and short- and long-term memory let agents resume and learn across sessions.

Knowledge Base: the RAG Knowledge Base that grounds advertiser answers across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP, reporting, and optimization. We run the KB agent, an OpenSearch vector index, and a daily ingestion pipeline spanning published and partner-curated content, with eval gates that enforce retrieval quality before every rebuild.

Pre-Built Ads Components: delegated advertiser authorization, privacy-safe logging, policy guardrails, real-time data access, and context handoff between agents.

Metering & Throttling: metering every invocation across model calls, tool calls, memory operations, and session time, then enforcing per-user and per-advertiser limits on a sub-millisecond path to protect the platform from abuse.

Operational Excellence: parallelization for low latency, human-in-the-loop approvals, end-to-end tracing, security isolation, cost attribution, and versioned deploys with rollback.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 UltraServer Availability
jobs.description:
The Software Development Engineer II will design, build, and maintain cloud-based repair and recovery workflows for NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 UltraServers, orchestrating repair and recovery operations from impairment detection through completed recovery. This role requires expertise in AWS services, system architecture, and cross-functional collaboration with Capacity Management, Hardware Engineering, and Datacenter Operations to manage AI/ML infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
The Software Development Engineer (SDE II) on the EC2 UltraServer Availability team is responsible for ensuring high availability of customer GB200 and GB300 UltraServers by orchestrating complex repair and recovery workflows. Following are the core responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

* Design and architect solutions that are cross-functional to Capacity Management, Hardware Engineering, and Datacenter Operations
* Work in environments where the technology strategy is defined but the solution design is not
* Build solutions that are stable, logical, testable, and efficient with the ability to independently make trade-off decisions
* Investigate and develop design concepts to frame solution sets at an application and product level

Software Development

* Write high-quality, maintainable code with proper testing and code reviews
* Develop and maintain the repair and recovery workflows for GB200 and GB300 UltraServer hosts

Operational Excellence

* Troubleshoot workflow failures and coordinate with downstream teams
* Focus on operational excellence by identifying problems and proposing solutions

Hardware & Software Integration

* Work with hardware and software integrations specific to GPU clusters and AI/ML training systems
* Manage network partition configurations for multi-node GPU clusters
* Handle firmware validation and consistency checks across asset groups

Team Collaboration

* Collaborate with customers and stakeholders to convert business needs into technical designs
* Participate in code reviews and technical assessments


A day in the life
This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

About the team
The EC2 UltraServer Availability team is a high-performing engineering organization responsible for maintaining high availability of NVIDIA-based ML infrastructure at scale. We manage end-to-end repair and recovery workflows for GB200 and GB300 UltraServers, from initial problem detection through repair and recovery. Our team drives operational excellence through continuous improvement of problem detection, repair efficacy, and customer impact mitigation. We work closely with hardware engineering, data center operations, and EC2 service teams to ensure reliable, efficient recovery of critical ML compute capacity. This is a high-impact role leading a two-pizza team of talented engineers solving complex technical challenges in one of Amazon's fastest-growing infrastructure domains.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
jobs.description:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
jobs.description:

The Frontier ADC team delivers the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We expand Frontier AI services into new regions, automate service deployment and operations, and build solutions that meet the security, availability, and scale requirements of government customers. Our teams build and operate massively scalable distributed systems across services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Software Development Manager who can think big, set technical and organizational direction, and build a high-performing engineering team. This leader will simplify complex problems while ensuring our customers receive a secure, reliable, and consistent experience.

A successful Software Development Manager will lead a team responsible for building, launching, and operating Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated environments. They will work closely with Amazon’s largest and most demanding government customers, own the team’s technical roadmap and delivery commitments, develop engineers, and drive the resolution of complex technical and operational issues. They will partner across service teams, security, infrastructure, product, and operations to deliver solutions that address the unique requirements of these environments.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:
- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” The right candidate will enjoy building teams, creating an inclusive environment, and helping engineers do the best work of their careers.
- Build and develop high-performing teams. You have experience hiring, coaching, and developing software and systems engineers. You set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, recognize strong performance, and help engineers grow into larger roles.
- Have strong technical judgment. You have experience with Linux, networking, software development, and large-scale distributed systems. You can guide architecture and design decisions, ask the right technical questions, and lead teams through complex troubleshooting and post-incident reviews.
- Deliver through others. You translate customer and business requirements into clear priorities, establish mechanisms that make progress visible, remove blockers, and hold the team accountable for delivering secure and reliable services.
- Love solving difficult problems. You will lead teams addressing complex service-build and operational challenges in GovCloud and isolated environments. You understand systems design, operations, automation, security, and process improvement.
- Think big. You will establish a strategy for building and deploying solutions across multiple services and regions. You will create mechanisms that allow the organization to scale without scaling operational effort at the same rate.
- Raise the bar. You establish strong engineering practices, guide design and operational reviews, and create a culture that values ownership, technical rigor, and continuous improvement.

As a Software Development Manager, you will:

Mentorship and Career Growth

We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB Index and Search
jobs.description:
Software Development Engineer — DynamoDB Indexing

Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless, distributed NoSQL database that delivers single-digit millisecond performance at virtually any scale. DynamoDB's indexing infrastructure powers Global Secondary Indexes (GSIs), enabling customers to efficiently query their data across alternate access patterns without managing additional infrastructure.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help design, build, and operate the distributed indexing infrastructure at the heart of DynamoDB. You will work on problems at the intersection of distributed systems, stream processing, storage engines, and large-scale data replication — ensuring that secondary indexes remain consistent, performant, and highly available as the underlying table data changes continuously.

The role includes designing and evolving the index replication pipeline that propagates mutations from base tables to secondary indexes in near-real time; building index lifecycle mechanisms that handle creation, backfill, compaction, rebalancing, and recovery across partitioned datasets at massive scale; and optimizing the storage, query, and cost efficiency of secondary indexes across all DynamoDB partitions and regions.

You will help determine how indexes are created, maintained, scaled, and recovered while the underlying DynamoDB data continues to change at millions of requests per second. You will also shape how indexing infrastructure integrates with DynamoDB's partitioning, replication, admission control, and query-processing systems — delivering predictable performance across latency, throughput, freshness, availability, and cost.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of DynamoDB's indexing capabilities — from foundational architecture through customer launch and operation at DynamoDB scale.

Key Job Responsibilities

- Design and implement distributed index replication infrastructure that propagates base-table mutations to Global Secondary Indexes with low latency and high fidelity.

- Build and optimize the Log Propagator pipeline, including log streaming, checkpointing, session management, admission control, and failure recovery across thousands of partitions.

- Develop index lifecycle mechanisms covering index creation, backfill from existing table data, incremental updates, compaction, partition splits and merges, rebalancing, and deletion — all while the table continues to serve live traffic.

- Ensure that secondary indexes remain consistent with the base table under concurrent writes, partition movements, leader elections, and failure scenarios, with well-defined freshness and consistency semantics.

- Integrate indexing infrastructure with DynamoDB's distributed storage, partitioning, replication, and query-processing systems, including StorageNode, Partition Manager, and the control plane.

- Design and build mechanisms for index availability and recovery, including handling degraded partitions, stuck replication sessions, and automated remediation of index lag.

- Optimize tradeoffs among replication latency, write amplification, storage efficiency, throughput, memory usage, and operational cost across the indexing fleet.

- Build observability, alarming, and operational tooling for the indexing pipeline — enabling rapid diagnosis and resolution of replication lag, backfill progress, and partition-level health.

- Drive operational excellence across the indexing fleet, including patching, deployment safety, capacity planning, and on-call processes for a Tier-1 service.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer III, AWS Elastic Beanstalk
jobs.description:

Our team builds the orchestration system at the center of the service: the public API, the workflow system that provisions and mutates customer environments, the health monitoring subsystem, the eventing pipeline, and the AWS Console experience. We are also in the middle of the most significant architectural expansion in the service's history — extending Elastic Beanstalk to run on Kubernetes and EKS, while continuing to support the millions of environments already running on our classic architecture. Doing both at once, without customer disruption, is a genuinely hard distributed systems problem.

If you are someone who is passionate about building high quality services, delighting developers, and reducing the distance between "I have code" and "it's running in production," this job is for you. jobs.title: SLAM Software Engineer, RIVR

You will shape our robots’ ability to navigate with pinpoint precision, and you will be part of a team focused on enabling our robots to navigate autonomously. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic Workspaces
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those workspaces will host AI agents alongside humans agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it.

Agentic WorkSpaces' Data Plane is the connective tissue that makes this possible: the single entry point through which every WorkSpaces connection flows and the streaming backbone that delivers the desktop experience once a session begins. We own the end-to-end pre-session journey authentication across every identity method, session authorization, resource discovery, gateway selection, and cross-region failover as well as the in-session streaming stack that carries pixels to the user and the pipeline that delivers workspace health and performance metrics back to our customers.

Our vision is for that connection to be seamless and invisible: users and the agents working beside them reach their workspace instantly and securely sessions stream with high fidelity and low latency failover is transparent and the health of every connection is observable through the same AWS tools customers already use delivered reliably from commercial regions to classified partitions at a scale where availability and security are non-negotiable.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that authenticate authorize connect and stream WorkSpaces sessions for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported identity provider and streaming protocol. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within the Data Plane from design through deployment and operations holding a high bar for availability latency and security on the services that stand between every customer and their workspace.

You are customer-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like a connection fabric that treats humans and agents as first-class principals streaming that adapts intelligently to network conditions and brokering that routes and heals itself before users notice a problem and then you build the systems to get there.

You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in distributed systems identity real-time streaming and network infrastructure at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and deliver features and systems within the Data Plane contributing to the architecture strategy for how the connection and streaming layer evolves to broker and stream sessions for AI agents alongside human users.
• Drive the work that unifies and simplifies how sessions are brokered and streamed across protocols making a consistent high-fidelity connection experience the default. Partner with compute identity providers networking and gateway teams earning trust by driving technical discussions that result in impactful architectural decisions.
• Design and implement pre-session authentication authorization and governance for a world where humans and agents share the same connection path: identity integration across every authentication method session authorization and access policies that treat agents as first-class principals and a security posture built in rather than bolted on.
• Own the operation of low-latency high-availability brokering and streaming services that are the single entry point for more than one million WorkSpaces users globally. Ensure your services meet stringent SLAs across multiple production regions AWS partitions and streaming protocols with self-healing routing transparent cross-region failover and autonomous issue resolution before customers are impacted.
• Drive engineering excellence through instrumentation automated testing and pipeline-based deployment eliminating manual toil and delivering a consistent connection and streaming experience across every protocol. Think big about the agentic era and experiment boldly with AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent gateway selection self-diagnosing connections and AI-assisted operational management.
• Raise the bar on connection reliability and observability so that authentication session brokering high-fidelity streaming and customer-facing metrics are delivered without imposing an operational tax on the customer or the agent workflows running on the desktop.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.
