jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Inventory Genealogy
jobs.description:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. AFT builds and operates software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many billions of units of inventory, employ tens of thousands of people, and ensure that customers get what they want when we promised we would get it to them. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

Our inventory systems are the authoritative source of information for billions of inventory units that Amazon holds in its logistical networks, worldwide. As new inventory arrives to our networks, inventory systems enable Amazon's supply chain to route products to optimal locations based on space availability, customer demand and buying patterns. Inventory systems track the state of all items and their location, and share the availability to upstream systems, to make the items sellable on the Amazon website. When customer orders come in, inventory systems reserve specific items and track them through various stages of order fulfillment, until shipments are delivered to customers. Throughout this end-to-end inventory movement, inventory systems detect discrepancies between virtual and physical states of inventory, and enable corrections of virtual inventory state via both preventative and mitigating mechanisms.

The AFT Inventory org is seeking a highly skilled SDE II to lead our Genealogy platform development. This critical role will shape the future of our inventory Genealogy and defect detection systems, focusing on root cause analysis and process-level insights. As the lead architect, you'll finalize our high-volume data storage infrastructure and develop advanced analytics solutions, handling approximately 1 billion daily inventory events. Your responsibilities will include building and optimizing a sophisticated knowledge graph to track inventory throughout Amazon's fulfillment network, designing scalable storage solutions, and developing high-performance APIs. You'll also spearhead the creation of analytics tools for defect identification, ensuring data security and compliance throughout. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of big data technology, directly impacting Amazon's inventory management efficiency and accuracy. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, cloud computing, and database management, along with strong leadership and problem-solving skills to drive innovation in this complex and dynamic field.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of big data technology, GenAI, directly impacting Amazon's inventory management efficiency and accuracy. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, cloud computing, database management, and GenAI, along with strong leadership and problem-solving skills to drive innovation in this complex and dynamic field. If this sounds exciting to you, you’ll find this role to be engaging, challenging, and full of opportunities to learn and grow.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable solution. You will collaborate closely with a team of engineers to influence our overall strategy and define the team’s roadmap. You will also help drive the system architecture, spearhead best practices that enable a quality product, and help coach and develop junior engineers. A successful candidate will have an established background in Big data analytics, and infrastructure to store TBs of data/events per day.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Foundational Security Services
jobs.description:
Are you a technology leader and innovator interested in owning business-critical identity infrastructure that authenticates and authorizes over 3 million Amazonians every day? We have an opportunity for a Software Development Manager in Amazon Foundational Security Services (AFSS), and we're looking for a leader ready to own and evolve Amazon's on-premises Active Directory service.

Amazon Foundational Security Services (AFSS) owns the service portfolio that provides enterprise capabilities for authentication, authorization, directory management, and public key infrastructure (PKI). This includes Amazon's on-premises Active Directory, and the Corporate PKI Service. We work very closely with additional Cloud IDPs, including Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), Google Workspace and AWS Identity Center (IDC). We enable the authentication and authorization needs of every Amazonian: logging into their laptops, authenticating to enterprise services like Exchange, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365, and authorizing access to shared resources such as GitFarm, wiki pages, and Workdocs.

As a Software Development Manager, you will bring strong people/project/program management capabilities, and a good exposure to Identity and Access management concepts (SAML, OAuth2, FIDO2), and Cloud Identity systems (Active Directory, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Okta etc.)

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end delivery and operational health of Amazon's on-premises Active Directory service, supporting authentication and authorization for millions of Amazonians, and providing directory services to millions of devices.
• Lead a team building and rolling out identity and access management capabilities across global regions.
• Proactively partner across business groups and security partners inside Amazon, building and running cross-functional projects that implement secure systems and security controls at scale.
• Drive Amazon's growing footprint across Cloud IDPs (e.g. Azure AD/Entra ID), bringing deep systems and domain experience in these platforms.
• Build Infrastructure as Code and DevOps tooling to drive efficiency and quality across the directory service.
• Create and evolve enterprise infrastructure and security standards, and ensure systems adhere to them.
• Review and implement system changes using thorough test plans, and drive operational excellence for services your team owns.
• Translate security recommendations into business terms (and vice versa), and regularly brief Amazon leadership on security posture and initiatives.
• Make sound two-way-door decisions under pressure, with the backbone to safeguard Amazon's systems, and the ownership to see decisions through.
• Proactively work across different business groups and security partners in Amazon, and build/run cross-functional projects.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Fault Injection Services
jobs.description:
AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) is a fully managed service for running fault injection and chaos engineering experiments on AWS. Customers use FIS to deliberately and safely stress their applications, uncover hidden weaknesses, validate that their monitoring and alarms work, and prove that their systems recover the way they expect, all before a real incident happens. FIS experiments apply controlled faults to targeted resources, guarded by stop conditions that automatically halt an experiment the moment it moves outside safe limits.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to own the design and delivery of the fault actions at the core of FIS. You will build the capabilities that safely disrupt production-grade AWS services, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS and Kubernetes workloads, and Amazon ElastiCache, and you will drive the resilience, scalability, and safety of those systems. You will set the technical direction for your team's software, advise senior leadership on architecture and roadmap, and mentor engineers across the team.

Safety is central to this role. A fault that is too broad, or that fires against the wrong resource, can affect real customer workloads, so you will own the authorization, blast-radius controls, and operational rigor that let customers trust FIS to break their systems on purpose. If you enjoy distributed-systems problems where correctness and customer safety matter as much as scale, this is a rare place to work on them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture for one or more FIS fault domains, providing a system-wide view and design guidance, and act as a key influencer on your team's technical strategy and goals.
Design, build, and release software at large scale for AWS customers worldwide, then operate it in production and keep it highly available and durable.
Build new fault actions and target types end to end: API design, authorization, execution logic, automated testing, and documentation, and safely evolve existing ones.
Identify high-impact, hard-to-reverse technical decisions early, and drive the team toward durable solutions rather than short-term workarounds, especially where customer safety and blast radius are at stake.
Raise the operational bar for your team: strong alarms and telemetry, clear runbooks, effective guardrails, and a healthy culture of incident review and continuous improvement.
Partner with the AWS service teams whose faults FIS supports to design integrations and land cross-team deliveries successfully.
Advise your management and senior leadership on technical trade-offs, and contribute to short- and long-term planning.
Actively mentor multiple engineers and champion engineering best practices that others adopt.

A day in the life
A Senior SDE on FIS is an owner of the product, not just of individual components. A typical day combines hands-on building with work that makes the whole team more effective: producing and reviewing designs for complex fault-domain problems, building and operating fault actions across the service, reasoning carefully about authorization and blast radius so an action can never exceed its intended scope, keeping a close watch on operational health, and unblocking and mentoring the engineers around you.

You will join AWS Resilience, working on a service that thousands of AWS customers rely on to make their own systems more reliable.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Machine Learning Compilers, Edge AI Compiler and Runtime Team
jobs.description:
Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer products like the Kindle family, Fire Tablets, Fire TV, Health & Wellness devices, Amazon Echo, and Astro. We are building the next generation of edge AI capabilities through our advanced compression platform, compiler and custom neural accelerator silicon. Come join us to accelerate deep learning networks on edge processors and beyond.

We are looking for a talented and passionate software engineer to be part of an exciting technology creation team at Amazon. You will have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of deep learning technologies embedded into consumer products used every day, by people you know. The position provides an unique opportunity to contribute and make an impact from hardware design stage followed by pre and post silicon development as well as productizing it on consumer devices.

In this role you will be work along side partner science teams to develop the compiler infrastructure and lower deep learning workloads to heterogeneous device backends. You will also partner up with peer science teams to innovate on model quantization and compression techniques for efficient execution on hardware.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop software stack for deep learning accelerator
Develop Compiler passes for graph ingestions, optimizations and partitioning.
Develop backend code generation capabilities across heterogeneous platforms
Profile, analyze and optimize system level performance, develop new tooling where necessary
Participate in design reviews, API development, and documentation
Successfully collaborate with hardware, software, applied science and product teams to onboard more and more user experiences to be powered by Deep Learning accelerator.
Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers

A day in the life
You join a small team building the compiler that brings large AI models to a new generation of custom silicon. The chip has a fraction of the memory of a phone, and the compiler is what makes language models run on it at all. The team is small enough that each engineer owns a meaningful piece of the system end to end. There is no layer between you and the problem.
The morning starts with results from an overnight run. A piece of the compiler you own just produced its tightest result yet on a real model. You ship the change for hardware validation.
You spend the afternoon directing AI agents through the codebase, reviewing their changes, and steering the design.
Before lunch, you load your compiled model onto the chip and run it through a demo app you wrote yourself, watching tokens stream out of silicon you helped make work. Later, you meet with the research team. They depend on your component. You sketch a cleaner interface together.

About the team
We sit at the intersection of AI models and custom silicon, and our work decides what is possible at the edge.
Engineers here bring deep experience across compilers and program analysis, optimization algorithms, computer architecture, machine learning systems, and the practical craft of getting large software to run reliably under tight constraints. People have shipped production code generators, tuned schedulers for novel hardware, and worked at every layer from the model down to the bare metal.
Because the team is small, you work alongside that experience daily, not at a distance. You partner directly with researchers shaping the models, hardware engineers shaping the silicon, and firmware engineers shaping the runtime. You learn how each layer constrains and unlocks the others, and you see your decisions land end to end.
This is a place to build technical depth quickly and own work that matters from day one.

jobs.title: Sr. SDE, AWS Agentic WorkSpaces - Forefront (Agentic Harness)

At Amazon we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. As a Senior SDE you'll lead the design and delivery of major components of the harness - with a particular emphasis on ranking and evaluation - tackle ambiguous greenfield problems where no playbook exists and raise the engineering bar across the team through design review mentorship and operational excellence. Because the harness is a multi-product platform you'll partner closely with other engineers UX and applied science across products - your work shows up in customer conversion admin productivity and the velocity of every team building on the platform.

Key job responsibilities

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
jobs.description:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll be essential in ensuring the team can reach their potential; working closely with them, reviewing their work, mentoring, and supporting them to develop. Together, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Audible's Catalog Management Systems (CMS) team owns the source for all Audible product catalog data. We build the systems that ingest content from publishers, augment and validate it, and publish it to the storefronts and partners where customers discover and access it. Our work spans the full catalog lifecycle, from ONIX and other provider feeds through ingestion and metadata services to pricing, availability, and publishing. A few beliefs guide how we work. Content is Audible's lifeblood, so we keep it flowing smoothly and rapidly, letting customers find and access what they want when they want it. We automate internal processes wherever we can, and involve people when their judgment is needed. We treat content providers as our customers, advocating for them and building tools that improve their experience. And we hold our systems to a clear standard: transparent, easy to learn and use, flexible as business needs change, and scalable as Audible grows. Organized into groups covering ingestion, publishing, operator tooling, and post-publish refinement, we partner closely with product and downstream teams across Audible to support new products and market expansion.

ABOUT YOU
You are talented, adaptable, and flexible. We’re looking for creative, open-minded Software Development Engineers to help build technologies that continuously improve the Audible listening experience. While focusing on iOS development you’ll build and scale mobile software, and coordinate cross-functionally by integrating new features, maintaining high performance, and creating intuitive interfaces. Our team is working on building native iOS products, without compromising compatibility with various iOS devices in an agile environment. Your primary focus is iOS, and we like for engineers to grow into full-stack work over time. Backend experience isn’t required—just a willingness to learn and contribute across the stack.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will...
- Develop, test, and maintain software components and applications for the world's largest audiobook creator and provider
- Identify and resolve software defects through code review, log analysis, metrics examination, debugging, and other troubleshooting methods
- Write maintainable and scalable code for software components as part of an agile engineering team
- Collaborate with stakeholders to envision, design, develop, test, and launch customer-centric software that inspires and impacts users

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron Distributed Training
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium, Amazon's custom machine learning accelerator. Neuron includes an ML compiler, runtime, collectives library, and application framework that integrate with PyTorch and JAX, so customers can train frontier-scale models on Trainium without rewriting their stack.

The Distributed Training team is at the forefront of training a wide range of models on AWS's custom ML accelerators, supporting novel architectures while maximizing their training performance. Working across the stack from PyTorch and JAX down to the hardware and software boundary, our engineers build the infrastructure that large-scale training depends on, develop new parallelism and numerics techniques, and tune high-performance kernels for the operations that dominate a training step, so every compute unit is doing useful work on our customers' most demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the limits of training efficiency at scale.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers, from frameworks and kernels through to the compiler, runtime, and collectives teams. This is hardware and software co-design in practice. A single throughput gap rarely sits in one layer, so tracing it means following the problem across the stack, deciding where the fix belongs, and working with the team that owns that layer to land it. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, since the gaps we characterize today become requirements for the next generation of Trainium. We work closely with customers to enable their models and ensure they train efficiently. This role offers a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed systems, where you will help shape the direction of AI acceleration technology.

You will architect and implement business critical features, and mentor a team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We are inventing. We are experimenting. It is a genuinely unique learning culture. The team works directly with customers on model enablement, providing hands-on support and optimization expertise so their training workloads reach the performance they need on AWS ML accelerators. We also collaborate with the open source ecosystem, contributing upstream so integration is seamless and performance holds at scale for customers and developers.

Key job responsibilities
You will lead efforts to optimize distributed training performance on Trainium, with a primary focus on training throughput, model FLOPs utilization, and time to convergence across the Neuron software stack. You will work across PyTorch, JAX, and the Neuron compiler and runtime to enable and tune large-scale training workloads on the latest Trainium instances. You will bring up model architectures that have never run on Trainium, identifying the missing operators, sharding strategies, and numerics needed to train them correctly, and then close the gap between correct and fast. You will own the parallelism strategies these models depend on, spanning data, tensor, pipeline, expert, and context parallelism, and apply reduced-precision formats where they measurably pay off. You will profile end to end to determine whether a workload is bound by compute, memory, collectives, or host overhead, then drive the fix to the layer that owns it, working with compiler, runtime, and collectives engineers to land it. You will translate the performance gaps you characterize into requirements that influence future Trainium architecture, and contribute upstream to the open source frameworks our customers train on.



A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.


About the team
Annapurna Labs was a startup company acquired by AWS in 2015, and is now fully integrated. If AWS is an infrastructure company, then think Annapurna Labs as the infrastructure provider of AWS. Our org covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. AWS Nitro, ENA, EFA, Graviton and F1 EC2 Instances, AWS Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML Accelerators, and in storage with scalable NVMe, are some of the products we have delivered, over the last few years.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) - Platform Engineering & Services
jobs.description:
What if every team at Amazon Fulfillment could build their own AI agent — one that already knows their systems, their data, and their processes — without writing model code? That's what we're building.

We're the team behind IRIS AI Studio, a self-service platform where engineering teams across Amazon's fulfillment network create, deploy, and operate custom AI agents. Teams connect their knowledge and tools, and walk away with a production-grade agent that can investigate incidents, answer domain-specific questions, and take real action — all through a no-code experience.

What makes this role different:

You're not building one AI product. You're building the platform that lets hundreds of teams build their own. You'll navigate the classic platform challenge: making something flexible enough for advanced use cases while keeping it simple enough for anyone to use. And unlike most AI platforms, yours operates in a world with physical consequences — when an agent gets it right, a facility avoids downtime; when it gets it wrong, packages don't move.

You'll work across the full stack — from the studio experience where agents are assembled, to the runtime infrastructure that keeps them reliable, to the integrations that connect agents to real operational systems. You'll own problems end-to-end, from design through production, and your work will shape how Amazon Fulfillment adopts AI across its global operations.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
jobs.description:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Data Center Bridge
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you want to solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry-defining projects that move the needle?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design and implementation of multi-component software systems across the full development lifecycle, from defining technical strategy through deployment and operational excellence.
- Own your team's architectural direction, making informed trade-offs between scalability, performance, security, and maintainability while ensuring software is extensible for future needs.
- Collaborate with engineers across related teams to align on system interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions that serve customers effectively.
- Mentor and coach engineers on your team and beyond, raising the engineering bar through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance that helps others grow.
- Evaluate and integrate generative artificial intelligence tools and emerging technologies where appropriate, applying responsible practices to improve team productivity and software quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a technical design document from a teammate, providing feedback that sharpens the approach before implementation begins. After a quick standup, you dive into coding a critical component of a system your team is building, ensuring it meets the high bar for clarity, error handling, and documentation you set for yourself. In the afternoon, you join a cross-team architecture discussion to align on shared interfaces, then wrap up by pairing with a junior engineer to help them work through a tricky problem.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, AI/ML, AWS Neuron, Model Inference
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch and JAX enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

The High-Performance Inference Systems & Acceleration team is at the forefront of running a wide range of models and supporting novel architecture alongside maximizing their performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working across the stack from PyTorch till the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, innovate new methods and create high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and kernels and collaborate with compiler to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

You will architect and implement business critical features, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive scale large language models like the Llama family, DeepSeek and beyond. The High-Performance Inference Systems & Acceleration team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build and tune distributed inference solutions with Trainium and Inferentia. Experience optimizing inference performance for both latency and throughput on such large models across the stack from system level optimizations through to Pytorch or JAX is a must have.

You can learn more about Neuron
https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index.html
https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success


Key job responsibilities
This role will help lead the efforts in building distributed inference support for Pytorch in the Neuron SDK. This role will tune these models to ensure highest performance and maximize the efficiency of them running on the customer AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon and servers. Strong software development using Python, System level programming and ML knowledge are both critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

- Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
- Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle including distributed computing based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing and production deployment.
- Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architecture.
- Design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
- Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
- Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
- Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling
- Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
- Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators
- Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques

A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important initiative.


About the team
The High-Performance Inference Systems & Acceleration team fosters a builder’s culture where experimentation is encouraged, and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, SRD Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Annapurna Labs, as part of AWS, is looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join the SW group and take a major part in redefining the future of AWS cloud.

We’re searching for engineers with a passion for networking to develop SRD (Scalable Reliable Datagram). SRD is a high-performance, low-latency transport protocol used within Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure to optimize network performance. SRD powers several high-impact, cutting-edge products, including on-demand ML and HPC platforms leveraging EFA, next-generation storage services built on EBS, and the future of AWS network traffic.

Are you ready to join the future?

* “The Tail at AWS Scale” paper (2024): https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10636119
* “A Cloud-Optimized Transport Protocol for Elastic and Scalable HPC“ paper (2020): https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9167399



Key job responsibilities
As an Embedded Software Engineer on the SRD team, your primary responsibility will be to develop and optimize SRD technology across AWS’s network infrastructure. You will work on cutting-edge, high-performance platforms that power ML, HPC, and storage-intensive workloads.

Your role will involve designing, deploying, and maintaining the SRD codebase, ensuring its reliability and scalability to meet the demands of diverse applications. You will gain in-depth knowledge of the various platforms and services running SRD within AWS, diving deep to understand their unique challenges and complexities.

Collaboration will be key, as you will work across multiple teams at different layers of the software stack. You will also contribute to defining new hardware modules and enabling offloads to enhance performance.

jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Amazon Leo OISL Star Tracker
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to help drive design and implementation of software systems that control, monitor, and manage Star Tracker flight hardware, including real-time device control, remote management, Linux integration, software build systems and release validation testing.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop, and optimize highly reliable flight software for Star Tracker flight systems, spanning low-level device drivers and real-time control loops to high-level autonomous behaviors, fault management, and AI/ML-driven decision-making that target Linux environments

* Architect and implement fault-tolerant, redundant software systems that keep systems operational with continuous uptime across a constellation of satellites, including health monitoring and autonomous recovery without ground intervention

* Build and maintain robust test, validation, and simulation infrastructure, from hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and software-in-the-loop virtualizations to automated regression suites

* Own the full lifecycle of embedded software delivery - from requirements decomposition and architecture design through implementation, code review, integration, deployment, and long-term maintenance of software running on satellites in orbit

* Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams spanning hardware, systems, communications, manufacturing and operations engineers to design, integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems that push the boundaries of space-based networking

* Develop and refine autonomous operational behaviors that enable satellites to independently recover and adapt to changing conditions, and respond to anomalies

* Drive continuous improvement of deployment and over-the-air (OTA) update processes, ensuring new capabilities and fixes can be safely and reliably delivered to hundreds of satellites on orbit with minimal operational risk

A day in the life
As a Senior Software Engineer on the OISL Star Tracker team, you won't just write code - you'll see it in action. Your software will control and monitor critical sensor hardware operating on hundreds of real satellites in orbit, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and on-the-ground verification to watching your code operate in-orbit and see the stars.

About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our devices smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.

We are looking for a senior software engineer who combines deep technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively, and someone who thrives at the intersection of hardware and software, space and ground, autonomy and operations.

jobs.title: SDE II, Amazon Fulfilment Tech, Amazon Fulfilment - Inventory Team
jobs.description:

AFT builds and operates the software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of fulfillment centers — moving billions of units of inventory, employing tens of thousands of people, and ensuring customers get what they want, when we promised it. We do this by building automated solutions for the things technology does well, while relying on people for the things humans do well.

Our team owns the Inventory Management System (IMS) that tracks and manages inventory across Amazon's global network of fulfillment centers. Every unit that moves through a fulfillment center depends on our systems to know what inventory exists, where it is, and whether it can be promised to a customer. Operating at this scale is uniquely complex: our systems must stay accurate and available in real time across billions of units and thousands of concurrent operations.

We are constantly innovating in how we track, reserve, and reconcile inventory — building on real-time events and data using cloud-based distributed systems. Our technology landscape spans cutting-edge AWS services and front-end technologies like React.
If you are excited to solve hard problems at massive scale and have a direct impact on how millions of customers get their orders, we would love to hear from you.

As a member of a small team, you will get the opportunity to work on highly visible, innovative projects that directly influence our customer & associates experience. Our engineers are top-notch software developers who love listening to the customers, working as a team, and proactively taking the lead whenever necessary.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon’s global fulfillment network. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Post Silicon Validation
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs, an AWS organization with development centers in the U.S. and Israel, builds custom silicon and software for AWS customers. Our team combines cloud-scale innovation with world-class expertise across silicon engineering, hardware design, verification, software, and operations to tackle technical challenges that have never been seen before.
Join our Silicon Validation team to validate next-generation machine learning accelerators that power AWS's cloud computing infrastructure. You'll work in a fast-paced, startup-like environment alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry on cutting-edge, internet-scale technology that directly impacts how customers use Machine Learning acceleration. We are changing the landscape of cloud infrastructure by accelerating the development of custom silicon by moving beyond traditional partnerships to dominate in AI training and inference

Your work will span validation of the complete vertical stack—silicon, PCB, high-speed components (HBM, PCIe, chip-to-chip), inter-system connections, and system-to-system interfaces. You'll dive deep into new technology hardware components and scaling technologies that power our Machine Learning boards and servers at scale, ensuring every component of our hardware and software comes together into products our customers rely on.

Key job responsibilities
As a Validation Engineer on our Machine Learning Acceleration team, you'll own critical validation aspects across the entire product development lifecycle—from early design validation through emulation, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and ongoing support of production systems deployed in AWS data centers. You'll collaborate deeply with architecture, RTL design, design verification, firmware, and software teams to ensure our next-generation AI/ML accelerators meet the highest standards of quality and performance. This role requires bridging multiple domains—from low-level hardware interfaces to high-level ML workloads—to deliver exceptional results.

We are looking for candidates with:
- Strong programming skills (Python, Lua, C/C++, Rust, Go, etc)
- A solid understanding of computer architecture
- Experience with AWS services, cloud infrastructure, firmware development (BIOS, BMC, drivers)
- Validation experience in any of these areas: PCIe, HBM, GPUs, neural networks, ML HW architecture, and/or CI/CD
- Familiarity with the validation lifecycle from RTL simulation (SystemVerilog/UVM, VCS, Questa, Xcelium) and emulation (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce) through silicon failure analysis and debug

A day in the life
- Developing comprehensive validation strategies and detailed test plans covering functional, performance, power, and stress testing from silicon bring-up to product release
- Executing complex test plans from RTL simulation and emulation environments through physical silicon validation
- Conducting hands-on silicon bring-up and debug in the lab using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
- Validating ML accelerator performance, accuracy, and reliability using real-world neural network workloads
- Building test infrastructure, CI/CD, and automated regression frameworks to enable efficient validation at scale
- Collaborating across architecture, design, firmware, and software teams to triage failures and drive root cause analysis to closure
- Reviewing test results, identifying patterns, and providing feedback to improve design quality and validation coverage
- Supporting production systems in AWS data centers and addressing field issues as they arise

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II — Ads Reporting, Programmatic Reporting Interfaces
jobs.description:
Amazon Advertising's Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization delivers campaign measurement and reporting across the advertising business and serves as the scientific center of excellence for measurement algorithm development. Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting (PREP) team builds the interfaces and engines that turn measurement data into consistent, accurate, and efficient reporting for advertisers and partners — through programmatic interfaces rather than dashboards. Other companies' systems talk to ours to measure and grow their Amazon advertising investment.

We operate at scale. Billions of ad impressions, clicks, and conversion events are processed and summarized every day across petabyte-scale data with millions of transactions per second. Delivering this reliably requires invention ahead of common technologies and event-driven architectures built on AWS.

This SDE II role spans two of our three tier-1 reporting surfaces and the engines behind them:

- Reporting API — the pull surface: an asynchronous API for occasional, experimental, and analytical queries, and the back end to the Unified Report Builder.

- Amazon Marketing Stream — the push surface for recurring, high-volume reporting data.

- The processing engines — including the Offline Engine (Iceberg + Spark on EMR) that computes the data those surfaces deliver.

You will own projects end to end — requirements, system design, implementation, testing, and production support — on systems built with Spark and EMR alongside AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions, Kinesis, and DynamoDB. The work is high-ownership and collaborative: you will partner with senior and principal engineers on architecture, and with product managers and technical account managers to translate customer pain points into features. You will also help deliver Unified Reporting as Amazon's single programmatic reporting solution and shift high-volume, recurring consumption from repeated API polling toward Amazon Marketing Stream.

Amazon is investing heavily in a world-class advertising business, and this team is at the forefront of that growth. We are highly motivated, collaborative, and direct, with a strong bias for action and a broad mandate to experiment. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you want to build the next generation of large-scale reporting systems on modern data and AWS technologies, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
1. Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable features and data solutions across the Reporting API, Amazon Marketing Stream, and the processing engines — from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, and production support.
2. Deep-dive into client and server systems to optimize performance, scalability, maintainability, and extensibility, integrating data across a large number of services.
3. Collaborate with senior and principal engineers on architecture and system design for high-impact, strategic projects, and navigate ambiguity to deliver results.
4. Write clean, maintainable code and raise the bar through peer code reviews and engineering standards.
5. Propose tools, frameworks, and automation adopted across the team, and drive operational excellence through monitoring and continuous improvement.
6. Partner with product managers, technical account managers, technical program managers, and mentees to understand customer needs, elevate the team, and promote engineering excellence.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about systems programming at the intersection of hardware and software? Do you want your code to directly accelerate the world's largest AI training and inference workloads? The Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) Drivers team is looking for Software Development Engineers to design and implement the kernel drivers and userspace libraries that power high-performance networking for AWS's AI/ML and HPC infrastructure.

EFA is the custom network interface that enables thousands of GPUs and accelerators to communicate at near-wire-speed bandwidth and low latency, making it a critical enabler of both foundation model training and real-time inference serving at unprecedented scale. When customers train the next generation of large language models or serve billions of inference requests with tight latency SLAs on Amazon EC2 P5, P6, or Trn instances, it's our driver stack that moves the data.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and optimize Linux kernel drivers (RDMA/EFA) and userspace provider libraries (rdma-core) that ship to millions of EC2 instances
- Work directly with custom hardware — collaborate with chip designers to bring new silicon capabilities to life in software
- Contribute to the upstream Linux kernel RDMA subsystem and rdma-core open-source project
- Architect solutions for next-generation networking features: GPU-direct RDMA, adaptive routing, collective offloads, and multi-path transport
- Build monitoring and automation tools to enhance driver testing for functionality, reliability, and performance
- Own the full lifecycle: from initial hardware bring-up and feature enablement through testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting across the global AWS fleet

Catalogs are at the forefront of modern Analytics, acting as the bridge between the consumption layer and data services. They effectively enable Engines to query information and allow humans and AI to find semantic meaning in data. Our suite of Catalog services make it easy to set up a secure data lake in days. A data lake is a centralized, curated, and secured repository that stores all your data, both in its original form and prepared for analysis. A data lake enables you to break down data silos and combine different types of analytics to gain insights and guide better business decisions.

Joining the AWS Catalog organization gives you the opportunity to:

We are looking for developers with expertise and passion for building large-scale data-intensive systems and distributed systems. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, SageMaker HyperPod Data Plane

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Lightsail
jobs.description:
Amazon Lightsail makes AWS accessible to developers and business customers who want to get their cloud stacks running in seconds without the complexity of traditional infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Lightsail team, you will build features and services that simplify compute, storage, networking, and website hosting for customers who need things to just work. The team is expanding quickly, adding new capabilities like website hosting and agent hosting, and you will help shape what comes next. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding customer problems through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are an engineer who enjoys building products you would actually use yourself, and you want to do that at AWS scale, we would like to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build features for Amazon Lightsail's distributed systems, working in Java, Go, JavaScript, and React across both backend services and frontend experiences.
- Collaborate with partner teams across AWS — including Amazon EC2, Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) — to integrate Lightsail capabilities with the broader AWS ecosystem.
- Own the operational health of the services you build by identifying root causes of production issues and driving permanent fixes, ensuring customers experience reliable performance.

Amazon Lightsail sits within AWS and has a distinctive mission: make cloud infrastructure simple and approachable for non-enterprise customers. While we run on the same AWS infrastructure that powers the world's largest workloads, our focus is on removing complexity so developers and small businesses can launch and scale without a steep learning curve. We are an inclusive team that values knowledge sharing and mentorship, and we intentionally assign projects to help each engineer grow. jobs.title: Embedded Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
jobs.description:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Amazon LEO Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Amazon LEO network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Java Runtime
jobs.description:
Are you fascinated by what happens beneath your code — how a compiler turns bytecode into blistering machine instructions, how a garbage collector reclaims memory without anyone noticing, how a runtime squeezes the last drop of performance out of the hardware? Maybe you've worked on garbage collection in a managed runtime like HotSpot, the .NET CLR, V8, or Chakra. Maybe you earned your expertise the hard way — tuning live services for performance and resilience under real production load. Whatever your path, the Java Runtimes Team at Amazon, owners of Amazon Corretto, would love to talk with you.

Java powers the majority of services at Amazon and nearly all public-facing AWS services. When we make the runtime faster or leaner, thousands of services — and millions of customers — feel it. You will work at the intersection of compilers, garbage collection, and systems software: finding bottlenecks in real running services, developing patches to the OpenJDK compiler, runtime, and libraries, and shipping them to every Amazon developer. You'll share what you learn with the broader engineering community and contribute your improvements back to OpenJDK — where the whole world runs them too.

This is deep, high-leverage systems work with an unusually direct line from your keyboard to global impact. We care about scalability, availability, and efficiency — and about going above and beyond to deliver the best possible Java experience for Amazon's internal teams, Corretto users, and the OpenJDK community.

Key job responsibilities
Identify areas for improvement using data from real running services, and turn those findings into concrete compiler, GC, and runtime optimizations.

Design, implement, and benchmark improvements to JIT compilation, garbage collection, and core runtime subsystems in the OpenJDK compiler, runtime, and libraries.

Contribute your changes upstream to OpenJDK and to Amazon Corretto, working through code review and the community process.

Tune runtime behavior for performance and efficiency across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) architectures.

Build profiling, observability, and auto-tuning tooling so runtime expertise scales across the fleet.

Share your findings with the engineering community and help service teams adopt runtime improvements and newer JDK versions

About the team
Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

In 2018 the team migrated Amazon's default JDK to OpenJDK, building rigorous security and quality mechanisms around it so that security and custom patches land internally the moment they are ready. We took that expertise and launched Amazon Corretto, Amazon's no-cost, production-ready distribution of OpenJDK — bringing our enhancements to customers and the OpenJDK community at large. Today we push the runtime forward across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) fleets, and we increasingly encode deep runtime expertise into tooling so that fleet-wide performance gains scale far beyond one-to-one consultation.

jobs.title: Robotics SDE, Safe Autonomy, Compass
jobs.description:
We are seeking a robotics Software Dev Engineer to join Compass. In this role, you will own the integration of the Compass software into various platforms, including mobile robots, mobile manipulators, and legged robots. You will interface with motion planning, sensing and perception, and safety firmware and create abstractions that enable the Compass software to be easily deployed across millions of robots.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain the software integration layer that enables Compass safety modules to interface with diverse robot platforms (mobile robots, manipulators, dynamically stable robots)
• Build robust abstractions and APIs that decouple safety logic from platform-specific hardware, enabling rapid deployment across new robot form factors
• Collaborate with motion planning, perception, and controls teams to ensure seamless data flow and real-time performance between safety systems and autonomy stacks
• Develop and maintain interfaces to safety-rated firmware and hardware, ensuring compliance with functional safety requirements
• Architect scalable, production-grade software that can operate reliably across millions of deployed robots
• Write high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code in C++ and/or Python for real-time robotics applications
• Define integration testing strategies and build simulation-based validation pipelines to verify safety behavior across platforms
• Contribute to system design reviews, technical documentation, and cross-team alignment on interface contracts
• Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in real-time safety-critical software paths
• Mentor junior engineers and raise the bar on software engineering practices within the team



A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Work with the inventors of control barrier functions on a novel, universal approach to safe autonomy: one that scales across mobile robots, manipulators, mobile manipulators, and future robot platforms with dynamic stability. You'll push the boundary of safe performance by integrating safety with motion planning, RL, and foundation models, ensuring that safety is never a blocker to robot performance. Your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon's unprecedented scale.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
jobs.description:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day.
