jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, AWS AI/ML Servers
jobs.description:
AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. When a model with billions of parameters trains across a large scale of GPUs, the software that provisions, monitors, and heals that fleet is what keeps training on track. We build the services, control planes, and data platforms that turn hundreds of thousands of servers into a reliable, self-managing system. If you want to build software at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and the physical infrastructure powering frontier AI, this is the role.

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to design and build the software that operates our accelerated compute fleet: fleet-management services, orchestration and remediation control planes, telemetry and analytics pipelines, and the APIs and tools that engineering, operations, and partner teams depend on. You will own software from design through production, working across multiple teams and organizations to deliver scalable, reliable services.

What You Will Do

You will design and build distributed services and data platforms that manage the fleet end to end. You will turn ambiguous problems into well-architected software: designing APIs, choosing data models, making the latency, availability, and cost trade-offs that come with operating at fleet scale. You will build the control planes that automate provisioning, health evaluation, and remediation, and the pipelines that transform raw telemetry into signals other teams act on. When your service catches and routes a failing node automatically before it disrupts a training job, that is your impact.

Why You Will Love It

Your software runs across a large scale of servers in the cloud, and you see its impact on fleet availability within days of shipping. You solve genuinely hard distributed-systems problems, own services end to end, and work close enough to the hardware to understand exactly what your software is managing. The team is small enough that your design decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you always have experts to learn from across software, hardware, and operations.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a strong software engineer first: you design clean abstractions, write high-quality, testable code, and reason about correctness, scalability, and failure modes. You care about the customer of your software, whether that is an operations engineer, a partner service, or an internal tool user. You communicate clearly, raise the engineering bar for your team, and can partner with hardware, firmware, and operations engineers to build software that reflects how the fleet actually behaves.

Key job responsibilities
Service & Platform Development

1. Design, build, and operate scalable distributed services and control planes that automate fleet provisioning, health evaluation, and remediation across a large scale of servers
2. Design APIs, data models, and system architectures that balance latency, availability, durability, and cost at fleet scale
3. Own software end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations, following engineering best practices for code review, source control, and CI/CD

Data & Telemetry Platforms

1. Build data and telemetry pipelines that ingest, correlate, and transform signals from across the fleet into actionable insights and automated actions
2. Develop analytics and reporting services, dashboards, and alerting that give engineering and operations teams real-time visibility into fleet health
3. Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to process high-volume telemetry efficiently and reliably

Reliability & Operational Excellence

1. Instrument services for observability; participate in post-incident reviews, identify contributing causes, and drive permanent software fixes that eliminate whole classes of risk
2. Improve the resilience, performance, and cost of the services you own, and reduce operational load through automation
3. Produce clear, maintainable documentation for services, APIs, and runbooks so others can operate and extend your work

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

1. Decompose complex problems into well-scoped components that you and other engineers can deliver in parallel
2. Partner with systems, firmware, hardware, and operations engineers to translate fleet behavior into software requirements and correct abstractions
3. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and set engineering standards for the team

May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing a design document for a new remediation control-plane API, leaving feedback on the data model and failure handling. Mid-morning, you pair with a teammate to debug elevated latency in the telemetry ingestion service and ship a fix. In the afternoon, you review overnight metrics from a service you own, then write code for a new fleet-health scoring pipeline. You end the day in a design review with a partner team, aligning on the API contract your service will expose to their tooling.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering AI/ML UltraServer platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end, from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

Why MQS?
Models, Quantum, & Silicon is a brand new organization within Amazon. We're building the full stack of compute to power the next era of innovation. One Org. One Mission. Limitless Impact!

Diverse Experiences

* Support computer-aided engineering and computational science workflows (e.g., Palace) by improving HPC environment robustness, performance, and availability across instance types and regions.

Working effectively within a team environment is essential. As an HPC Platform Engineer embedded in a research organization, you will have the opportunity to work on new ideas and stay abreast of the field of experimental quantum computation.


A day in the life
The majority of your time will be spent on projects that strengthen and scale our HPC platform and accelerate the computational workflows that underpin quantum hardware design. jobs.title: Software Engineer- Annapurna Labs (Tel Aviv / Haifa, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs and builds the custom silicon and systems software that power Amazon Web Services at scale — including **Nitro** (the hardware and hypervisor platform behind every modern EC2 instance) and **Graviton** (Amazon's Arm-based server processors used by millions of customers worldwide).

We are looking for talented **graduate software engineers** to join our Nitro and Graviton systems software teams. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll write low-level, high-performance software that runs directly on Amazon-designed chips — the kind of work where the code you write in your first year runs in production across the world's largest cloud. You'll be mentored by senior engineers, ramp up on real systems from day one, and grow into an expert in embedded and systems software.

If you love understanding how things work all the way down to the hardware, this is the team for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and debug embedded and systems software (firmware, drivers, low-level services) for Amazon's Nitro and Graviton platforms.

- Write and optimize code primarily in **C** and **C++**, working close to the hardware.

- Collaborate with hardware, silicon, and verification engineers to bring up new chips and platforms.

- Debug complex issues across the software/hardware boundary using logic analyzers, JTAG, and system-level tooling.

- Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and the continuous improvement of our software and processes.

- Learn continuously — from senior engineers, from the systems, and from a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike, but a typical one might include:

- Picking up a task from your team's backlog — a new driver feature, a firmware bug, or a bring-up item on a new chip revision — and pairing with your mentor to scope it.

- Writing and reviewing C/C++ code, then running it on real Amazon-designed hardware in the lab (or on emulation/simulation before silicon arrives).

- Debugging an issue that spans the software/hardware boundary — reading logs, attaching a debugger over JTAG, or reasoning through a trace with a hardware engineer sitting next to you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
jobs.description:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

The Frontier ADC team is at the forefront of delivering the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to our customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in this rapidly evolving field, leveraging the power of cloud computing and the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. With a focus on expanding Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated regions, driving automation investments, and delivering innovative solutions, we are at the forefront of modernization. Our teams are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud computing across the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio. We support the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio including services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II who can think big and simplify solutions to complex problems, all while ensuring our customers continue to have the best experience possible!

A successful Software Development Engineer II joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding government customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Frontier AI services in GovCloud and isolated environments. They will drive the resolution of technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

• Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

• Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Have strong software and systems skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in GovCloud and isolated environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across GovCloud and isolated regions. You will strive to build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer II in Frontier ADC, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud and isolated regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to leverage generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. Our engineering teams support services running in GovCloud and isolated regions, creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Frontier ADC team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, building solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Software Development Engineer II you will:

• Work cross-functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.

• Love to code. Whether it's building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

jobs.title: Software Security Engineer, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
The Annapurna Labs Security Team secures the firmware at the foundation of AWS custom silicon. We work on Graviton processors and the Nitro System — hardware that runs a substantial share of the world's cloud workloads — in close collaboration with the silicon architects and firmware developers who design it. Our engineers operate at the lowest levels of the stack: secure boot chains, hardware root of trust, attestation, cryptographic protocol design, and the boundaries between trust domains within the system.



Key job responsibilities
As a Security Engineer, you will threat model new silicon and firmware architectures, conduct low-level penetration testing against privileged and externally reachable interfaces, review designs and code across multiple firmware components, and build the fuzzing and analysis tooling that makes this work repeatable at silicon scale. You will also help raise the security bar across the wider organization through direct engagement with firmware and hardware teams. We are looking for engineers fluent in C and ARM assembly, with real depth in secure boot, applied cryptography, or embedded exploitation, and the technical credibility to hold a position in a room full of people who designed the system you are testing.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, TFS
jobs.description:
If you are looking for high impact, high growth opportunity with interesting engineering challenges in a fast-paced environment, this is the role for you. We have a number of untapped high impact engineering and business opportunities with high criticality for Amazon. And have the opportunity to work on the leading technologies like AI/ML, Gen-AI, RAG and various AWS systems.

What will you own?
You will work across a suite of products that drive complex business and engineering logic for managing financial accounting for ~$100B annual spend. These solutions leverage various AWS technologies and AI capabilities to solve large-scale complex problems. The systems demand non-trivial engineering, requiring deep business understanding and strong technical acumen. You will collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to identify opportunities for improving accuracy, expanding the solution across multiple geographies, and defining the technical roadmap while influencing solutions and tech decisions across teams.

Who we are?
We, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) are responsible for building technologies that support financial aspects for Amazon transportation. Amazon’s transportation systems get millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper while providing world-class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Our software systems include services that handle tens of thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted for. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever-expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales not only with volume but also with the business models. We leverage advanced technologies including big data, Gen-AI, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.

TFS is 100+ tech team across eight different platforms. We deal with problems of scale. Billions of dollars of spend is automated through our platforms and pipelines. We are a growing org and we are looking to ramp up our team across all engineering roles. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with our global product teams and customers across the world and other tech teams in the organization as we raise the bar in delivering innovation.
Our engineering team is completely based out of India, and we build global solutions.

We have a large product and tech roadmap and are significantly ramping our tech team to meet the next level of product requirements for Trans Finance.

- The Engineer in this job is expected to make the design (High level and Low level) decisions, own end to end (depth) for specific set of features while having breadth on rest of the features and provide technical guidance for the Junior members in the team.
- Design and implement scalable solutions using Scala or Java, and AWS services

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Eva Development Team
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the Data Center Gen AI Team
Join the Data Center Gen AI team, where we build generative AI solutions for AWS data centers. Our systems orchestrate physical work processes across AWS's worldwide data centers, directly impacting millions of customers who rely on AWS services.

Position Impact
You'll contribute to transforming data center operations through AI/ML innovations, helping build the platform primitives that dozens of teams across the Data Center Community rely on. You'll work on developing intelligent systems that optimize technician workflows, automate decision-making processes, and enhance operational efficiency across AWS's global infrastructure while supporting AI-powered capabilities for a 30K+ globally distributed user base.

Strong familiarity with one or more of the following:
- Generative AI / Agentic Systems — LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, tool-calling patterns, agent frameworks (Strands, LangChain)
- Full-Stack Serverless Engineering — AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, DynamoDB/RDS, EventBridge, SQS, CDK Infrastructure-as-Code
- Frontend & SDK Development — React, TypeScript, Cloudscape Design System, component library development, streaming interfaces (SSE)
- Search & Knowledge Systems — OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, vector embeddings, hybrid retrieval, document processing pipelines, semantic chunking
- ML & Data Engineering — SageMaker, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, classification models, feature engineering, ETL pipelines
- Platform & DevOps — CI/CD pipeline development, progressive deployment, synthetic monitoring, observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenTelemetry)

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Thrives in ambiguous environments and is eager to learn and adapt quickly
- Demonstrates a bias for action with the ability to deliver results in fast-paced settings
- Builds and maintains solid technical depth while staying customer-focused
- Shows genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for AI/ML advancements
- Has working knowledge of AI/ML technology application (LLMs, agents, RAG, Skills, ML models)
- Takes ownership of features and components end-to-end, driving them to completion with guidance from senior engineers
- Balances pragmatic execution with creative problem-solving

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the future of AWS data center operations through innovative AI/ML solutions while working with advanced technologies at unprecedented scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop AI/ML platform features and solutions, contributing to systems that serve both data center operations and engineering teams
- Own end-to-end delivery of features and components, including AI integrations, deployment pipelines, and user-facing interfaces for non-ML experts
- Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to integrate ML solutions into existing DC workflows, ensuring system quality and scalability
- Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code while actively contributing to improvements in development processes, particularly for GenAI development and deployment
- Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, bringing a customer-focused perspective to architectural decisions
- Design and implement reusable components and tools that enhance team productivity and system reliability
- Stay current with AI/ML advancements and proactively identify opportunities to apply new techniques to data center challenges

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Elastic Container Service
jobs.description:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is forming a new team in Seattle with a bold mission: dramatically reduce the time it takes for containerized workloads to become ready to run on Fargate. The vast majority of customer tasks are short-lived, making launch speed one of the most impactful levers for customer experience — and we're going after a step-function improvement.

As an SDE on the Workload Optimization team, you'll work at the intersection of container runtimes, operating systems, and networking to optimize the end-to-end launch path. This is deep systems work with direct, measurable customer impact at enormous scale.


Key job responsibilities
- Build and optimize container startup and runtime systems using Linux kernel, containerd/runc, and Bottlerocket
- Design and implement solutions across the container networking and instance preparation stack
- Work on one of the highest-scale container orchestration platforms in the world
- Join a founding team with greenfield ownership and the opportunity to shape technical direction from day one

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Measurements and Data Science (MADS)
jobs.description:
Love building and leading high-performing engineering teams? Want to own the systems that keep billing accurate and trustworthy for millions of advertisers spending billions of dollars worldwide? Excited to lead the shift from manual financial operations to AI-powered and agentic automation? Then, the Iron Mountain platform team wants you!

Amazon Advertising is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost product reach and sales through performance and display advertising. The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system that manages all advertiser billing, invoicing, accounting automation, real-time budgeting, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) — processing multi-billion transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily, worldwide, across all ad products displayed On or Off Amazon.

Billing accuracy is a critical pillar of this platform. This team owns billing corrections (credits and rebills), offline and alternative payment workflows, and the revenue-integrity mechanisms that make advertising billing transparent and auditable end to end — serving thousands of correction requests each year from partners across Ads Sales, Finance, Accounting, and FinOps. The multi-year roadmap transforms this space into self-service and intelligent automation: AI-driven investigation of billing defects, agentic correction workflows, and advertiser-facing self-service experiences.

The Iron Mountain team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this Bengaluru-based team. You will:

Lead, hire, and develop a team of 8+ engineers, owning their growth, delivery, and engineering excellence
Own the product and technical roadmap for billing corrections and offline payments — from high-volume manual workflows today to automated, self-service, and agentic experiences through 2027
Drive operational excellence for tier-1 billing systems where accuracy and availability directly protect advertiser trust and Amazon revenue
Shape how GenAI and AI agents interact with financial systems safely — automation with auditability, guardrails, and zero tolerance for monetary error
Partner across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, and ad-product teams worldwide to reduce correction volume at the root cause, not just process it faster
Be a player-coach: technically strong enough to hold the bar in design reviews, while spending your energy on people, roadmap, and delivery
To succeed, you will bring a track record of building strong teams and delivering large-scale distributed systems, comfort operating business-critical financial services, and a forward-looking perspective on how AI transforms financial operations — combined with people-first leadership that grows engineers as fast as it ships software.

Key job responsibilities
People & Team Leadership

-Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of SDEs.
-Set technical direction and priorities, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term architectural investments
-Foster a culture of operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement
-Drive career development for team members, providing regular coaching and feedback
-Collaborate cross-functionally with partner teams and stakeholders to align on roadmaps and dependencies.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in the development of services that keep advertising billing accurate and trustworthy at global scale. You will lead a dynamic group of passionate engineers and collaborate with peer teams across Ads, Finance, and Accounting to identify automation opportunities, design novel solutions that meet customer requirements, and build software that intelligently detects and remediates billing defects across our worldwide advertising platforms. You will be building highly available, scalable, and auditable architecture — increasingly powered by AI and agentic workflows — to execute financial corrections safely and effectively.

About the team
The Cashmere team builds software which supports the automated detection, correction, and settlement of advertiser billing, empowering humans to automate key financial operations and take themselves out of the loop as Amazon Advertising scales. We own services that model billing behaviors across ad products and marketplaces, identify and remediate defects before they reach advertisers, capture the financial and compliance constraints of our systems, and execute credits, rebills, and offline payments that serve our customers while preserving accuracy, auditability, and advertiser trust.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking talented engineers to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

If you are passionate about safety and performance and have an interest in robotics systems, then we would like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customers.


Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain novel robotic systems, contributing to the architectural design of complex systems and collaborating with peers and other teams to find solutions to challenging problems.
- Take end-to-end ownership of features — from design through validation, launch, and the issues that surface in the field.
- Engage and challenge ideas constructively in design reviews, and once the team decides, commit fully to the team's decision and help make it succeed.
- Contribute valuable feedback during peer reviews, effectively communicate with technical leadership, and develop new and innovative solutions in a high-paced R&D environment that balance performance and reliability.
- Ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains — networking and WiFi, security, navigation, obstacle detection, motor control, functional-safety-related control, and diverse sensors — and go deep where the problem demands it.

A day in the life
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you'll work with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and debug modern robotic systems. Your day spans design discussions and brainstorming novel approaches to the hardest robotics problems, implementing new product concepts and features, and shifting between bare-metal/real-time OS (RTOS) code code and Linux kernel-level work as the problem demands. Testing ranges from writing automated tests that validate new features to hands-on bench and live testing to reproduce and root-cause failures — whether they surface in the firmware, in the kernel, or in the board itself.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon Quick
jobs.description:
Generative AI is transforming how people work, but one problem is still unsolved: how do you give an AI assistant to 100,000 employees and keep the right guardrails in place? How do you enforce data sovereignty, audit every AI action, and comply with regulations like the EU AI Act, all without slowing down the teams building the product?

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Quick Governance team, you will set the technical direction for the policy infrastructure and enforcement systems that make enterprise AI safe at scale. You will own the architecture of distributed Java services that sit where authorization, compliance, and AI governance meet — systems where correctness is non-negotiable and every decision must be explainable. You will take ambiguous problems that span multiple teams, define the technical strategy, and lead engineers from design through delivery and operations. Our goal is to make the governed path the easiest path: a platform any Quick team can plug into and get policy enforcement, auditability, and observability out of the box.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the architecture for how governance policies are authored, versioned, assigned, and evaluated across complex organizational hierarchies, including group-based assignment, inheritance, and precedence — designed so new governance domains can be added without your team being on the critical path for every integration.
- Design control-plane workflows and contracts that turn administrator intent into policy artifacts for downstream enforcement services across regions, setting the bar for consistency, auditability, and safe rollout across environments.
- Lead the technical strategy for telemetry and analytics pipelines that show how AI is used across an organization, including usage dashboards, audit trails, compliance reporting, SIEM integration, and anomaly detection at enterprise scale.
- Drive alignment with authorization, identity, and guardrails teams on shared interfaces and end-to-end governance design, write and review design documents, and make clear trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.
- Mentor and grow engineers on the team, lead design and operational reviews, drive operational excellence, and actively contribute to hiring.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing a design document for a new policy-inheritance model, then lead a cross-team architecture session with the identity and guardrails teams to align on shared contracts. After lunch you write Java code for a control-plane workflow that orchestrates safe policy rollouts across regions. Later you pair with a teammate to investigate an anomaly in the compliance-reporting pipeline, and close out the day by giving design feedback to a junior engineer working on the admin observability dashboard.

About the team
Amazon Quick is a generative AI-powered assistant that helps employees be more productive by answering questions, generating content, providing summaries, and completing tasks, all securely grounded in enterprise data. Quick serves some of the world's largest enterprises, with deployments spanning hundreds of thousands of users. The Quick Governance team builds the unified admin controls, policy platform, and observability layer that let these customers adopt AI safely, responsibly, and in line with regulations. If you want to define how enterprises govern AI at scale, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Luna SIPS
jobs.description:
Amazon Luna is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join the SIPS (Streaming Infrastructure and Provisioning Services) team. SIPS owns the infrastructure and services responsible for provisioning, managing, and efficiently utilizing the compute fleet that powers Luna's cloud gaming platform.

Cloud gaming presents a unique infrastructure challenge. We need to have the right GPU capacity available in the right AWS regions at the right time, while balancing customer experience, availability, performance, and infrastructure cost. The systems owned by SIPS operate at large scale and sit directly in the critical path of launching and running game sessions for Luna customers.

As an SDE II on SIPS, you will design, build, and operate distributed services that manage the lifecycle of our compute infrastructure. You will work on problems such as automated fleet scaling, capacity provisioning, instance lifecycle management, workload placement, infrastructure utilization, and improving the reliability and efficiency of our platform.

You will work closely with engineers across Luna and AWS to solve problems that span application software, distributed systems, EC2 infrastructure, GPUs, networking, and capacity management. You will have opportunities to take ambiguous infrastructure problems, develop technical solutions, and drive them from design through production.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate distributed services that power Luna's streaming infrastructure and provisioning platform.
- Build and improve systems for automated capacity provisioning, fleet scaling, instance lifecycle management, and workload placement across AWS regions.
- Develop solutions that improve GPU and compute utilization while maintaining high availability, performance, and customer experience.
- Own features and services end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and production operations.
- Diagnose and resolve complex production issues spanning distributed services, EC2 infrastructure, networking, and GPU environments.
- Improve the scalability, reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of SIPS services and reduce manual operational work through automation.
- Work closely with engineers across Luna and AWS to support new game launches, infrastructure capabilities, instance types, and regional expansion.
- Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical decisions, and help improve engineering standards and development practices across the team.
- Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to a strong engineering and operational culture.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, CloudFront Media & Entertainment
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy watching the latest movies, television shows, or sporting events on your computer, tablet or smartphone? Do you hate waiting for your pages to load or your show to re-buffer? Do you want to contribute to systems that deliver a flawless experience in serving video from the edge for high profile customers?

AWS Cloudfront is looking for experienced Software Development Engineers to join our team in beautiful Dublin, Ireland. We offer comprehensive relocation and benefit packages.
At AWS Cloudfront, working on systems with global scale is a daily part of the job. We solve hard problems. We build reliable, scalable, low-cost systems that serve our ever-growing customer base. We are constantly shipping features that drive innovation in the CDN market. We deliver an elegant geo-distributed platform to serve not only video from the edge, but a wide variety of use cases.

We:

Are a fast-growing, agile and collaborative group of technologists from diverse backgrounds.
Are inventors and owners, building new technologies and improving existing ones.
Obsess over our customers' needs and experience.
Enjoy the prototyping and tinkering stages, as well as the rigor of making solutions production-ready.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and deliver scalable software solutions using an iterative and agile development approach.
- Collaborate closely with a strong team of software engineers and technologists to solve complex problems and build high-impact products and services.
- Take end-to-end ownership of projects, driving them from design and development through delivery while ensuring high-quality outcomes.
- Build and operate highly scalable, reliable services that support millions of customers and users.
- Analyze systems and architectures at scale, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously enhance performance, reliability, and efficiency.
- Share knowledge, learn from peers, and actively contribute to the growth and development of team members through collaboration, mentorship, and constructive feedback.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Seller and AM GenAI Tools
jobs.description:
Amazon's International Seller Services (ISS) org is seeking a Software Development Engineer to be part of an engineering team working on innovative products and tools across 3P. 3P sellers WW register on Amazon and sell a large selection of products around the WW. Account Managers and other partners help onboard sellers into Amazon and help them grow their business. We are developing innovative products that leverage generative and agentic AI to transform workflows for Sellers. Our aim is to help partners in every aspect of their daily activities as they help sellers improve selection, grow and expand their business worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
You will be a critical part of a team of software engineers, building Seller and AM tools and transformative solutions powered by cloud computing and generative AI. This role offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of agentic AI and distributed systems, building new products and services from the ground up and enhancing existing tools.

A day in the life
In a typical day, you will be working with a team of engineers working on a variety of products ranging from AI Assistants for Sellers to register on Amazon, ensure their listings are compliant and adopt various programs to sell across markets. You will also be working on automating workflows for AMs, managing various tasks and automation. You will be working with Products Managers and AMs worldwide to create and execute a roadmap of compelling user experiences. A closer partnership with other engineering teams and applied science team will be very critical. You will be extremely curious about learning and incorporating the latest developments in generative AI to develop products that deliver agentic AI solutions.

About the team
The team sits in Amazon's International Service Org that creates tools, products and agentic AI solutions for Seller and Account Managers worldwide. The products will include a mix of solutions that are common across Sellers in multiple countries and solutions customized for Sellers in each country.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Now
jobs.description:
Do you want to invent a brand-new quick-commerce platform from the ground up? Amazon Now is building the future of 10-minute delivery for India's fast-growing grocery and essentials market, and we're looking for talented engineers who want to do more than write code — you'll own components that thousands of customers touch within minutes of a change going live, and help shape the product, the architecture, and the business roadmap. This is not maintenance work; it's a high-visibility, grounds-up initiative where you'll design and build the entire shopping lifecycle — discovery, storefront, ordering, and delivery — using modern ReactJS front-ends and backend services built from scratch.

You'll work alongside senior engineers and product leaders to solve difficult, ambiguous problems at scale, making pragmatic trade-offs without over-engineering. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your work directly influences both the technology and the customer experience on a platform designed to scale beyond India, this is the role for you.




Key job responsibilities
a) Design and deliver complex, scalable components of the quick-commerce platform end-to-end, spanning discovery, storefront, ordering, and delivery experiences
b) Contribute actively to the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and operational support for production systems
c) Make sound architecture and trade-off decisions on technology choices, dependencies, and resource efficiency, balancing speed of iteration with long-term maintainability and quality
d) Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and customer needs into technical solutions that deliver measurable impact
e) Ensure operational excellence by identifying and resolving root causes of issues, raising the engineering bar on reliability and scaling, and sharing knowledge through code reviews

A day in the life
Your day blends inventing and building stable, performant software with your team through pragmatic design discussions and thorough code reviews. You'll make critical architecture decisions — whether to reuse existing components or build new ones, which dependencies to adopt, how to optimize for resource efficiency — while pairing with senior engineers on complex technical challenges. You'll collaborate directly with customers and stakeholders to refine project ideas, then move quickly under a build-fast, iterate-fast model without compromising on quality or operational discipline.

About the team
We're the India Grocery & Everyday Essentials team building Amazon Now — a grounds-up quick-commerce experience for India's fast-growing 10-minute-delivery market. Our team of senior engineers and product leaders is creating industry-leading shopping experiences spanning discovery through delivery. We value high ownership, a proactive approach, and the highest engineering standards, and we move fast and iterate quickly.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo Commerce, Amazon Leo Commerce
jobs.description:
Want to help connect millions of unserved and underserved communities to high-speed broadband internet — from space? Amazon Leo Commerce is Amazon's initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites that deliver low-latency, high-speed connectivity worldwide. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the Customer Engagement Systems team and build the telecom applications and services that power how customers order, activate, and manage their broadband subscriptions.

In this role, you will design and implement components that sit at the intersection of satellite networking and customer-facing communications services. You will work across the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and system design through testing, deployment, and operations — solving problems that have never been solved before at this scale.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement telecom components, applications, and services for customer ordering, billing, subscriber management, and notifications
- Partner with the Satellite, Networks, and Security engineering teams to integrate Customer Engagement Systems with the core network
- Design scalable components, services, and data models that support high-reliability communications workloads
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle including code reviews, testing, deployment, and operational support, ensuring root causes of issues are identified and permanently resolved
- Document system architecture and mentor teammates on how your software is constructed, operated, and maintained

A day in the life
You will spend your time designing and building services that enable customers to subscribe to and interact with a global satellite broadband network. On a given day you might be whiteboarding a new data model with a teammate, reviewing pull requests, or collaborating with the Networks team on an integration point. You will balance heads-down coding with cross-team design discussions and operational readiness activities.

About the team
Our team owns the architecture and roadmap for managing the customer ordering and billing lifecycle, subscriber management services, customer notifications, and customer metrics and analytics for Amazon Leo Commerce. We are a collaborative group building systems from the ground up to support a global telecom service, and we work closely with Satellite, Networks, and Security engineering teams to bring broadband connectivity to communities around the world.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Java Runtime
jobs.description:
The Java Runtimes Team (JRT) owns and advances the Java runtime that powers a large share of Amazon's production services. We work at the intersection of language runtimes, compilers, and hardware — tuning the JVM and its ecosystem so that thousands of services run faster, use less memory, and scale more efficiently across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) fleets. We contribute directly to OpenJDK and our Corretto JDK, and we build the tooling that turns deep runtime expertise into automated, fleet-wide performance gains.

We are hiring a Runtime Engineer to work across three closely-linked areas: the JIT compiler, garbage collection, and systems-level software optimization. You will profile real production workloads, identify runtime bottlenecks, prototype and land improvements in the JVM, and help encode that expertise into tools that scale beyond one-to-one consultation.

Key job responsibilities
1. Analyze production JVM workloads to identify compiler, GC, and runtime bottlenecks, and translate findings into concrete optimizations.
2. Design, implement, and benchmark improvements to JIT compilation, garbage collection, and core runtime subsystems.
3. Contribute changes upstream to OpenJDK and to Amazon Corretto, working through code review and community processes.
4. Tune runtime behavior for performance and efficiency across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) architectures.
5. Build and improve profiling, observability, and auto-tuning tooling so runtime expertise scales across the fleet rather than through manual, per-service consultation.
6. Validate performance and reliability of changes against real workloads before broad rollout.
7. Partner with service teams to drive adoption of runtime improvements and newer JDK versions.

About the team
Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Neuron Explorer
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Trainium and Inferentia cloud-scale machine learning accelerators and the Trn3/Trn2/Trn1 and Inf2/Inf1 servers that use them. This role is for a Software Development Engineer on the Developer Experiences (DevEx) team within AWS Neuron, based in Toronto.

The Neuron Explorer team makes AWS Trainium performance visible. We own Neuron Explorer, the tool for profiling, debugging, and optimizing machine learning workloads on Trainium and Inferentia. We build profiling, debugging, and analysis tools that let engineers see how efficiently models and kernels use the hardware, pinpoint bottlenecks, and decide what to optimize next. Neuron Explorer traces execution from source code down to hardware operations across both single-node and distributed applications. Our goal is to cut through complex execution data so customers can optimize faster and reach higher performance on Trainium.

As the Software Development Engineer for the Neuron Explorer team, you will design, build, and operate the full stack behind Neuron Explorer — from low-level performance data collection and analysis engines to interactive visualizations and developer workflows. You will own features end to end, spanning the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI, and you will help push our AI-powered recommendation and analysis capabilities that automatically surface bottlenecks and guide optimization.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build performance data collection pipelines and analysis engines that transform raw hardware execution data into actionable insights for Neuron Explorer users.
- Develop interactive visualizations and developer workflows that make complex profiling data understandable, helping customers pinpoint bottlenecks across single-node and distributed training workloads.
- Own features end to end across the full software development lifecycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — ensuring reliability and maintainability.
- Collaborate with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to surface the right performance information so internal and external customers can optimize AI workloads on Trainium and Inferentia hardware.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities into Neuron Explorer's recommendation engine, building features that automatically identify optimization opportunities and guide customers toward higher performance.

A day in the life
You will work across the backend processing pipeline, the web UI, and the CLI that make up Neuron Explorer, partnering with compiler, runtime, and chip architecture teams to expose the data customers need to optimize their models. You will work with senior technical leaders and management to define product direction and deliver it to customers, including teams bringing massive-scale multi-modal large language models to peak performance on Trainium. We build the full stack of software, servers, and chips to accelerate machine learning at the highest scale.

About the team

We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences.

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Elasticache, AWS ElastiCache
jobs.description:
Build the next-generation in-memory database services!

AWS ElastiCache, a fully-managed in-memory data store compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, enables customers to build data-intensive apps or boost existing database performance by retrieving data from high throughput and low latency in-memory data stores.

AWS MemoryDB, a Valkey and Redis OSS compatible, durable, in-memory database service, delivers ultra-fast performance for modern, micro services applications.

The AWS In-Memory Databases team uses ideas from several facets of computer science – data storage, distributed computing, and more – to help customers build low latency and fast performance NoSQL systems. Our high availability and scalable in-memory distributed services are powered by open source and optimized for sub-millisecond latency at scale. We are influencing the direction of NoSQL systems throughout the industry – and we want you to be a part of it.

We are seeking motivated, passionate backend engineers to work with in-memory database technologies including Valkey, Redis OSS and Memcached and make AWS ElastiCache the best place to run these engines. You will use your analytical, design, and problem-solving skills to build next-generation technologies in areas of horizontal and vertical scaling, data replication, data sharding and migration algorithms as well as robust authentication/authorization protocols. As part of this role you will work closely with Valkey OSS community to influence and contribute net new features as well as performance optimizations to open-source Valkey.

Our team understands and values work life balance. Most days, our entire team is co-located in the Dublin office, but support occasional remote work if needed. We generally keep core in-office hours from 10am to 4pm and provide flexibility for people to structure their working hours around them.

The role involves day time on-call responsibilities, typically once every 2-3 months. We don’t like to get paged in the middle of the night or on weekends; so we investigate operational gaps on a weekly basis, proactively root-cause issues and fix them for good.

Our team has a mixture of engineers from diverse backgrounds and tenures. We are dedicated to supporting new team members through on-boarding buddies and mentorship.

We try to assign projects based on each team member’s unique background and provide them opportunities to learn new skills to make them better rounded engineers. We celebrate knowledge sharing and encourage each member to participate and learn through team wide design reviews.

Our team is intentional in building a daily work environment where mutual respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated. We seek diverse perspectives in our team meetings and respect honest feedback to help us make effective decisions.

Elastic Cache is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer I, Graviton Software, Annapurna Labs

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Tech L), DSO (Demand Science Optimization)
jobs.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer driving the re-architecture of Amazon Devices' pricing and assortment planning platform — the system that decides what devices sell where, when, and at what price, across every Amazon device sold worldwide. This role owns the design and delivery of a new domain-modeled system: collapsing a fragmented legacy input pipeline into an automated platform that determines pricing and retailer placement for over 21,000 products across 7 device families and 22+ countries.

The team's scope is growing, and you will shape how it grows.

What you will work on:

- Setting technical direction and architecture across the services the team owns
- Raising the engineering bar through design review, code review, and operational standards
- Aligning with engineers on partner teams on shared interfaces and ownership boundaries
- Replacing recurring manual work with automation and better design
- Mentoring engineers as they grow into deeper technical ownership

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the most technically complex parts of the input layer, using AI-assisted development and agents to replace work that is manual today
- Set technical direction and architecture, including decisions to consolidate, rebuild, or retire systems
- Lead design and code reviews, and define the operational standards a service meets before the team owns it
- Partner with product managers, scientists, and engineers on other teams to turn requirements into designs and to align on shared interfaces and ownership boundaries
- Mentor engineers through design guidance, written documentation, and pairing

A day in the life
Your primary focus is the layer of inputs that Amazon's device planning, forecasting, and inventory systems all read from. A handful of services, and every build and allocation decision downstream depends on them agreeing.

You're rebuilding that layer to easily allow stakeholders to manage a whole product line's inputs for high-impact decisions. You'll make the calls on what that architecture looks like.

Beyond this system, an Sr. SDE in DSO is expected to operate across charters — bringing technical judgment to whichever part of the org needs it most at a given time, representing the team in cross-charter design discussions, and mentoring engineers across projects.

About the team
We own the inputs Amazon's device planning, forecasting, and inventory systems depend on — the data behind what gets built, where it ships, and at what price. Our customers are internal: the planners who own each product line, finance partners, and the science and engineering teams downstream. You'll work with them directly.
We're rebuilding it so each input lives in one place and stays correct without someone tending it, moving toward agent-based interfaces.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Catalog
jobs.description:

Amazon Selection & Catalog Systems (ASCS) is the engine behind the world's largest product catalog. Billions of products. Hundreds of millions of real-time updates daily. Every price change, every new listing, every inventory shift, our systems make it happen, 24/7/365, at a scale where textbook solutions simply don't apply.

Massively distributed systems that push the limits of scale and performance

You're comfortable leading across team boundaries — aligning with business owners, senior developers, and principals
You're energized by ambiguity and greenfield work, not intimidated by it
You ship, you learn, you iterate

Direct impact on hundreds of millions of customers and sellers worldwide, your work shows up in the shopping experience, every day
Ground floor of a new technology stack with a clear scaling trajectory
Cutting-edge problem space: LLMs, distributed systems, big data, applied to real products at real scale
A team that's fast-moving, collaborative, and genuinely fun to work with


Key job responsibilities

Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to drive services optimizations, cost, and security.
Use software engineering best practices to ensure a high standard of quality for all of the team deliverables
Write high quality distributed system software
Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of AI Accelerators at AWS Neuron
We build Amazon Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Machine Learning Applications team, you will optimize the world's most demanding AI models at a scale few engineers ever get to work on. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

You can learn more about Neuron
https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com
https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/ https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
This role will help lead the efforts in building distributed inference support for Pytorch in the Neuron SDK. This role will tune these models to ensure highest performance and maximize the efficiency of them running on the customer AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon and servers. Strong software development using Python, System level programming and ML knowledge are both critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models including GPT, Kimi, and Qwen on custom AI accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle including distributed computing based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, low level optimizations, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architecture.
* Design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques
• Develop kernels to improve model efficiency on Amazon AI Accelerators
• Transform complex tensor operations into highly optimized graph implementations
• Optimize state-of-the-art language, vision, and multimodal generative AI models for Neuron hardware

What Makes This Role Unique:
• Direct influence on AWS's AI Accelerator used by thousands of ML applications
• Full-stack optimization from high-level frameworks to low level primitives
• Collaboration with both open-source ML communities and hardware architecture teams
• Requires passion for performance tuning and system architecture


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important initiative.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.


About the team
At AWS Neuron, we're revolutionizing how the world's most sophisticated AI models run at scale through Amazon's next-generation AI accelerators.
The Inference Enablement and Acceleration team is at the forefront of running a wide range of models and supporting novel architecture alongside maximizing their performance for Amazon's custom ML accelerators. Working across the stack from PyTorch till the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic software stack, innovate new methods and create high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. The team collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

jobs.title: Software Developer II, Cosmos
jobs.description:

The Cosmos team is looking for a Software Development Engineer I to help build and scale our real-time data infrastructure that collects, processes, and delivers telemetry from robotic workcells across Amazon's fulfillment network.

As a Software Engineer on Cosmos, you will work on the systems that ingest millions of events per day from robotic equipment, process them through streaming pipelines, and land them in our data lake where they drive operational insights and business decisions. Our stack includes Java and TypeScript services deployed via CDK, with streaming powered by Kinesis and Flink, and analytics via Athena. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of robotics, data engineering, and distributed systems in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

- Design, develop, and maintain components of the Cosmos data pipeline, including event ingestion, stream processing, and data lake storage
- Write clean, well-tested production code to support real-time and batch data processing
- Collaborate with robotics engineering teams to onboard new event types and data models into the Cosmos platform
- Participate in operational excellence activities including monitoring, alarming, and on-call support for team-owned services
- Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning within an agile development team
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues in distributed systems, working across service boundaries when needed

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
jobs.description:
The Frontier ADC team delivers the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We expand Frontier AI services into new regions, automate service deployment and operations, and build solutions that meet the security, availability, and scale requirements of government customers. Our teams build and operate massively scalable distributed systems across services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Software Development Manager who can think big, set technical and organizational direction, and build a high-performing engineering team. This leader will simplify complex problems while ensuring our customers receive a secure, reliable, and consistent experience.

A successful Software Development Manager will lead a team responsible for building, launching, and operating Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated environments. They will work closely with Amazon’s largest and most demanding government customers, own the team’s technical roadmap and delivery commitments, develop engineers, and drive the resolution of complex technical and operational issues. They will partner across service teams, security, infrastructure, product, and operations to deliver solutions that address the unique requirements of these environments.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” The right candidate will enjoy building teams, creating an inclusive environment, and helping engineers do the best work of their careers.

- Think big. You will establish a strategy for building and deploying solutions across multiple services and regions. You will create mechanisms that allow the organization to scale without scaling operational effort at the same rate.
- Raise the bar. You establish strong engineering practices, guide design and operational reviews, and create a culture that values ownership, technical rigor, and continuous improvement.
