jobs.title: Machine Learning - Compiler Engineer , AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
Do you want to be part of AI revolution? At AWS our vision is to make deep learning pervasive for everyday developers and to democratize access to AI hardware and software infrastructure. In order to deliver on that vision, we’ve created innovative software and hardware solutions that make it possible. AWS Neuron is the SDK that optimizes the performance of complex ML models executed on AWS Inferentia and Trainium, our custom chips designed to accelerate deep-learning workloads.

This role is for a software engineer in the Compiler team for AWS Neuron. As part of this role, you will be responsible for building next generation Neuron compiler which transforms ML models written in ML frameworks (e.g, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX) to be deployed AWS Inferentia and Trainium based servers in the Amazon cloud. You will be responsible for solving hard compiler optimization problems to achieve optimum performance for variety of ML model families including massive scale large language models like Llama, Deepseek, and beyond as well as stable diffusion, vision transformers and multi-model models. You will be required to understand how these models work inside-out to make informed decisions on how to best coax the compiler to generate optimal implementation instruction. You will leverage your technical communications skill to partner with internal and external customers/stakeholders and will be involved in pre-silicon design, bringing new products/features to market, ultimately, making Neuron compiler highly performant and easy-to-use.

Experience in object-oriented languages like C++/Java is a must, experience with compilers or building ML models using ML frameworks on accelerators (e.g., GPUs) is preferred but not required.
Experience with technologies like OpenXLA, StableHLO, MLIR will be added bonus!

Explore the product and our history! https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index
htmlhttps://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
You will design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform Neuron compiler’s performance, stability and user-interface. You will work side by side with chip architects, runtime/OS engineers, scientists and ML Apps teams to seamlessly deploy state of the art ML models from our customers on AWS accelerators with optimal cost/performance benefits. You will have opportunity to work with open-source software (e.g., StableHLO, OpenXLA, MLIR) to pioneer optimizing advanced ML workloads on AWS software and hardware. You will also work on building innovative features that will deliver best possible experiences for our customers – developers across the globe.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in compiler architecture, you’ll create compiler optimization and verification passes, build features surface features and peculiarities of AWS accelerators to developers, implement tools to analyze numerical errors, and resolve the root cause of compiler defects. You’ll also participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal (other Neuron SDK and Amazon wide teams) and external stakeholders (open-source communities). Lastly, work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About the team
About the Team

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Direct Fulfilment
jobs.description:
Join a talented team of software engineers and technical leaders dedicated to reaching the next billion customers. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact, complex challenges as we scale our systems to support new and rapidly growing India and emerging marketplaces. As a software engineer on the team, you will be responsible for the technical design and implementation of solutions that enable our Direct Fulfillment (DF) model. DF allows vendors to ship products directly to customers on behalf of Amazon. This requires building systems that can reliably work end-to-end for emerging and global marketplaces and enable seamless customer experiences. If you're excited to grow your skills while helping us scale the world's most customer-centric retail technology, we'd love to hear from you!





Key job responsibilities
You will be a technical leader to drive the
- Designing and developing highly reliable, scalable, and distributed systems.
- Delivering quality features on-time and execution against project plans and delivery commitments.
- Working with team members to manage the day-to-day development activities, participate in designs, design review, code review, implementation, and operational excellence.
- Engaging and working with customers and dependencies to ensure the quality delivery.
- Mentoring other engineers
- Maintaining current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, always on a look out for new technologies and work with the team in bringing in new technologies.
- Launch products to India as well as world-wide marketplaces

About the team
Direct Fulfillment (DF), known in the industry as "dropship," is a fulfillment model that allows vendors to ship orders directly to the Customer. The offer is branded as 'Ships and Sold by Amazon' and the customer service experience is the same as items sold from Amazon Fulfillment centers, such that the customer does not know the difference. DF was launched in India (IN) on Oct 2018. Our vision: “provide customers with widest possible retail selection while maintaining a superior experience for vendors and cost structure for Amazon”.

jobs.title: Embedded Senior Software Engineer, Project Leo Customer Terminals
jobs.description:
Project Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

In this role, you will develop software for the Leo Customer Terminal embedded systems engineering team. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, deployment and operations of the functions for Leo Customer Terminals.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Development and testing with embedded Linux
* Develop embedded software functions for Customer Terminal devices within the Project Leo system
* Developing embedded software utilizing Rust, C++, C
* Participate in all phases of SDLC: requirements, design, coding, test, deployment and production system
* Development of software in a secure compute environment
* State machine design and analysis
* Support Customer Terminal deployments operations and debugging on production systems
* Technical writing of design specifications


A day in the life
As part of our software engineering team, you will design, implement and debug software used to test and debug embedded software for Leo Customer Terminal platforms in R&D and commercial operation. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams in Leo Customer Terminal hardware development, software development and operations. You need to be flexible and responsive to fast changing priorities and issues. You will work on Customer Terminal issues on production system platforms.

About the team
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team develops and supports the devices that connect Leo subscribers to the Leo network. We provide software for the Leo Customer Terminal platform, applications and underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver commercial grade services for our Leo subscribers.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Elastic Container Service (ECS)
jobs.description:
Containers are redefining how our customers are building, deploying, and running their applications. Do you want to join the Amazon Container Services team and help customers by building the future of serverless containers on AWS Fargate?

ECS Console team is looking for a software development manager to lead the team owning critical software stack governing the lifecycle of tasks running on containers used by major AWS services.

We are looking for a self-motivated, strong and people focused Software Development Manager within the ECS Storage and Networking group. ECS is a container orchestration service that lets customers to focus on running containerized applications without necessarily managing servers by removing the operational overhead of scaling, patching, securing, and managing servers. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron Distributed Training - Performance Optimization
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Trainium and Inferentia cloud-scale machine
learning accelerators and the Trn3/Trn2/Trn1 and Inf2/Inf1 servers that use them. This role is for a software engineer in the Distributed Training team for AWS Neuron. This role is responsible for development, enablement and performance tuning of a wide variety of ML model families, including massive scale multi-modal large language models like Llama, Qwen, gpt-oss, DeepSeek and beyond, as well as multi-modal generation models such as Stable Diffusion, Flux, WAN, and many more.

The Distributed Training team works side by side with chip architects, compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build and tune distributed training solutions with AWS Trainium, maximize training throughput, minimize time-to-convergence, and push the boundaries of training efficiency on Trainium. You will identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack, from collective communications and memory utilization to compiler optimizations and kernel performance.

Key job responsibilities
This role will lead efforts to optimize distributed training performance on Trainium, with a primary focus on maximizing training throughput, model flops utilization, and efficiency across the Neuron software stack. You will work across PyTorch, JAX, and the Neuron compiler and runtime to enable and tune large-scale training workloads on the latest Trainium instances.

jobs.title: Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the role As Director of Data & Analytics, you'll own Product Data & Analytics across Product & Engineering, reporting to the CTO, Ramps & Platform. You'll have a real mandate: build out the team, define how it operates, and make it the reason MoonPay ships better products faster. The metrics, experimentation, and data infrastructure that Product, Engineering, and Leadership rely on to decide what to build next will be yours to shape. This is a builder's role. You'll grow a function spanning Data Science, Analytics Engineering, and Data Analysts, hiring across levels and shaping how these three disciplines work together as one team. You'll set the bar for rigor, design the structure and career paths that let each discipline do its best work, and scale the function alongside one of the fastest-growing companies in crypto. If you've wanted to take a data organization to the next level, with executive backing and a business that genuinely depends on it, this is that opportunity. What you will do Own the direction, roadmap, and operating model for Product Data & Analytics Recruit, hire, and lead a team spanning three disciplines: Data Scientists (experimentation, modeling, causal inference), Analytics Engineers (data modeling, self-serve infrastructure), and Data Analysts (product metrics, dashboards, ad hoc analysis) Design the org structure, leveling, and career paths that let each discipline scale as the team grows Standardize how product metrics, experimentation, and analytics get built and consumed across MoonPay, replacing one-off analysis with reusable, trusted data products Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to embed analytics and experimentation into the product development lifecycle, from problem definition through post-launch measurement Set technical and quality standards across the team's work: data modeling conventions, experimentation methodology, dashboarding and reporting practices Represent data and analytics needs in cross-functional planning with Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Compliance Mentor team leads and senior ICs, building a bench of future managers within the function Report on team health, hiring progress, and analytics impact to senior leadership About you 10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or analytics engineering, with significant time in a management or leadership role A track record of building and scaling a data/analytics function from the ground up or through a high-growth phase, including hands-on hiring across multiple disciplines Deep experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to embed analytics and experimentation into how products get built Strong technical fluency across the disciplines you'll manage. You don't need to write production code daily, but you can evaluate tradeoffs in data modeling and experimentation design Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience communicating clearly to executives, engineers, and cross-functional partners alike Experience working within fintech, payments, or crypto is a strong plus An active interest in cryptocurrency and Web3, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, less-defined environment Salary Bandings: $360-410k USD

About the Opportunity This is an opportunity for an experienced Fraud Investigator to play a critical role in protecting MoonPay and its users from fraud threats in the dynamic, fast-evolving cryptocurrency landscape. You’ll sit within our Fraud Investigations team, leading complex investigations, managing and tuning fraud detection rules, and acting as an incident response during live fraud attacks, building AI-powered agents that scale our detection and response capabilities. At your core, you’re an incident responder focused on mitigating immediate impact from fraud while closely collaborating with ML, Product, Data and Compliance to build scalable long-term solutions and controls. This role requires someone with strong analytical abilities, excellent attention to detail, and a deep interest in financial crime prevention in the crypto domain. You’ll work cross-functionally with Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data and ML teams to execute fraud prevention strategies, analyze fraudulent patterns, and support the broader fraud risk framework—all while maintaining SLA and precision standards. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and want to have a direct, measurable impact on fraud losses, this role is for you. What You Will Do Detection and Threat ManagementMonitor fraud signals and emerging threats to identify attack patterns.Conduct threat hunting to uncover fraud missed by existing controls.Identify detection gaps and implement strategies to strengthen fraud prevention. Incident Management Act as an incident commander during live fraud attacks, coordinating containment and response across teams. Lead complex fraud investigations, identifying root causes and recommending permanent fixes to prevent recurrence. Assess the severity of fraud cases and escalate high-risk cases to the Manager or Compliance in a timely manner. Execute rapid containment actions (blocks, freezes, restrictions) to minimise fraud exposure during active incidents. Rule Management Review, build, implement, and tune fraud detection rules to optimise accuracy and minimise false declines. Backtest rule logic against historical data to validate effectiveness before deployment. Monitor rule performance in production and iterate based on real-time data and investigation outcomes. Own the False Decline Rate for rules implemented by the Fraud Investigations team, keeping it within acceptable thresholds. Agent Building & Automation Build, deploy, and QA AI-powered agents and automation workflows that enhance fraud detection and investigation efficiency. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive investigation tasks and scale the team’s operational capacity. Partner with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to translate investigative insights into scalable tooling and controls. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting Engage with Product, ML, Engineering, and Compliance teams to support investigations and contribute to fraud mitigation strategies. Provide support to internal teams raising fraud queries, acting as a subject matter expert on fraud risk. Ensure accurate and timely documentation of fraud cases, maintaining clear records for internal reporting and external audit requirements. Identify gaps in tooling or processes and provide actionable feedback to improve detection accuracy and investigation efficiency. About You Must-have experience and skills 3+ years of experience in fraud detection, prevention, and investigation, preferably in the Web3, crypto, or blockchain industry, with a strong understanding of the ecosystem, products, transaction flows, and associated fraud and financial crime risks. Demonstrated experience leading complex fraud investigations from initial alert through to root cause analysis and remediation. Hands-on experience building, implementing, and tuning fraud detection rules, including rule backtesting and performance management. Strong understanding of fraud typologies, attack vectors, and emerging trends in the crypto and digital payments space. Experience with data analysis tools and the ability to derive conclusions and recommendations from large datasets (e.g. SQL, Excel, or BI tools). Excellent critical thinking and risk assessment skills—you can evaluate the likelihood and impact of fraudulent activity under pressure and make sound decisions. Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy and thoroughness in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Clear, professional communication skills with the ability to write concise case notes, escalations, and cross-functional updates. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset—you identify problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools in fraud, risk, investigations, or operational workflows, with an understanding of how AI can be used to improve detection, analysis, decision-making, and operational efficiency. Nice-to-have experience Coding ability (e.g. SQL, Python) for data analysis, automation, or building investigative tools. Familiarity with blockchain analytics and on-chain investigation tools (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic). Knowledge of chargeback processes and card scheme fraud programmes.

About the Opportunity MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Head of Business Risk & Controls to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business. This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows. The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations. You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business. What You Will Do Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness. Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability. Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment. Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities. Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership. Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves. About You You bring 10+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function. You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance. You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities. You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up. Salary: 180,000 - 200,000 USD Salary is based on experience and location in the US

Assess and monitor counterparty risk across liquidity providers, exchanges, custodians, banking partners, payment processors, and blockchain infrastructure vendors. Evaluate exposure from cross-chain bridges, DEX swaps, and smart contract interactions, including protocol risk, liquidity depth, slippage, and settlement failure. Review & challenge risks related to crypto trading, including price slippage, execution latency, and hedging liquidity across venues. Work with Treasury on market, liquidity, and FX risk, including hedging strategy, inventory and float management, and stablecoin de-peg scenarios. Provide an independent review of new product proposals, collaborating early with Product and Engineering, ensuring all risks are identified and controls are integrated from inception, and recommending approval with or without conditions. Review business continuity testing and business impact analyses to ensure operational resilience and preparedness for disruptions. Develop, maintain, and evolve the risk framework, with a strong focus on defining and embedding Risk Appetite Statements and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), alongside risk registers, limits, and escalation procedures. Review technology and information security risks across core systems, infrastructure, and third-party integrations to ensure robust safeguards and data protection. Prepare risk reporting for senior leadership, the board, auditors, and partners Conduct third-party risk assessments and continuous monitoring for critical vendors, service providers, and partners. What You'll Bring Experience 5-10 years in risk management at a payments company, fintech, exchange, bank, or crypto firm. Understanding of cross-chain bridges and their trust and security models, plus the history of bridge exploits. Understanding of swaps, DEXs and AMMs, liquidity pools, slippage, MEV, and aggregator routing. Knowledge of hedging approaches in crypto, such as spot, perpetuals, futures, options, and stablecoin basis risk. Familiarity with stablecoin mechanics and reserve and de-peg risk, and with smart contract risk and audits. Experience with blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic) and on-chain data exploration. Core skills Excellent judgment under uncertainty. You can make a call with incomplete information and explain your reasoning. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact for non-specialists. A collaborative approach: you can say "no" or "yes, with conditions" without becoming a blocker. Nice to Have A professional risk certification (FRM, PRM, CAMS) or a quantitative degree. Experience in DeFi or familiarity with writing or reading simple smart contract logic. Prior experience building a risk function at a scaling company.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on. KYB API & partner experience The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once). Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it. Compliance as product Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix. EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product. Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy. Vendor & provider orchestration The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it. Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place. Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk. Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone. Who You Are A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature. High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it. Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction. AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team. Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy. You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification. At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers. You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build. A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped. Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.

jobs.title: 2D Animator
jobs.description: As a 2D Animator, you'll be a pivotal creative force, reporting directly to the Lead 2D Animator. You'll be instrumental in bringing our mobile games to life by designing, creating, and implementing high-quality 2D animations and cycles for characters, in-game elements, and effects. Your work will define the posing, timing, pacing, and emotional content, ensuring animations meet specific game requirements and contribute significantly to the overall player experience. Beyond execution, you'll engage in specialized activities within the 2D animation pipeline for assigned game content, ensuring the artistic vision and technical standards are met. This role is crucial in delivering the dynamic visual appeal and engaging storytelling that defines our titles. You'll also contribute to improving our 2D animation frameworks and workflows, while effectively using development software and tools. You'll primarily work within the Animation Department, collaborating closely with various teams to ensure seamless integration of animation into our projects, and contributing to broader discussions on game development.

jobs.title: 3D Artist
jobs.description: We are looking for a 3D Artist to work on a brand new game at the Jam City Narrative Game division. Your role is to contribute to the game team by providing the best in class 3D art. You will be modeling and texturing props, environments and characters, as well as implementing the assets in engine. **In order to be considered, you MUST provide us with either a link to an online portfolio, website or a pdf showcasing recent artwork upon application.

jobs.title: Associate 2D Animator
jobs.description: As an Associate 2D Animator, you'll be a vital part of our creative team, reporting directly to the Lead 2D Animator. You'll contribute to bringing our games to life by creating engaging and high-quality 2D animations that enhance player experience and support our artistic vision. This role is crucial in delivering the visual appeal and dynamic storytelling that our players expect from our titles. You'll primarily work within the Animation Department, collaborating closely with various teams to ensure seamless integration of animation into our projects.

jobs.title: Confirmed Backend Engineer - Care
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.

Your Mission We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Train Supply team. The mission is to scale the current BlaBlaCar train distribution in Europe supporting the expansion of the train supply to new markets and countries. As a backend developer you will work on technical challenges and product feature development from early-stage conception, to development, testing strategy, deployment, and monitoring of new releases. jobs.title: Confirmed FP&A Analyst
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions. Your Mission We are looking for a FP&A Analyst to join the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team at BlaBlaCar, whose mission is to structure, analyze, forecast and monitor BlaBlaCar’s activity and financial results. Reporting to the FP&A Manager, in a multicultural team of 11, your role will be to act as a link between finance and business. Your primary role will involve providing a financial business partnering to the Engineering department, responsible for developing our platform. You will also take part in supporting different commercial business units (incl. Carpooling, Bus Marketplace and Train) and Product & Marketing department. Your responsibilities Forecasting, budgeting and financial analysis of Engineering, Product & Growth departments, Presentation of financial results to the management, Development and maintenance of reports related to the commercial scope (Carpooling, Bus Marketplace, Train), Support the monthly reporting process, acting as a coordinator within FP&A and with Accounting teams to ensure reporting timelines are respected and presentations updated in a timely manner, Reviewing, approving and controlling the costs, ensuring high financial discipline, Reviewing and approving contracts signed by Engineering department, to ensure that financial terms are favorable, Controlling personnel costs in assigned scope, Prepare ad hoc analyses and reports. Your qualifications Bachelor or master degree in finance, economics, econometrics or similar discipline, Previous finance experience (at least 1-2 years), FP&A experience strongly preferred, An analytical mindset, Strong business acumen, Strong communication skills, You are eager to understand financial processes to collect and analyze data, Willingness to learn, Full working proficiency in English, advanced French strongly preferred, Nice to have: experience in a tech company, experience with a reporting tool (Pigment, TM1, Anaplan…), BI tool (Power BI, Tableau). What we have to offer Hybrid position : 2 days at the office per week 50% healthcare coverage (Alan) 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves Financial support for home office equipment Minimum 25 days holiday per year Local meal plan policy (Swile card) 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable) Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs Employee Stock ownership plan Regular team building events 1 day off per year to test our product Interested in joining the ride? PLEASE UPLOAD YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH ! a 45-min video-call with your Talent Acquisition Manager to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions a case study to assess your financial analysis skills followed by a 60-min interview with our FP&A Manager Patryk Korycki to discuss the case study, your interest in the role and your career expectations A 30-min chat with team members: Charles and Jessica, a 30-min interview with Candice François, Head of SFBA to check team fit Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.
